items.name: Ded Aleicar's Rock Key
items.description: This small rock key will open the door of Ded Aleicar's cave. So long as you find it, of course.

items.name: Dark Miners' Treasure Map
items.description:
This map reveals the location of the Dark Miners' Treasure Chest: 
"The chest may be found on an island. You'll have to pass behind a foundry to lay your hands on it."

items.name: Dark Bakers' Treasure Map
items.description:
This map reveals the location of the Dark Bakers' Treasure Chest:
"The chest may be found on an island south of Amakna; you have to walk behind rocks, between two small ponds."

items.name: Bworks' Treasure Map
items.description: This map indicates the location of the Bworks' treasure chest: "The chest may be found in a dead end, in the South-East of the Dark Forest. It will certainly be kept by a group of Bworks."

items.name: Wabbit Potion
items.description: This potion is a cure for Myxomawosis. A sip of it and you will be able to visit the Wabbit Islands safely.

items.name: Arachnid Leg
items.description: A very thin but very hairy Leg. The best alchemists manage to create powerful poisons with the juice extracted from these legs.

items.name: Captive Vampire Fang
items.description: This very pointy fang belonged to a vampire. If you wear it around your neck, or even if you simply carry it in your inventory... you'll be able to show it to your buddies. Sorry, were you expecting more?

items.name: Not Tempting Canvas
items.description: This large piece of canvas is slimy and smelly but yet of quite good quality.

items.name: Kanniball Barrel
items.description: This barrel is empty... at least, for the moment. Don't hang around the Forest of Masks too long if you don't want to be what fills it.

items.name: Kokoko Wood Plank
items.description: What will you do with this plank? Build a boat? Lay a floor in your house? Do you really care? Whatever, it's just a simple plank for the moment.

items.name: Kokoko Wood Beam
items.description: A solid wood beam. Don't poke it in someone's eye.

items.name: Essential Rope
items.description: Kanniballs use this rope to stop their guests from leaving the dinner table during meals.

items.name: Pirate Skull
items.description: This headband-sporting skull proves that even a dead pirate can hide his baldness.

items.name: Green Carapace
items.description: The carapace of a mad turtle that thinks it's a ninja.

items.name: Yellow Carapace
items.description: The carapace of a mad turtle that probably ingested too many dangerous substances.

items.name: Red Carapace
items.description: The carapace of a mad turtle that liked tomatoes and cheese on a warm slice of bread.

items.name: Blue Carapace
items.description: The carapace of a mad turtle who wanted to imitate Zowwo, the Masked Fox.

items.name: Green Mask
items.description: This mask, belonging to Cheerful Kanniball, has been made in the image of Greenery, the element of meat seasoning.

items.name: Yellow Mask
items.description: This mask, belonging to Whining Kanniball, has been made in the image of Lightning, the element of surprised young flesh.

items.name: Red Mask
items.description: This mask, belonging to Irascible Kanniball, has been made in the image of Fire, the element of roasting meat.

items.name: Blue Mask
items.description: This mask, belonging to Surprised Kanniball, has been made in the image of Water, the element of slaking thirst between two mouthfuls of meat.

items.name: Recommendation Scroll
items.description: Uba Tesse has given you this parchment. He has warmly recommended that you train as an alchemist.

items.name: Recommendation Scroll
items.description: You got this parchment from Uba Tesse. He highly recommends the alchemist training. There is a small note from by Boff Chalon.

items.name: Crocobur Pedestal Fragment
items.description: This Fragment comes from the pedestal upon which the notorious Crocobur has sat for many years and will continue to sit for many more. Little by little the stone is saturated with its powerful magic.

items.name: Hel Munster's Certificate
items.description: This certificate proves that Hel Munster is your mentor. You will now have to call him "Master Hel Munster".

items.name: Don Rouann's Faith
items.description: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret. You have currently learnt bravery.

items.name: Don Rouann's Faith
items.description: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret. Now that you have learnt bravery and communication, all that remains is to learn patience.

items.name: Don Rouann's Faith
items.description: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret.

items.name: Tuft of Tarche's Hair
items.description: This tuft of hair proves your victory against Tarche. You're a star!

items.name: Threatening Letter
items.description: A threatening letter addressed to Lady Marmalade.

items.name: Tuft of Torche's Hair
items.description: This tuft of hair proves your victory against Torche. Magnificent!

items.name: Vet's Syringe
items.description: One end pointed, a plunger on the other, it's a syringe, no doubt about it. You have been warned.

items.name: GM Wabbit Blood
items.description: Who would have travelled to the Wabbit Islands armed with a syringe with the sole aim of extracting some blood from the most genetically modified creature on the island? You, of course.

items.name: GM Wabbit Blood Analysis
items.description: Analysis clearly reveal that the blood comes from a Wabbit's hind quarter. After a thorough examination of the sample, the alchemist was able to determine which part of the backside was stung; for your information, it was the right cheek.

items.name: Tooth Extractor
items.description: This tooth extractor is specially designed for Chafers but you can also use it to extract one of your own decayed gnashers. The rest will surely fall out not long after, though.

items.name: Chafer Tooth
items.description: This Chafer Tooth is so similar to a human one, you'll find it hard to tell them apart.

items.name: Necklace
items.description: The necklace the girl lost. Unfortunately, it's in bad condition since its sojourn in a Crobak's stomach.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description:
Gunpowder. There's a label with a simple reminder printed on it:
Powder + Flame = Explosion

items.name: Rock Block
items.description: A Plain Crackler's rock block, similar to those used in the building of fortifications of Bonta.

items.name: Scurvion Venom
items.description: Some Scurvion venom which shouldn't fall into foreign hands.

items.name: Lord Crow's Scythe
items.description: Why cut wheat with this scythe when you can cut granite?

items.name: Inspection Form
items.description: This inspection form of the Brakmarian act n°243 enables you to detect whether a man is part of it or not.

items.name: Tattered Hood
items.description: The former owner of this hat probably took a few blows too many to the head, which tends to happen when you rebel against Bonta's authority.

items.name: Special Playing Card
items.description: This playing card has a particular appearance close to perfection. It is apparently a collector's card.

items.name: Crate of Edged Weapons
items.description: A crate of edged weapons, full of all kinds of blunt instruments.

items.name: Kittycare Tin
items.description: Yum! Kittycare! Your Kaniger will leap over the moon with delight.

items.name: Mud
items.description: That's that taken care of.

items.name: Blop Flower Pulp
items.description: You have picked up a very appetising pulpy substance.

items.name: Repaired Necklace
items.description: The necklace the Mayor's daughter lost, as good as new.

items.name: Bontarian Badge
items.description: This badge is used to identify militiamen who have fallen on battlefields. Apparently some people collect them in Brakmar.

items.name: A Day Leave
items.description: This pass gives you a day leave.

items.name: Aggressive Boar Tusk
items.description: The extraction of this Plain Boar tusk certainly required a great deal of know how.

items.name: Nicked Katana
items.description: It's Amayiro's weapon. You can easily handle it but it seems to be slightly nicked.

items.name: Repaired Katana
items.description: This weapon, which used to be nicked, is now ready to cut whatever you want. Amayiro won't be disappointed.

items.name: Cheque for 100,000 Kamas
items.description: Whoever pays his debts grows rich ok, but this is quite a sum! It would be better to avoid such debt, your children will be grateful...

items.name: Spying Report
items.description: This report written by Bishom Pot must contain lots of information about the daily activities of the Brakmarians.

items.name: Hunter Test Mark
items.description: You tried to take the test to become a hunter.

items.name: Tsog's Hidden Chest
items.description: You have found Tsog's Chest in a small box. It's strange but this box has the same smell as Tsog... yes, that same indescribably horrible smell.

items.name: Smelly Gobball Leg
items.description: This leg reeks of death... I assure you it was cleared of all involvement in the murder of its owner... Just smells like... Death.

items.name: Mak Gahan's Bone
items.description: You took this bone with you after you scattered Mak Gahan's body parts all over the room.

items.name: Scribbed Name of the Assassin
items.description: The name of the Burnt Cat innkeeper's murderer is inscribed on this slimy, smelly piece of paper.

items.name: Receipt for the Box
items.description: This document proves that you've brought back a crate.

items.name: Brakmar Key
items.description: This key was stolen by a squirrel for mysterious reasons.

items.name: List of Soldiers Taking a Break
items.description:
You got this list from one of the militia members who were questioned. It contains the following names:
Brank Thoof, Hoca Norss, Jack Rottance, and Kad Maxy.

items.name: List of Soldiers Taking a Break
items.description:
You got this list from a drunk at the inn. It contains the following names:
Hoca Norss, Tink Berval, Brank Thoof, Kad Maxy and Seta Bnamron.

items.name: Warrior Xale Dugros's Confession
items.description: Xale DuGros confesses that he never goes to the Inn. But he regularly has a break.

items.name: Warrior Nager Nacmeil's Confession
items.description: The warrior Nager Nacmeil confesses that he no longer takes breaks. He's been a bit under the weather lately.

items.name: Bishom Pot's Confession
items.description: Bishom Pot confesses everything. His behaviour is unforgivable.

items.name: Signed and Dated Leave
items.description: This document indicates you've got a minute off.

items.name: Militiaman Allen Tokar's Badge
items.description: The Badge of the militiaman Allen Tokar.

items.name: Militiaman Yook Aput's Badge
items.description: The Badge of the militiaman Yook Aput.

items.name: Militiaman Barry Flaye's Badge
items.description: The Badge of the militiaman Barry Flaye.

items.name: Elite Chafer Helmet
items.description: This Chafer helmet is damaged, but it's still effective if you want to be part of the elite.

items.name: Ixa Mustam's Will
items.description: It's written in ancient Brakmarian. It's such a pity that the sum of your knowledge of the language is one word, "Guo'rhalys!"

items.name: Greedovore Wine
items.description: Apparently, it takes about 20 years to distil Greedovore Juice properly. Any less than that, and it'll kill you.

items.name: Greedovore Juice
items.description: Greedovore Juice is as toxic as Scurvion juice, but if it's well distilled, it gives an incomparable taste to wine. Only a few people can actually distil this juice, and most of them are pirates.

items.name: Finche Aticus's Report
items.description: This report written by the spy Finche Aticus gives an exhaustive list of the weapons and warriors in Bonta.

items.name: Letter from Oto Mustam
items.description: A letter from your Master addressed to Vil Smisse. It is written in an unknown dialect to prevent nosy parkers like you from reading it.

items.name: Vil Smisse's Answer
items.description: This is Vil Smisse's answer to Oto Mustam, don't worry, it is totally incomprehensible to ordinary mortals.

items.name: Welloy Cab's Form
items.description: Paw written by Welloy Cab, this report will delight mathematicians and fans of Namnmnuble Bmbmeckett

items.name: Blank Report Form
items.description:
Empty Report Form.
Ready to be filled in by Welloy Cab.

items.name: List of Baits for Fishermen
items.description: Come on you useless piece of... Get that bait.

items.name: Special Baits
items.description: This special bait box looks like an ordinary can of KittyCare.

items.name: Tabach's Badge
items.description: Badge of Tabach, Clerk of the Order of the Valiant Heart.

items.name: Ybaul's Badge
items.description: Ybaul's badge. She is the Clerk of the Order of The Saving Spirit.

items.name: Aigurraf's Badge
items.description: Badge of Aigurraf, Clerk of the Order of the Sharp Eye.

items.name: Nocabregor Recipe
items.description: How to make Nocabregor powder: 3 measures of Magical Cure and 1 measure of Oilbow Grease. Only a firework manufacturer or an enchanter can make this recipe, with the help of some Flint.

items.name: Furious Whitish Fang Tooth
items.description: This tooth was bravely extracted from a rabid animal.

items.name: Words of Ixa Mustam
items.description: "My will can be found to the north of the lighthouse at Madrestam Harbour. Get yourself a Twiggy Shovel to dig it up. And give my son a smack from me!"

items.name: Words of Tsog
items.description: "I've hidden a chest at Sufokia's most easterly point, in an underwater tunnel. A word of advice before you go: get yourself a Twiggy Shovel to dig it up."

items.name: Invitation Letter
items.description: This letter is sealed and it would be very impolite to open it.

items.name: Sonacixem Recipe
items.description: This recipe allows Sonacixem, a formidable magic poison, to be easily made.

items.name: Filled-in Inspection Form
items.description: The inspection form n°243 filled in by Leonzi Trool. From the looks of things, he didn't have anything to do with it.

items.name: Letter from Zeurg
items.description: This letter indicates a spell capable of destroying Holbaids.

items.name: Tuft of Dike Tarak's Hair
items.description: This tuft of hair is ample evidence of your brutal treatment of Dike Tarak.

items.name: Tax Decree 51-11b
items.description: This letter impudently says that all the owners of alcoholic drinks must pay a tax to soldiers. For the retirement fund it says... I don't believe a word!

items.name: Burnt Cat Inn Cheque
items.description: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

items.name: Bwork Inn Cheque
items.description: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

items.name: Djaul's Inn Cheque
items.description: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

items.name: Misery Inn Cheque
items.description: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

items.name: Atolmond Inn Cheque
items.description: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

items.name: Danathor's List
items.description:
- 5 pieces of Pippin Blop
- 1 bowl
- 3 cherries

items.name: The Lung of the Plains
items.description: A big green diamond adorns this necklace. It's so flashy that people usually focus more on the diamond than the person who's wearing it, which can be useful in some situations.

items.name: Standard Champo
items.description: It's a standard Champo but at least it protects you from the sun.

items.name: Sbab's Hairpin
items.description: Sbab has given you this small brooch as a mark of respect for your demon's honour.

items.name: Oni Tnec's Confession
items.description: Oni Tnec describes the dreadful way he killed Rimaraf in his confession.

items.name: Scurvion Poison
items.description: Some Scurvion poison. The bill for the delivery is addressed to Oni Tnec.

items.name: Statement
items.description: An Investigation Report which reveals all Oni Tnec's stupid mistakes.

items.name: Oni Tnec's Badge
items.description: Oni Tnec's Badge, found in Rimaraf's home.

items.name: Lyeno's Badge
items.description: This is the badge you picked up near the prison where Lyeno is locked up.

items.name: Letter from Oto Mustam to Sbab
items.description: The aim of this fully ironic letter is to denigrate Sbab.

items.name: Lava Sample
items.description: This sample has been found East of the mine.

items.name: Lava Sample
items.description: This sample has been found West of the mine.

items.name: Lava Sample
items.description: This sample was found close to the mine.

items.name: Lava Sample
items.description: This sample has been found South of the mine.

items.name: Start of Report
items.description: This report outlines the worrying changes in the Brakmarian magmatic mass.

items.name: Raaga's Report
items.description: This report outlines the chaotic changes in volcanic activities around Brakmar.

items.name: List of Samples to Find
items.description:
Raaga roughly wrote down the information you need to find good lava samples:
'Search within a 5 miles radius. Look for small peaks.'

items.name: Interrogation Room Pass
items.description: With this piece of paper, you can freely enter the prison's Interrogation Rooms

items.name: Steward's Threat
items.description: This is a threat that Danathor wrote to cover his back later on.

items.name: Rimaraf's Address
items.description: Rimaraf lives in a house decorated with a flower pot at 13 Carving Alley, near the butcher's.

items.name: Danathor's Brooch
items.description: Danathor gave you this small brooch.

items.name: Statement
items.description: This person's alibi seems to hold up perfectly.

items.name: Statement
items.description: This person is a suspect whose alibi doesn't stand up.

items.name: Investigating Officer's Card
items.description:
A militia investigating officer is keeping a close eye on you. You are a suspect in the killing of Rimaraf.
The officer left his card after questioning you.

items.name: Good Vote Certificate
items.description: This small piece of paper signed by Satirev Refibrom proves you voted on a Judgement, and you voted well.

items.name: Wrong Vote Certificate
items.description: This small piece of paper signed by Satirev Refibrom proves you voted on a Judgement, and you lied.

items.name: Stolen Documents
items.description: These top secret documents are sealed with a death glyph. If you try to read them, you'll surely suffer a horrible, horrendous, painful death.

items.name: Tuft of Puja's Hair
items.description: You have given Oto Mustam's son a good hiding. Neither of them will appreciate it!

items.name: Reminder
items.description: Bring back 10 Treechnid Barks.

items.name: Tooth
items.description:
This tooth must be yours judging by the hiding Oto Mustam gave you. 
Wisdom would suggest you give it a while before going back to him... unless you want to be picking the rest of your teeth up with your other broken arm.

items.name: Satirev Refibrom's Threat
items.description: The Great Judge of Brakmar doesn't want to see you again. Apparently he doesn't have a soft spot for you in his heart. Don't worry, he has a heart of stone anyway.

items.name: Change of Order
items.description: This paper indicates you've already changed your order.

items.name: Spy Report
items.description: No recent dangerous activity has been reported. The militiamen organisation is in turmoil since the murder of one of their people. The culprit is apparently a Bontarian.

items.name: Sewer Rat Carcass
items.description: This rat is now dead meat... one less scum-rodent to crowd out the sewer entrance.

items.name: A piece of the Sewer Wall
items.description: This piece of Sewer Wall was found in the stomach of a thingamajig.

items.name: A Brakmarian's Card
items.description: Someone slipped this calling card into your kit. Apparently, it was a Brakmarian. It says that warriors are interested in your talents as an assassin and suggests that you join the crazy Brakmarian adventure.

items.name: Assassin's Description
items.description: You found a Bontarian who stank of blood. All you know about this fellow is written on this piece of paper.

items.name: Description of a Bontarian
items.description: You've freed a sniffling spirit but he didn't anchor on the targeted person. You have written some information about the person on this piece of paper.

items.name: Blue Larva Eye
items.description: Scrambled eyes with a pinch of oregano and some salty tears really gets you going in the morning. But you'd best not eat it, since it's what will prove to Oto that you've killed a Blue Larva.

items.name: Bunch of Larva Eggs
items.description: This bunch of eggs looks like a big bunch of grapes. Don't even think about popping them in your mouth though.

items.name: Harry Stottel's Note
items.description: The entrance to the Legendary Golden Larvae Cave is situated a little west of Amakna. The latent powers of your golden larva will allow you to enter the cave. But make sure it doesn't get hurt or else it will run to its daddy's arms.

items.name: Brakmarian Badge
items.description: This badge allows warriors who have fallen in battle to be identified. Apparently some people collect them in Bonta.

items.name: Red Candle
items.description: This red candle is unlike any other.

items.name: List of Standard Equipment
items.description:
A mid-level warrior should wear anything but rags or flashy clothes. A better option might be the following:
- A Camate
- A Vitality Headband and a Vital Belt
- Kluh's Boots
- A Brakmarian Cloak.

items.name: Militiaman Shorts
items.description: You must be a real fetishist to own these... or is someone making fun of you.

items.name: Allegiance Ring
items.description: Domen gave you this ring. If you give it back it means you support the destruction of life itself. Which is perfectly alright, of course, you'll just have to find some new friends.

items.name: Djaul's Bracelet
items.description: Djaul gave you this bracelet. It shows everyone that you agree with his words.

items.name: Letter for Oto
items.description: Domen gave you this letter addressed to Oto.

items.name: Turtle Eye
items.description: This turtle won't show off any longer.

items.name: Mission Report
items.description: This report relates the Brakmar attack on the East wall.

items.name: Letter for Oto
items.description: Domen gave you this letter addressed to Oto, but you forgot to give it to him.

items.name: Hair Tuft
items.description: Is this the tuft of hair you ripped out of that Osamodas' chest that time?

items.name: Letter from Danathor
items.description: "I have to talk to you, come and see me when you have a moment to yourself. See you soon, my young friend."

items.name: Letter from Larry Poller
items.description: "Hi, I'm Larry Poller, we met when Colonel Lyeno was freed. I need your help. Come and see me when you have a moment to yourself. See you soon."

items.name: Turtle Brain
items.description: Cooked with great loving care, this Turtle Brain can become a delicious meal.

items.name: Magik Dust
items.description: This blueish dust is a very powerful magic catalyst.

items.name: Ufot Eticili's Brooch
items.description: Ufot Eticili gave you this small brooch.

items.name: Title Deed
items.description: It's the title deed of Ufot Eticili's house.

items.name: Paro Cabanne's Prediction
items.description: Paro Cabanne's prediction for the next elections.

items.name: Pool of Blue Jelly
items.description: You pity the Blue Jelly, don't you... And you still managed to treat it like this!

items.name: Pool of Lemon Jelly
items.description: You've bullied this poor little Lemon Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as flat as it is now...

items.name: Pool of Strawberry Jelly
items.description: You've bullied this poor little Strawberry Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as misshapen as it is now...

items.name: Pool of Mint Jelly
items.description: You've bullied this poor little Mint Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as squashed as it is now...

items.name: Contaminated Rat Blood
items.description: Safety standards require you to keep 100 thumbs away from any Hyoactive substance. If you don't, the game will last 3 times longer.

items.name: Old Trool Fair Ticket
items.description: You can get into the fair with this ticket.

items.name: Black Tofu Feather
items.description: A black feather from a Black Tofu.

items.name: Feca Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Feca.

items.name: Osamodas Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Osamodas.

items.name: Enutrof Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Enutrof.

items.name: Sram Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Sram.

items.name: Xelor Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Xelor.

items.name: Ecaflip Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Ecaflip.

items.name: Eniripsa Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Eniripsa.

items.name: Iop Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Iop.

items.name: Cra Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Cra.

items.name: Sadida Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Sadida.

items.name: Sacrier Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Sacrier.

items.name: Dopple Certificate
items.description: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory over a Dopple.

items.name: Blue Larva Skin
items.description: A slimy piece of flesh snatched from a poor helpless larva.

items.name: Scissors
items.description: This pair of scissors is not much to look at. Its former owner glued it to his wrists and went around giving ridiculous haircuts to Gobballs. It was totally unprofitable, nobody paid the slightest bit of attention.

items.name: Fake Dofus
items.description: This Dofus looks like no other, and for good reason: it's as fake as the doctorate in kephalomancy that hangs on your wall...

items.name: Pandapiler Special
items.description: Lenald the Wise gave you this Pandapiler to take to the Pandawushu Master of the water path.

items.name: Pandala Amulet
items.description: This rather simple-looking amulet hides a mystery so mysterious it'll take a drunken, senile, partially blinded Pandawa anchorite to decipher it... In other words, you won't have an answer in the foreseeable future.

items.name: Chocolate Dofus Recipe
items.description: The recipe for the Chocolate Dofus is a must if you want to impress your friends.

items.name: Shamanic Certificate
items.description: This medical certificate is essential if you want to practise Pandawushuka.

items.name: Rank Attainment
items.description: This piece of paper is stamped with the date you last earned a new Pandawushuka rank.

items.name: Aerdala Dojo Certificate
items.description: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory at the Dojo.

items.name: Terrdala Dojo Certificate
items.description: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory at the Terrdala Dojo.

items.name: Pandala Dojo Certificate
items.description: This certificate indicates the date of your last victory at the Dojo.

items.name: Akwadala Dojo Certficate
items.description: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory at the Dojo.

items.name: Feudala Dojo Certficate
items.description: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory at the Dojo.

items.name: Love Letter for Poochan
items.description: A Letter apparently written by Timouss.

items.name: Second Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: First Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: Third Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: Fifth Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: Fourth Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: Sixth Firefact
items.description: An artefact from the Firefoux dungeon.

items.name: Bworky Hair
items.description: This hair won't stay in your bag for long. Well, I really hope not, anyway.

items.name: Sapphire Brooch
items.description: This jewel was stuck in someone's hair for months. The inscription on it explains that it can be used as a key once reunited with its cousin brooches.

items.name: Emeralda Brooch
items.description: This jewel was stuck in someone's hair for months. The inscription on it explains that it can be used as a key once reunited with its cousin brooches.

items.name: Ruby Brooch
items.description: This jewel was stuck in someone's hair for months. The inscription on it explains that it can be used as a key once reunited with its cousin brooches.

items.name: Diamond Brooch
items.description: This jewel was stuck in someone's hair for months. The inscription on it explains that it can be used as a key once reunited with its cousin brooches.

items.name: Mumminotor Relic
items.description: This strange relic is essential for you to meet the Minotoror.

items.name: Deminoball Relic
items.description: This strange relic is essential for you to meet the Minotoror.

items.name: Bootlicker Potion
items.description: This strictly illegal potion is dreaded even by the greatest. Indeed, just one sip will give the drinker a unique obsession: licking the nearest boots. Rumours speak of an alternative version that targets something else. The only clue as to this place is the bad breath of the unlucky drinkers.

items.name: Filtounga Recipe
items.description: This book contains the secret to a good Filtounga.... The mythic dish created by Mouss Bouff.

items.name: Warm Filtounga Dish
items.description: This dish is for the witch Paindep.

items.name: Bwork Beer Recipe
items.description: The great Bworknroll Magus reveals his sacred Bwork beer recipe, without leaving out a single secret and even giving a few tips on how best to enjoy it. A delight for fans, a nightmare for those who've already drunk this beer without knowing what it's made from.

items.name: Kin's Relic
items.description: This family item is extremely powerful. Usually passed from generation to generation, it hasn't lost any of its powers. There are very few artefacts that contain such power. Some say it has even been in contact with a Dofus.

items.name: Yse Vewybad's Recommendation Scroll
items.description: Yse Vewybad gave you this scroll to thank you for your favours.

items.name: Rogue Emblem
items.description: This Rogue emblem might be the key to meeting their chief.

items.name: Contract between Vil Smisse and Yse Vewybad
items.description: This contract proves Yse Vewybad's treachery. All you have to do now is show it to the right person... For example, Amakna Kingdom's Steward, a man known for his loyalty to the throne.

items.name: Obese Tofu Egg
items.description: This egg contains an obese Tofu... a creature that may defeat the Pwince of Wa in the future.

items.name: Force-feeding Potion
items.description: This potion will permit Vil Smisse to force-feed the obese Tofu that you brought him.

items.name: Wabbit Prince's Servant's Livery
items.description: The Wabbit Prince's servant looks gorgeous, darling, when he slips into his livery.

items.name: Wedding Dress
items.description: The bride's wedding dress has been carefully wrapped in this gorgeous package. It just needs to be brought to Steward San Lavalss.

items.name: Mark of Victory
items.description: You easily defeated the disciple. He gave you this scroll to confirm it.

items.name: Transformation Potion Formula
items.description: This book contains theories from various alchemists about the possibility of Wabbit Twansfowmation. All it does is show how little they've done on the subject.

items.name: Worn Treasure Map
items.description: Even though your eyes are wet with joy, you are still able to read that the treasure is hidden somewhere along the road of enslaved waters.

items.name: Handyman Information Card
items.description: This card contains all the necessary information to find the handyman described herein.

items.name: Purse of Kamas
items.description: This purse contains a considerable amount of kamas. Choose carefully who you bribe.

items.name: Bag of Potatoes
items.description: A bag of potatoes? What are you doing with a bag of potatoes? Idiot.

items.name: Torn-up piece of paper
items.description:
Part of a letter someone has torn up. Upon it, you read '...as we arranged, I'll make sure the investigation into this merchant goes nowhere. Come and pay me the amount we agreed where we usually meet... where the women are pretty...'
The letter is signed X.

items.name: Document about Xephires
items.description: This document contains lots of interesting information about a guy named Xephires. What's most amazing is the amount of time he spends in the Pandazaap Inn.

items.name: Milone's List
items.description: This incredible list was given to you by Milone the jeweller. It tells you of the objects necessary to create a sumptuous jewel.

items.name: Kilibriss Fluid
items.description: Is it really any different to ordinary slobber? It certainly doesn't look like it.

items.name: Letter for Milone
items.description: This hastily written letter explains to Milone that the jewel is in danger... so why are you still reading this? Get going!!!

items.name: Letter from the Chief Thief
items.description:
This was found on one of the burglars you beat at Milone's house:
Milone the jeweller has just created a very valuable jewel. Steal it by whatever means necessary. Fortunately, Milone gave them a copy, but it's no thanks to you.
On the back of the message, though, there is a guide to their hideout. A friendly visit? Why yes! Still, you probably shouldn't go alone.

items.name: Letter for Xephires
items.description: This letter from Oto Mustam explains to Xephires the plan in detail.

items.name: Milone's Jewel
items.description: You and Milone the jeweller joined forces to create this jewel. It'll sell for a fortune, if you ever manage to find anyone who wants it, that is.

items.name: New Letter for Xephires
items.description: Oto describes the conditions for corrupting Xephires.

items.name: Strange Sword
items.description: This sword really is unusual. You've never seen such a thing in Bonta.

items.name: Nek Feubuk's Notes
items.description: Nek Feubuk received the Ecaflips who mentioned Loudac's name.

items.name: Kikim Indabutt's Notes
items.description: Kikim Indabutt heard some guards talking about their problems with a gang of Ecaflips.

items.name: Bandit Ecaflip's Emblem
items.description: You found this emblem on the Ecaflip Plain Bandits around Cania.

items.name: Amayiro's Jewel
items.description: This jewel will be just perfect for luring the bandit chief into your trap.

items.name: Xelor's Letter
items.description:
This letter was delivered to you by Marge the jeweller:
Bring the jewel to Ekysoy Kubnan at the Kikim Inn. It'll be quicker for us and more profitable for you.

items.name: Amayiro's Jewel (Fake)
items.description: This jewel looks just like the one Amayiro sent you to get.

items.name: Bontarian Patrol Insignia
items.description: You found this insignia during the (very easy) skirmish with Bontarian forces.

items.name: Brakmarian Patrol Insignia
items.description: You found this insignia during the skirmish with Brakmarian forces.

items.name: Metal Shards
items.description: The numerous shards were found near some broken restraints.

items.name: Zoth Poison
items.description: This stuff looks more like mint jelly than poison. Zoths aren't known for making jelly, though... and neither are Brakmarian spies, which is even more worrying.

items.name: Powerful Militiaman's Badge
items.description: You found this badge on a particularly frightening militiaman who vanquished several warriors from Brakmar. His equipment seemed very strange.

items.name: Nara's Hammer
items.description: This hammer will prove to Oto that you've vanquished the mercenary smith of Bonta.

items.name: Request for Help from Amayiro
items.description: Signed by Amayiro, this letter is a request for official help.

items.name: Lenglad's Underpants
items.description: Lenglad won't want people gossiping about him for a very long time.

items.name: Nara's Toolbox
items.description: In this toolbox are all the tools that Nara the blacksmith forgot.

items.name: Plan of Attack
items.description: This letter, dated to a week ago, explains in detail the plan to attack Bonta. You'll need to be careful though, because a note at the end says the plan is still to be confirmed and may be changed in the coming days by officer Kapp Tenn. As a result, you'll have to find out what's happening with the plan at the moment.

items.name: Cemetery Patrol Insignia
items.description: You found this insignia on a Brakmarian patrol you attacked at the Cemetery of the Tortured.

items.name: Surprise Letter from Danathor
items.description: Someone slipped this letter into your bag while Amayiro was giving you your mission: Retrieve the documents, but bring them back to me rather than Amayiro. You will be rewarded. Danathor.

items.name: Secret Bontarian Documents
items.description: These documents contains lots of information on Bonta's defence system. But who are you going to give them to?

items.name: Bontarian Spy's Directions
items.description:
Break into the Tower of Brakmar at midnight and collect up all the documents that you find on the second floor. Come back to Bonta via the East road.
No, that's not what YOU have to do, they're the instructions for the spy you have to save.

items.name: Secret Brakmarian Documents
items.description: These documents contains lots of secret information on the Fogornleg Horn.

items.name: Ragged Bandana
items.description: This tattered old bandana is in a right state. It's covered in phlegm, like it's been used as a handkerchief by generations of Wabbits. It belongs to Elturt, that much is obvious, as despite the stink of Cawwots, you can still smell rotten herring. It must contain very powerful magic if it still smells that bad after so many years.

items.name: Fogornleg Horn
items.description: You tried blowing in it, but nothing much happened.

items.name: Brakmarian Spy's Orders
items.description:
Break into the Tower of Bonta at midnight, cut the throats of anyone that tries to stop you, and collect all the documents you find on the first floor. Then return to Brakmar by road.
No, that's not what YOU have to do, those were the instructions for the spy that you have to find.

items.name: Stolen Secret Documents
items.description: These are the documents that the injured spy recovered from the Tower of Bonta.

items.name: Crumpled Secret Documents
items.description: The secret documents that the injured spy found in the tower of Bonta. They were slightly crumpled during your fight against the Bontarian forces.

items.name: Babbage Laced with Pollen
items.description: This Babbage was prepared in the primordial cauldron, which has given it special qualities. To find out what they are, you'd have to taste it. Sadly, it's destined for Elturt's consumption. Life can be so cruel sometimes.

items.name: Crate of Equipment
items.description: A weapon, a helmet, a shield: this crate contains rudimentary but effective equipment for warriors.

items.name: Corruptite
items.description: Oto Mustam needs this alloy to make his blade. It disintegrates very quickly and must be kept in a special container if it is to be transported without risk.

items.name: Treated Corruptite
items.description: This piece of Corruptite has been treated and will no longer disintegrate.

items.name: Cursed Iron
items.description: A piece of Cursed Iron that Oto Mustam needs for his blade. You'd think it was normal iron, if it wasn't for the aura that would scare off a Kaniger.

items.name: Piece of Strap
items.description: [wait_mod_Bo7180]This piece of leather appears to have been snatched from the strap of a bag.

items.name: Oli Venders's Information
items.description: In order to be sure that you wouldn't come back to threaten him, Oli Venders scribbled down how to make a Bony Wand. An experienced sculptor ought to be able to do it by following the instructions, if provided: 1 Primary Forest Substrate, 1 Brassic, 5 Yomi Snowfoux Malleolus.

items.name: Gwenolaz Barnumuze's Message
items.description: A piece of paper for the judge Satirev Onivin on which Gwenolaz Barnumuze wrote that she was not for sale.

items.name: Enileda's Message
items.description: A sheet of paper for the attention of judge Satirev Onivin on which Enileda uses very flowery words to express her refusal.

items.name: Ma Cleopatra's Message
items.description: A letter of refusal to submit to the judge Satirev Onivin from Ma Cleopatra on which is written 'We do not have the same values...'

items.name: Maskara's Message
items.description: A draft paper for the judge Satirev Onivin on which Maskara scrawled that she refused to become his puppet.

items.name: Kwartzwatch's Message
items.description: A message written by Kwartzwatch for Satirev Onivin. The text suggests that she'd never take off her bandages for him.

items.name: Hammer of Light
items.description: This hammer is possessed by a powerful Light Spirit.

items.name: Hammer Hitocracy
items.description: This is the Hammer of Light, without the Light Spirit. It can be used to forged a demonic blade without danger.

items.name: Purified Hammer Hitocracy
items.description: This is the Hammer of Light, without the Light Spirit. It can be used to forged a demonic blade without danger. Domen has removed some of its devastating power.

items.name: Incomplete Sword
items.description: This impressive sword isn't complete yet, but it already gives off a powerful evil aura. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Incomplete Imbued Blade (level 1)
items.description: Oto lent you this impressive looking sword for you to take to Lagren and have imbued with power. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Incomplete Imbued Blade (level 2)
items.description: Oto lent you this impressive looking sword for you to take to Lagren and have imbued with power. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Incomplete Imbued Blade (level 3)
items.description: Oto lent you this impressive looking sword for you to take to Lagren and have imbued with power. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Incomplete Imbued Blade (level 4)
items.description: Oto lent you this impressive looking sword for you to take to Lagren and have imbued with power. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Incomplete Imbued Blade (level 5)
items.description: Oto lent you this impressive looking sword for you to take to Lagren and have imbued with power. Don't even think about stealing it. Not only is it not finished, it would provoke Oto's wrath, and that's something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Nightmare Essence
items.description: Use this essence to imbue Oto's sword with power.

items.name: Onivin's Wedding List
items.description: This list has been provided by Satirev Onivin, and details the Astrubian women he'd like you to talk to on his behalf: Ma Cleopatra, Enileda, Gwenolaz Barnumuze, Maskara, Kwartzwatch.

items.name: Miss Yelliott's Testimony
items.description: Miss Yelliott's testimony is written down on this piece of paper.

items.name: Miss Yelliot's Dubious Testimony
items.description: Miss Yelliott's somewhat dubious testimony is written down on this piece of paper.

items.name: Putrid Water
items.description: You might think that this bucket served as a chamber pot for an Altdemon but you'd be wrong. The stagnant water mixed with blood it contains is even more foul than that of the bottomless peat bogs.

items.name: Purified Putrid Water
items.description: Even though you know that this putrid water has been purified, you can't see any difference between it and the unpurified version. Up close, you think it smells even worse than before. Which is normal, as your nose is closer to it.

items.name: Kit Dingaround's Dodgy Version
items.description: This letter shows that you think there's something dodgy about Kit Dingaround's version of events.

items.name: Kit Dingaround's Believable Version
items.description: This letter shows that you think Kit Dingaround's version of events is to be believed.

items.name: Miss Yelliot's Believable Testimony
items.description: This letter shows that you find Miss Yelliott to be a credible witness, unless it's her so-called music that you enjoy.

items.name: Miss Yelliott's Dodgy Testimony
items.description: This letter shows that you find Miss Yelliott's version of events to be suspicious, unless it's simply because you do not like the way she speaks... or sings.

items.name: Gnirreh is to be Believed
items.description: This letter shows that you think Gnirreh didn't do it. What? Smelling of fish can be good, sometimes...

items.name: Gnirreh is a Collaborator
items.description: This letter shows that you think Gnirreh actually slipped the secret document into Kit Dingaround's bag, or maybe it's revenge for the terrible odour that accompanies him.

items.name: Verdict: Kit Dingaround is Guilty
items.description: This letter shows that you believe Kit Dingaround is guilty of treason.

items.name: Verdict: Kit Dingaround is Innocent
items.description: This letter shows that you believe Kit Dingaround is innocent.

items.name: Kit Dingaround: Guilty
items.description: This letter shows that you pleaded against Kit Dingaround. Danathor was pleased with your choice.

items.name: Kit Dingaround: Innocent
items.description: This letter shows that you pleaded in Kit Dingaround's favour. Amayiro was pleased with your choice.

items.name: Case Dismissed
items.description: This letter shows that you were not very convincing during the trial of Kit Dingaround and that the case against him has been dismissed. No need to wait for Danathor or Amayiro's recognition.

items.name: Wild Fury Potion
items.description: Burno forgot to remove the label from this potion. Its name does not bode well.

items.name: Imbued Evil Sword
items.description: The evil aura of this sword is much more powerful and stable than before. Don't even think about stealing it, that would provoke Oto's wrath, which is something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Miteters
items.description: Here are some Miteters, those strange things you sometimes find on the heads of Alyeenas with dubious personal hygiene.

items.name: Kanig Mammary Blubber
items.description: This blubber is extracted from nature's best-endowed Kanig Matriarchs.

items.name: Spiritless Hammer of Light
items.description: This Hammer of Light seems to have lost the spirit that gave it its power. As such, it doesn't look particularly impressive.

items.name: Replacement Doll
items.description: A doll made by Maskara's skilled hands to replace the one that the Light Spirit lost.

items.name: Maskara's Promise
items.description: This simple ring symbolises the promise Maskara made. She will play dolls with you (and especially be your doll) whenever she can. This makes it one of the most valuable assets in the world.

items.name: Mysterious Box
items.description: You dared to steal this crate from your own Tower of Orders to give it to the Rogues, without even knowing what it contains. To do so is to betray the trust that your Order Master put in you.

items.name: Bolzano Vieilletrasse's Report
items.description: This document is a report of your discussion with Bolzano Vieilletrasse.

items.name: Eowine Fiole's Report
items.description: This document is a report of your discussion with Eowine Fiole.

items.name: Lara Soft's Report
items.description: This document is a report of your discussion with Lara Soft.

items.name: Casper Van Brushing's Report
items.description: This document is a report of your discussion with Casper Van Brushing.

items.name: Wewe-Wabbit Haemoglobin
items.description: This blood changes colour according to the cycles of the moon. In other words, it's a nightmare for scatter-brained alchemists.

items.name: Information about Satirev Onivin
items.description: You have found out some useful information about Satirev Onivin and you have made a note of it (as well as a note not to put your nose too close to his mouth) on this piece of paper so you don't forget.

items.name: Information about Larry Poller
items.description: You have found out some useful information about Larry Poller and you have made a note of it (as well as some remarks on his physical appearance) on this piece of paper so you don't forget.

items.name: Information about Grace Malcean
items.description: You have found out some useful information about Grace Malcean and you have made a note of it (as well as some useful things to do on Saturday night) on this piece of paper so you don't forget.

items.name: New Message from Ma Cleopatra
items.description: A message written by Ma Cleopatra's small, soft and slight hands telling you that she is ready to meet Judge Satirev Onivin in person.

items.name: New Message from Enileda
items.description: A message written by the gifted hands of Enileda, who doesn't have any time for Judge Satirev Onivin.

items.name: New Message from Gwenolaz Barnamuze
items.description: A hastily written message from Gwenolaz Barnamuze, who writes that she's coming to see the judge and she's bringing her whip (and her Black Gobbly leather suit, if desired). To each their own...

items.name: New Message from Maskara
items.description: Another message from Maskara who has agreed to meet Judge Satirev Onivin in a calm and peaceful place.

items.name: New Message from Kwartzwatch
items.description: Lovely paper, beautiful handwriting and a beautifully written refusal. What more does Judge Satirev Onivin need to keep on trying, again and again?

items.name: Order slip for the Busnip 2000
items.description: An order slip for a Busnip 2000, given to you by Enileda and available for collection in ten days.

items.name: Letter for Grace Malcean
items.description: A letter written for Grace Malcean. It would be inappropriate to read its contents, given that it's not addressed to you.

items.name: Letter from Steward San Lavalss
items.description: A letter for Amayiro, written by Steward San Lavalss. You could also burn it, but that would be frowned upon.

items.name: Mystenergiometre
items.description: This device works correctly. More or less. You came to this conclusion without reading the instructions.

items.name: Amaknian Aubergine Soup Recipe
items.description: To make up for the lack of aubergine flavour, Amaknian chefs use beer. You'll need the following ingredients to make this soup successfully: 1 Drinking Water, 5 Pepper Measures, 5 Spices, 5 Aubergines, 7 Millets, 1 Spoiled Meat, and 1 Amakna Beer.

items.name: Notice to Appear
items.description: This notice is for the Bontarian soldiers, who have been the target of complaints from Amakna's people.

items.name: Letter from the Council
items.description: This letter from the High Council is addressed to Emmy Nens-Grize.

items.name: Sacri Zoh's Contract
items.description: On this paper, Sacri Zoh agrees to be a disciple of Esra'Ruoy'Dnim so long as he gets the salary he wants. Whether he deserves it is another question...

items.name: Kapp Tenn's Contract
items.description: On this paper, Kapp Tenn agrees to become a disciple of Esra'Ruoy'Dnim so long as he's named Commander within a day. But Esra'Ruoy'Dnim's more likely to call him slave than Commander.

items.name: Broken Restraints
items.description: Despite what state they're in, these restraints are still imbued with magic.

items.name: Dayvid Blayne's Contract
items.description: Dayvid Blayne has agreed to serve Esra'Ruoy'Dnim.

items.name: Sentinel Dodox Feather
items.description: You can almost hear the Fecas shouting from here: "But why would a bird that can't fly need feathers?"

items.name: Wish List for Father Kwismas
items.description:
Father Kwismas gets a twisted pleasure-pang when he reads the wish list of a child he's devoured.
You haven't written yours yet, so here's a sample.

items.name: Pik Api
items.description: This is one Pokipik who'll never see the light of day. Aren't you ashamed of yourself?

items.name: Alignment Conversion Certificate
items.description: This certificate was given to you by Morgan Faym'n. It contains some details which may interest you and it attests to your conversion.

items.name: The Bonta Register
items.description: This register belongs to Morgan Faym'n and contains many documents, some of which explain how to become a Bontarian. Inside is a page that you must fill in yourself.

items.name: The Brakmar Register
items.description: This register belongs to Morgan Faym'n and contains many documents, some of which explain how to become a Brakmarian. Inside is a page that you must fill in yourself.

items.name: Order Certificate No. 5
items.description: This certificate states that you belong to an order. If you want to join another order, you have to wait seven days from the date you received your certificate. Even warriors get to change their mind from time to time. Don't make a habit of it, though!

items.name: Memo about threats
items.description: You wrote a note on this piece of paper to remind yourself that you should never threaten an Astrubian when there are armed village guards nearby.

items.name: Ingrown Toenail Powder
items.description: Some old, powdered ingrown toenails which used to belong on the toes of an Enutrof. Many years have passed since it was ground down, but the powder still smells of feet. It makes you wonder if you might have been tricked.

items.name: Lear's Amulet
items.description: This powerful amulet used to belong to Lear, the leader of a long-defunct cult. Apparently he communicated with extra-dimensional beings and was able to clone souls. He was also able to resurrect himself... which must have been pretty handy when there were no priests about.

items.name: Forced Resurrection Potion
items.description: Sometimes souls can't or even don't want to be reincarnated. This potion is useful for forcing them to regain their original forms.

items.name: Enchanted Firefoux Rod
items.description: With a bit of luck, this rod will net you a Gabby tongue from a venerable Firefoux.

items.name: Gabby Tongue
items.description:
This strange organ is sometimes used as part of the Gabby Tongue interrogation technique.
This underhanded method involves forcing the victim to swallow a Gabby Tongue, rendering them unable to speak without flailing around like a madman, as if they were moshing, or worse, slam-dancing. This tires them out very quickly, and then the secondary effects kick in - the victim mistakes the very first person they see for their best friend in the whole World. Getting information out of them when they're in this state is a piece of cake.

items.name: Sumens Statuette
items.description:
This is one of the two statuettes Maimane gave to Sumens to represent the goods and evils of mankind. It owes its appearance to a spell Sumens cast on it, who wanted to keep it safe from greedy hands.
Two questions remain: does this statuette represent good or evil? And most importantly, why does it look so ridiculous?

items.name: Cokesoul Stone
items.description: This soul stone was enchanted by the master of the Order of the Putrid Eye himself and will coax souls into letting themselves be caught of their own free will.

items.name: Terra Bitya's Soul Stone
items.description: This soul stone contains the soul of Terra Bitya the Enutrof. You should take good care of it if you don't want your own soul to end up inside it.

items.name: Transgenesis Potion
items.description:
If you manage to use it correctly, this potion can accelerate the growth of plants by modifying their genes. No one knows if there are any side effects when the plants are eaten, but shhhhh. What the customers don't know can't hurt them!
You'll need three farmers and three alchemists to carry out the operation.

items.name: Transgenesis Scroll
items.description: This scroll activates the effects of the Transgenesis potion when the latter is poured on oat cereals.

items.name: Erzal's Blessing
items.description: This book doesn't only contain twisted stories of walking and talking dead, it also describes the ritual for forcing a soul to return to its body.

items.name: Recollection Potion
items.description: This potion allows you to recall a memory that was inadvertently lost.

items.name: Renegade Chief's Badge
items.description: You took this badge from a Bontarian renegade who didn't deserve to have it.

items.name: Field Location
items.description: Merlinmagus told you where the Militiaman is going to use the Transgenesis spell. You must hurry and get there before it's too late.

items.name: Modified Scurvion Seed
items.description: These Scurvion seeds were modified, but you can't tell the difference between them now and them in their original form. The real problem is that you definitely can see the difference between these seeds and Poppy Seeds. Only an idiot would make that mistake!

items.name: Safe Key
items.description: This key opens the safe which, according to Terra Bitya, holds the Statues of Sumens.

items.name: Small Bontarian Note
items.description:
This note reads: Brakmarian idiot, in addition to being stupid and ugly, you're slow and you smell bad. Even a Mama Bwork wouldn't want you as a pet. Why don't you go back to your pitiful city, or, if you're mad enough, try to recover the statue in the tower of Bonta.
Signed: A crafty Bontarian.

items.name: Strange Object
items.description: This strange object is really strange. But the strangest thing is the strange feeling that you could use it to access a strange place in the vicinity. Strange, no?

items.name: Brakmartian Hair
items.description: The tuft of hair was torn from an unknown creature bearing the insignia of Brakmar. It's irrefutable proof that you saw it, at least.

items.name: Psychopath's Badge
items.description: You recovered this badge from the still-quivering body of a psychopathic Brakmarian. Do you have so little shame that you'd even rob the dead?

items.name: Assassin's Badge
items.description: You recovered this badge from the still-shuddering body of a Bontarian assassin. Do you have so little shame that you'd even rob the dead?

items.name: Bag of Sesanabolic Seed
items.description: These magically altered seeds dramatically increase muscle mass. Conversely, they dramatically decrease brain mass. That explains why they are an essential ingredient in the diets of young Iops.

items.name: Present for Lady Keeper
items.description: This gift is for Kaffra Keeper's mother. From what you understand, it contains a small fortune that could cover the cost of your equipment for several years. Unfortunately for you, if you try to steal it, you won't live long enough to enjoy it.

items.name: Sesanabolic Potion Recipe
items.description:
Worldwide, only a handful of alchemists know this recipe. Merlinmagus decided to give it to you anyway because he was fed up with being bothered all the time: 14 Mandrakes, 14 millets, 14 elm wood, 7 sesame seeds, 1 Motor Pike, 1 Amorphid wing, 10 water.
To make a good Motor Pike, you'll need a fisherman to mix 5 Pike, 7 Tench, 1 spoiled meat, 1 Mush Rhume slobber and 2 Tanuki entrails.

items.name: Cherry Jam Tart Recipe
items.description:
Kelog Hornflex the baker created this recipe. Because he loves to please people, he's agreed to give it to you. Note: Cherry Jam Tart starts to melt after an hour.
- 14 Mandrakes
- 14 Millets
- 5 Pieces of Morello Cherry Blop
- 3 Cherries
- 4 Strawberry Jellies
- 1 Walnut Oil
- 2 Kido Blood

items.name: Sheet from Tillol
items.description: You don't know what miracle led to this sheet – signed by a famously unknown individual by the name of Tillol – to stick to you.

items.name: Kralove Soul
items.description: Who would have thought that such an immense monster would have such a tiny little soul. As they say, it not the size that matters, it's what you do with it.

items.name: Neutrality Form
items.description: This form has been returned to the militia at the Castle of Amakna by Morgan Faym'n. You'll need it to become neutral.

items.name: Desertion Form
items.description: This form confirming your desertion has been returned to you by Morgan Faym'n. You'll need it to become neutral.

items.name: Tuft of Innkeeper Bagrutte's Hair
items.description: This tuft of mangy hair was pulled out of one of Innkeeper Bagrutte's armpits. The smell of it makes you never want to smell anything ever again.

items.name: Paddock Key
items.description: The goblins are equipped with basic tools, so they recycle as much as they can, and this is no exception. Who would have thought that a simple bone could open their paddock? Not you in any case.

items.name: Kain Dharyn Crystal
items.description: Kain Dharyn's fame as a treasure hunter spread far and wide through Amakna. He discovered many crystals with incredible properties, including the power to uncross his eyes without using his hands. Kain told no one where the crystals were to be found, and to this day many Enutrofs seek it still.

items.name: Enchanted Kain Dharyn Crystal
items.description: This Kain Dharyn Crystal was enchanted so as to multiply the greed of anyone who sees it.

items.name: Chief Thief's Tibia
items.description: The Chief Thief will have a hard time walking with one Tibia less! Well, that'll teach him a lesson.

items.name: Blue Corruptah Stone
items.description: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

items.name: Yellow Corruptah Stone
items.description: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

items.name: Green Corruptah Stone
items.description: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

items.name: Stone of Corrupted Souls
items.description: This stone comes from the Well of the Corrupted Souls. It can be used to control the souls of creatures trapped inside.

items.name: Crate of Bontarian Equipment
items.description: This crate contains the kit of the perfect little militiaman. If the contents of the crate are of a similar quality to the crate itself, it wouldn't be surprising if it took less than a day to defeat the Bontarian militia.

items.name: Expert Report
items.description: As you expected, this expert report confirms the poor quality of the Bontarian militia's equipment. Oto Mustam will be delighted with the news.

items.name: Warehouse Keys
items.description: This glass bowl contains what's left of what was lodged in Sennuig's stomach. The good news is that the keys to the warehouse are in there too somewhere. All you have to do now is stick your hand in there and pull the keys out. Don't forget to lick your fingers afterwards!

items.name: Crate of Ore
items.description: You stole this crate of ore so that Latem Sa wouldn't be able to use it to forge new equipment for the Bontarian militia.

items.name: Smith's Hammer
items.description: You stole this hammer from Latem Sa and replaced it with a Hurrian Hammer. Latem Sa is so incompetent that he probably won't know the difference.

items.name: Avian Training Technique
items.description: This technique, developed by the famous Bow Meow trainer Roy Sigfred, tells you how to tame a Trich and make it man's best friend. It still won't think much of women, though.

items.name: Loot from the Convoy
items.description: You got this booty in the attack on the Bontarian convoy. Stampitor the Boor, who you can find in the Brakmarian Militia Headquarters, will surely repay you well for your efforts. He might even let you go in one piece.

items.name: How to Make Greedoburg
items.description:
Laura Soho, waitress at the Amakna Tavern, wrote down on this scrap of paper how to prepare a bottle of Greedoburg with an alchemist's help.
- 5 Pandaburg Flasks.
- 1 Greedo Rum.
- 10 Babbage.

items.name: Poisoned Fishy Salad Recipe
items.description:
Gropinson Cruaule wrote the recipe for Fishy Salad in the sand on the beach and you copied it down onto a piece of paper.
- A fishmonger (putting them in the dish is optional)
- 12 Sickle-Hammerhead Sharks
- 3 Crab Sticks
- 2 Lemons
- 4 leaves of Babbage
- 1 Yuara Pirate Oil
- 1 Rasputin Cake

items.name: Mulic Bere's Keys
items.description: These keys belong to Muric Bere. They unlock the door to his special forge where, amongst other things, he creates extraordinary items for very ordinary people like you.

items.name: Spentox Back-Scratcher
items.description: This very pointy back-scratcher will shape itself to your body's contours, reaching the parts other back-scratchers cannot. Yes, even there.

items.name: Army of Cheeken Ticks
items.description: Fatter than Gobball ticks, Cheeken ticks can devour up to 100 times their own weight in blood. Vampires and even Dark Vlad himself would turn pale with envy.

items.name: List of Yesteryear's Ingredients
items.description:
Here's the list Oto Mustam gave you:
- 1 Vaulting Rye Bread
- 1 Kerbabben Salad
- 1 Plate of Scrampi
- 1 Longevity Potion

items.name: Vaulting Rye Bread Recipe
items.description:
- 2 Funky Flour.
- 5 Water.
- 2 Baker's Yeast.

items.name: Funky Flour Recipe
items.description:
- 20 hemp
- 1 magical cure
- 4 onions
- 2 eternal ashes

items.name: Kerbabben Salad Recipe
items.description:
- 5 Spiced Stews.
- 2 Blopshroom Pollens.
- 10 Treechnid Buds.

items.name: Plate of Scrampi Recipe
items.description:
- 10 Grawn Fritters
- 5 Lemons
- 10 Babbage

items.name: Longevity Potion Recipe
items.description:
- 2 Unikron Blood
- 2 Memory Potions
- 2 Potions of Old Age
- 2 Ancestor Potions

items.name: Cheeka's Brooch
items.description: This Brooch was given to you by Cheeka for your valiant actions during the attack on the convoy. It also seals her promise to thank you in person when she returns to Bonta.

items.name: Bandit Hideout Key
items.description: This is the key to the bandits' hideout. Grimpil told you about a mechanism that closes the door automatically when someone enters. This is why everyone who associates with the gang has a copy of the key.

items.name: Tuft of Grimpil's Fur
items.description: When you hold this tuft of fur in your hand you seems to sense activity inside. You look closer, and yes... no... it's not fur at all, it's a tuft of enormous lice and ticks.

items.name: How to Use Nowaine Jelly
items.description:
This document on 1,001 uses for Nowaine Jelly was written by Liroye Merline. Here's what she says about copying keys on the cheap:
- 1 Nowaine Jelly
- 1 unit of Wild Grass
- 1 unit of Bakelelite

items.name: Confidential Documents
items.description: A list of confidential Bontarian documents. You might ask what these secret papers are doing in the bandits' hideout.

items.name: Compromising Report
items.description: This report is very bad news for you. It accuses you of being disloyal to Bonta and implicates you in numerous dodgy dealings. Only an expert can tell you if the document is authentic or not.

items.name: Flask of Brakmarian Poison
items.description: This flask of Brakmarian poison has been prepared just like grandma used to make it. The label advises you to keep it warm, and consume it slowly once you've opened the bottle. However, it goes on to say "don't swallow, unless you're the victim or a Bontarian". It would appear that the Brakmarians don't muck around when it comes to poison.

items.name: Client Register
items.description: This register lists all the clients who've visited the Alchemists' Workshop in Brakmar these last few weeks. The problem is that it's all written in Brakmarian - you can't understand a bloody word it's saying.

items.name: Gaming Room Key
items.description: This key will unlock the door to the Burnt Cat Inn's gaming room.

items.name: Petra's Heart
items.description: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had, and so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

items.name: Petra's Heart
items.description: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had, and so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

items.name: Petra's Heart
items.description: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had, and so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

items.name: Petra's Cheque
items.description: This cheque, made out to Oto Mustam, was written by Petra. It's a pity it's not a pile of glittering kamas, you could have discreetly helped yourself to some.

items.name: Oto Mustam's Shopping List
items.description:
Oto Mustam is making you pay the price for failing the test of ill will so miserably. He wants you to find the following items:
- 1 Sack of Bronze.
- 1 Sack of Malt.
- 1 Sack of Sage.

items.name: Celt'Axe
items.description: This hatchet looks very basic, as if from another age. It's of such low quality that it would be impossible to cut a Trunknid with it.

items.name: Nara's Katana
items.description: This Katana was made by Nara when he passed his apprenticeship exam. There is none other like it... it is up there with the Celt'axe for quality.

items.name: Roughed-Up Doll
items.description: You have a hard time believing that this ugly, smelly doll was once a Bwork Magus. Then you remember Bwork Magi are even uglier and smellier than the doll is.

items.name: Patched-Up Doll
items.description: You ask yourself if the doll was better off before or after it was patched up by Maskara. One thing's for sure, only a god could make a doll more beautiful than it was originally. Now you know why the Bwork Magus was in such a bad mood and decided to shut himself up in a cave for years on end.

items.name: Enchanted Doll
items.description: It's enchanting to see this enchanted doll back in the hands of the enchanter who enchanted it by the enchanted lakes. If he was still alive, the singer Jon Lemon would certainly have written an unpopular song about it.

items.name: Register of Rounds
items.description: Contrary to what its name suggests, this register isn't about Bwork Mamas, but the routes of Brakmarian patrols. There are many choices for an ambush on here.

items.name: Old Bwork Spellbook
items.description: This old spellbook belonged to a cavern-dwelling Bwork Magus, so the illustrations in it will be difficult for modern cavern-dwelling Bwork Magi to understand, and even more so for an ordinary Bwork Magus. Let's just hope that Danathor will find some use for it. It would be a shame to have gone to so much trouble for nothing, wouldn't it.

items.name: Fishy Salad Recipe
items.description:
Gropinson Cruaule wrote the recipe for Fishy Salad in the sand on the beach and you copied it down onto a piece of paper.
- A fishmonger (putting them in the dish is optional).
- 12 Sickle-Hammerhead Sharks
- 3 Crab Sticks
- 2 Lemons
- 4 Babbage
- 1 Yuara Pirate Oil
- 10 Cherries

items.name: Magic Patch Recipe
items.description:
This recipe was developed by the tailor Sosh to patch up magic clothing. Experienced tailors can use it to create a fabric that will withstand both the test of time and bad weather.
-	5 Cucumbers
-	5 Kurookin Fabrics
-	3 Kilibriss Downs
-	1 Firefoux Fabric 
-	1 Silk String

items.name: Magic Blood Orange Dye Recipe
items.description:
This recipe was developed by the famous alchemist Uba Tesse. No one has used it yet because Uba Tesse left it at his friend Sosh's house. Sosh generously gave it to you.
- 1 Magic Redness Dye
- 1 Magic Orange Dye
- 1 Wewe-Wabbit Blood
- 30 Monkfish

items.name: Patched Bandana
items.description: This bandana is in a much better state than it was when you first found it. It smells less of Cawwot and more of fish, which shows it's back to how it was before. Elturt will be happy to have it back in such good condition.

items.name: Warrant
items.description: This warrant, signed by Kaffra Keeper, says that Brakmarians should hand over documents to Seci Ves at the foot of the Brakmarian Tower of Orders.

items.name: Magus Ax' List
items.description:
Here is the list of items to take to the Revelation Ritual:
- 5 Drizzle Potions.
- 10 Water.
- 10 Pandkin Seed.
- 4 Magical Cure.
- 2 Hornbeam Wood.
- 4 Draught Potions.
- 2 Trusted Friends.
- NO sulphur.

items.name: Result of the Revelation
items.description: Magus Ax has written the outcome of the Revelation Ritual on this parchment. To use the Fogornleg Horn, simply sling it over your shoulder and sing "Doo-DAH! Doo-DAH!".

items.name: Container Recipe
items.description: Ralgout the old miner scribbled the recipe for the Corruptite Container on this old bit of paper which reeks of sulfur and sweat. Any lumberjack can make it with:- 6 Dark Bamboo Wood- 7 Gold- 7 Cod- 1 Lean Meat to have organic matter that soaks up corruption like a sponge (besides your body, of course).

items.name: Corruptite Container
items.description: Corruptite can be safely stored and transported in this container. Some eccentric Enutrofs use it as a means of personal transportation.

items.name: Artisanal Knout Recipe
items.description:
This improvised recipe shows how to make a Knout, a strange weapon for a strange creature with strange habits. The ingredients needed are:
- A Handyman, a Smith, and a Sculptor
- 1 Soryo Snowfoux Paw
- 1 Maho Snowfoux Leather
- 5 Thriten Tooth
- 5 Brassic
- 5 Bread Boards

items.name: Artisanal Knout
items.description: You built this box with the remaining wood planks to keep the Knout sheltered from the weather, or at least that's what you claim. It's highly likely that in reality you wanted to protect the sensibilities of your young audience by hiding the Knout inside this box.

items.name: Evil Eye Talisman Recipe
items.description:
To make an Evil Eye Talisman, you'll need a living jeweller and the following ingredients:
- 5 Crobak Feet
- 1 Kami Snowfoux Cornea
- 10 Flax String

items.name: Aerol Lotion Ingredients
items.description:
Here is the list of ingredients needed to make Aerol Lotion:
- 5 Draught Potion
- 35 Cod
- 2 Maho Snowfoux Wool
- 10 Magical Cure
- 10 Temporal Powder
- 35 Belladonnas
- 3 Potion of Old Age
- 2 People you trust (or don't)
- NO SULPHUR

items.name: Evil Eye Talisman
items.description: This talisman never seems to want to stop looking you in the eye, which makes it quite disturbing and increases your sense of paranoia.

items.name: Dark Hornbeam Wood
items.description: Dark Hornbeam Wood is identical to Hornbeam Wood, just dirtier. It can be used to forge evil weapons... like a sword, for example.

items.name: Dark Hornbeam Sword Pommel
items.description: This sword pommel was has been carved from Dark Hornbeam Wood. It's useless on its own, but with the appropriate blade you can make an evil sword.

items.name: Aerol Lotion
items.description: This lotion was invented long ago by the Enutrof alchemist Aerol who wanted to fight against hair loss. Unfortunately for him, the lotion does not protect against falling rocks and he died, flattened by a boulder during a game of bowls with some Cracklers.

items.name: Nightmarish Incense
items.description: This magical incense was made from the nightmares of prisoners tortured by members of the Order of the Unsound Mind. Its price is also as nightmarish as those who made it.

items.name: Evil Sword
items.description: This sword radiates a palpable aura of evil. Don't even think about stealing it, that would provoke Oto's wrath, which is something you do NOT want to see.

items.name: Barrel of Shambrosia
items.description: The barrel contains a strong, potent alcohol, based on Grass Snake venom and Moowolf earwax. Drinking even the tiniest of sips causes severe brain damage, so it is very popular with Iops who can consume it safely.

items.name: Access Map to Gordo McRamsay's Wine Cellar
items.description:
This map shows how to access Gordo McRamsay's wine cellar, located south of the Amakna Village Zaap. Boulders block the access, but you shouldn't have any difficulty getting through with any old pickaxe.
You also need a Bombu Barrel to transport the Shambrosia. A handyman will know how to make one.

items.name: Rump Feather
items.description: This feather, which appears to be giving off alcoholic fumes, was brutally torn from the rump of a wandering drunk. He knows now that alcohol abuse is dangerous for his health.

items.name: Letter from the Chief Thief
items.description:
This was found in combat against the burglars at Milone's house:
Milone the jeweller has just created a very valuable jewel. Steal it by whatever means necessary. Fortunately, Milone gave them a copy, but it's no thanks to you.
On the back of the message, though, there is a guide to their hideout. Revenge beckons, but you won't be able to do it alone.

items.name: Horrible Sludge
items.description: This horrible sludge appeared in your pocket as if by filthy magic.

items.name: Renegade Message
items.description: This message convenes the renegades to the Scaraleaf dungeon. You should go there yourself to find out more.

items.name: Renegade Chief's Message
items.description: In this message, the chief of the renegades requests that they meet him in the South of the bandit territory. This is your chance to get rid of this traitor.

items.name: Mojeetov Cocktail
items.description: What do you get when you crush a Mojeeto Petal? Alcoholic sap that is used to make a wide range of cocktails. Otomai's disciples are very fond of these drinks and consume many litres during the summer festivals. Guaranteed to set the party on fire.

items.name: Warning Whistle
items.description: This whistle, crafted according to Roy Sigfred's Canine Breeding Technique, is used to call tamed Whitish Fangs. You can't imitate the master of a Whitish Fang which does not belong to you, though. It also works on wild Whitish Fangs.

items.name: Plain Bandit Canine Tooth
