items.description: The fight with the Plain Bandits was so violent that one of them lost a tooth.

items.name: Xarthan's Meeting
items.description: This note was written by a Brakmarian. It says that Xarthan is to come to the Tower of Bonta after his next meeting. That means that he may be already there.

items.name: Used Handkerchief
items.description: You found this handkerchief during your battle with Xephires. It's a nice little souvenir, and could come in handy if you get a cold. You could also make a knot hat out of it, if you don't mind looking a bit crazy.

items.name: Crate of Merchandise
items.description: Xephires has asked you to deliver this crate of merchandise to Pandarin Sudopong to show your "goodwill". You're not sure what's in there, but you know whatever it is valuable.

items.name: Nara's List of Supplies
items.description: Nara made a list of what he needs for his new forge. 20 Oak Wood, 1 Sulphur Pouch, 30 Iron, 1 Kouartz, 5 Bakelelite and 10 Wild Plain Boar Leather.

items.name: Notes on Erzal's Malediction
items.description: Erzal's Malediction indicates how to bring a soul back to life against its will. You'll need 1 unit of Healer Potion, 5 units of Magical Cure and 1 Lear Amulet, found on the corpse of a Greedovore.

items.name: Cancellation Order
items.description: This letter, dated to a few hours ago, tells that the assault on Bonta has been cancelled due to improvements to their militiamen's equipment, and the capture of the traitor Xephires.

items.name: Letter for Fidji Merline
items.description: Ebru of El entrusted you with this letter for Fidji Merline. You have to follow the Brakmarian Handywoman's instructions exactly.

items.name: Modified Manger
items.description: This manger has been modified to hide aubergines. You really don't want to be stuck on top of a mount that has eaten from it. The gases released by the excessive consumption of aubergines have been known to lead to horrific accidents.

items.name: Hairy Leg
items.description: This leg is covered in Arachnee and Bow Meow hairs and can make a frightening weapon when Shush Tercesasti is confronted with it.

items.name: Description of a Stranger
items.description: Robin Gaywould wrote down the description of the stranger who was talking to Kit Dingaround. Strangely, it doesn't match the description he gave you when he first told you. Something's not quite right here...

items.name: Norb's List
items.description: Norb made a list of what you have to take to Nara. You'll need 2 Bakelelite, 10 Manganese, 20 Bauxite, 15 Dolomite and 20 Oliviolet Wood.

items.name: Smuggler's Key
items.description: You retrieved this key from the jagged remains of a body rocked with spasms. It affected you no more than if you'd retrieved it from a counter. Which is fair enough, as the piece of corpse you found this key on was lying on a counter.

items.name: Crate of Precious Minerals
items.description: This box is filled with valuable ore used to manufacture equipment for the militia of Bonta. Domen has asked you to take it to Kazzy Duno, who will know what to do with it.

items.name: Key to the False Hideout
items.description: This key is used to open the False Hideout belonging to supporters of Djaul and Hecate, located near the Djaul Inn.

items.name: Crate of Poision
items.description: This crate of poison comes from Brakmar, guaranteeing its effectiveness. It contains enough poison to exterminate an army of ticks, so it's advisable to carry it carefully.

items.name: Soryo Firefoux Skin Briefs
items.description: The effectiveness of Maho Snowfoux Skin Briefs is guaranteed by the descendants of Captain Chafer. Usually worn by babies with fragile skin, these briefs will also make a great impression at Captain Chafer's Panty Party.

items.name: Crate of Swords
items.description: This crate contains many swords for members of the Order of the Bleeding Heart or the Unsound Mind, whoever appropriates them first.

items.name: Old, Worn-Out Book
items.description: This book's cover is as worn and as wrinkled as the skin of a centenarian Enutrof. A quick look inside is enough to confirm that it is intended for Iops. There are very few words, but lots of pictures, because everybody knows that the average Iop is illiterate, just like the newly incarnated souls in Astrub.

items.name: Dark Treechnid Dark Bark
items.description: Darker than Dark Treechnid Bark, this bark owes its brilliance to the magic substances it is imbued with.

items.name: Carved Dark Bark
items.description: In order not to damage it, you placed the carved dark bark into this box.

items.name: Bloody Master Vampire's Tight-Fitting Leather Briefs
items.description: In order to avoid being hit in the spots where it hurts, the Bloody Vampire Master sometimes puts on his leather briefs when he goes hunting. The briefs also provide good protection against sunburn.

items.name: Location of the Ecaflip Tile
items.description:
According to Grizmine, the Ecaflip tile is at the centre of Minotoror Island.
Its magic can be deactivated with a Piece of Badoul's Treasure.

items.name: Location of the Xelor Tile
items.description: Kwartzwatch hid the Xelor tile somewhere in the village of Feudala. Around ten Temporal Powders should be enough to deactivate it.

items.name: Location of the Enutrof Tile
items.description: According to Annapelle, her husband Nystig buried the Enutrof tile north-east of their house at the foot of a dragoturkey statue. A Crackler's Gold Tooth is needed to deactivate it.

items.name: Notes Concerning Nosilla Budois's Vision
items.description: According to Nosilla Budois, the Light Spirit is said to have crossed the Amakna Forest and mountains to settle in what seems to be the Cemetery of the Tortured. Nosilla also spoke of a city with an alchemist's house, an Eniripsa standing in front of it, and a Sadida making a doll. You have noted the description.

items.name: Stolen Fragment of Time
items.description: This Fragment of Time was stolen from Xelor's Clock by the Demons of the Hours. It would be best not to boast about possessing such an object if you want to avoid the wrath of said god.

items.name: Torn Up Mission Papers
items.description:
This piece of torn paper indicates the end of a mission: ... and take him to the Brakmar jail for interrogation.
It looks like it was lost quite recently.

items.name: Wyrmwell
items.description: Who would have thought that a Wyrmwell belonging to a dragon could look so mundane? Surely not you.

items.name: Sacred Water
items.description: This water comes from an underground source in Akwadala. The alcohol vapours continuously steaming from it confirm its sacred nature.

items.name: Bunch of Keys
items.description: The long bits on these keys are very flexible, but they soon lose their agility, and only regain their magical properties after a week. Using them will get you into any dungeon you like - once a week, though. Have I stressed that enough?

effects.formatted:
Attracts the target.

The attraction is greater and the spell's maximum range is increased by 4 if the caster is at Suffering 6 or more.

Inflicts Fire damage.
Inflicts additional Fire damage on summons.

[!] Occasionne des dommages Air.
Si la cible est dans l'état Proie, les alliés à son contact gagnent 1 PM.
Inflicts Neutral damage or eats an Arachnee egg to unbewitch and heal itself.
Inflicts Air damage and increases the damage suffered by enemies in a 2-cell circle around the target.

items.name: Dontase Mebro Shovel Instruction Manual
items.description: This book, translated into 198 languages and dialects, explains how and under what circumstances to use the Dontase Mebro Shovel. The pages written in Bwork and Iop are also the ones with most pictures.

items.name: Lost Thought
items.description: This chrysalis contains a thought lost by Solar, and a beautiful golden flutterthought will soon hatch from it, as long as it is not destroyed or sold beforehand.

items.name: Sag Dratsum's list
items.description: Sag Dratsum has told you the items you need for a tailor to make a Sag Mask: 2 Pyrutes, 20 Hemp Fibres, 20 Black Gobball Leathers, 1 pair of Brown Boxers, 2 Fungore Gills.

items.name: Sacrier's Tears
items.description: This water comes from a pool created by the tears of the goddess Sacrier. Apart from its origin, nothing distinguishes it from conventional water, except for its slight salty taste.

items.name: Stroken
items.description: Behind the strange name, a few tough fights surely hide... You win them in battle and you trade them with one of the Sacre siblings in the militias of the rival cities.

items.name: Memory Fragments
items.description: If one day you were told that it was possible to steal a fragment of memory, and forge a weapon with it, you wouldn't have believed it. Now that you're telling this story, it's others who don't believe it.

items.name: Dawn Shard
items.description: The magic from this weapon is so powerful that you can feel it vibrating in the air. If Jiva wasn't renowned for being such a fierce fighter, you might think that this object was intended for other use altogether... if thoughts like that ever reached Danathor's ears, you'd end up being stoned to death in a public square.

items.name: The Four Bandit Brothers' Magic Formula
items.description:
This magic formula was elaborated by the four bandit brothers: Smirkerth, Amlock, Dusolair and Firetellini. It will allow you to rob your enemies or young fans without a trace!
Once the formula is pronounced, its effects will spread to the World of Twelve... before fading away.

items.name: Amaryllis
items.description: A flower that is delightful to look at, to feel and to caress. No wonder the Brakmarians have cut them down to the point that virtually none exist today.

items.name: A Tuft of Hair from the Abominable Sept of the Seas
items.description: This tuft of irritating hair could be what provokes the Abominable Sept of the Seas' bad moods. Indeed, he's very angry right now, given that you've just torn it from him.

items.name: Cra Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Cra Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Ecaflip Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating an Ecaflip Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Eniripsa Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating an Eniripsa Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Enutrof Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating an Enutrof Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Feca Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Feca Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Iop Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Iop Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Osamodas Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating an Osamodas Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Pandawa Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Pandawa Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Sacrier Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Sacrier Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Sadida Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Sadida Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Sram Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Sram Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Xelor Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Xelor Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Lunar Rock Fragment
items.description: According to legend, there was a time when, on full moon nights, goddess Pandawa bathed naked in the Akwadala springs. Unable to remain unimpressed by a show of such beauty, the moon exploded with joy and dozens of pieces of rock were thrown to the surface of the World of Twelve. These days, only some are left.

items.name: Invisible Oil Recipe
items.description: This recipe is a simple list of ingredients: 6 Invisible Chafer Bones, 2 Invisible Fabric, 14 Millets, 7 Tench, 2 Rotaflor Belladonnas.

items.name: Invisible Oil
items.description: Invisible Oil is an extremely powerful magic oil. Indeed, as the stains generated by this oil cannot be seen, it is a delight for young laundresses and young, turbulent Iops.

items.name: Fake Sumens Statuette
items.description: This statuette looks remarkably like the real Sumens statuette – or perhaps it's the original itself. It would be better to keep those doubts to yourself and not to talk to your superiors about it.

items.name: Mush Rhume Snot
items.description: This drip has a stronger taste than the snot dripping from your nose. You're clearly tasteless.

items.name: Dramanita Heart
items.description: This heart belonged to a Dramanita, but you stole it. Kind of in the same way it had been stolen from another adventurer's chest before you.

items.name: Broken Mystenergiometre
items.description: Something's wrong with this device. Just like any good amateur DIYer, you came to this conclusion without reading the instructions.

items.name: Black Magic Egg
items.description: This egg is stuffed with black magic. It's like the Ebony Dofus, but much less powerful.

items.name: Sidimote Trool Blood Sample
items.description: You worked hard for this sample. Really hard.

items.name: Sacri Zoh's Contract
items.description: This is a draft of a future contract linking Sacri Zoh to Esra'Ruoy'Dnim. As meticulous as Sacri Zoh is, it's hard for him to draft a contract in one go.

items.name: Sacri Zoh's Contract
items.description: This is a draft of a future contract linking Sacri Zoh to Esra'Ruoy'Dnim. As meticulous as Sacri Zoh is, it's hard for him to draft a contract in one go.

items.name: Kapp Tenn's Contract
items.description: Kapp Tenn is fairly demanding, and writing his contract was no easy task. However, with a bit of perseverance, it's doable.

items.name: Kapp Tenn's Contract
items.description: Kapp Tenn is fairly demanding, and writing his contract was no easy task. However, with a bit of perseverance, it's doable.

items.name: Recipe for Climbing Rope
items.description: A handyman can make climbing rope using the following resources: 30 hemp, 5 silk string and 1 nephilady silk.

items.name: Recipe for Impure Corruptah Stone
items.description:
Impure corruptah stones of different colours can be made at the crusher with the following ingredients:
Blue: 2 Bluish Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.
Yellow: 2 Lemon Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.
Green: 2 Mint Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.

items.name: Recipe for Corruptah Stone
items.description:
At the Crusher, a miner can make Corruptah Stones of different colours using the following ingredients:
Blue: 10 Impure Blue Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.
Yellow: 10 Impure Yellow Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.
Green: 10 Impure Green Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.

items.name: Magic Shadowy Dye Recipe
items.description: An alchemist can prepare Magic Shadowy Dye from following ingredients: 1 Magic Dark Dye, 1 Dark Treechnee Bark, 1 Dark Treechnid Root, 1 Venerable Treechnid Root and 1 Morrow Bone.

items.name: Bombu Barrel Recipe
items.description: A handyman can make this barrel from 80 Bombu Wood and 3 Ebonite.

items.name: Ougaa'g
items.description: As the name might suggest, swallowing this substance may not be a fantastic idea.

items.name: Sutol Flower
items.description:
This flower is grown in the indoor garden of Amakna's shoemakers' workshop. It is almost indistinguishable from a Lotus flower, except that, unlike its aquatic cousin, it grows directly in the soil.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: The Sacre's Orders
items.description: This torn piece of paper lists all the instructions of the Sacre Family. They are quite simple. They order you to track and execute a target. And do not come back before 10 minutes after the fight.

items.name: Jorbak's Imprint
items.description: You've noted down when Jorbak's spirit will be visible. No need to rush things.

items.name: Goultarminator's Bloody Souvenir
items.description: You tore this heart from Goultard's Evil Essence. You can now put it on your desk as a souvenir.

items.name: Perfect Immature Koalak Skin
items.description: The little immature Koalak who's skin you tore off didn't want you to treat him that way... but hey, you're stronger and crueller than he is.

items.name: Perfect Ginger Dragoturkey Wing
items.description: This wing smells like sulphur. Any Dragoturkey breeder will tell you it's the most tender part for a barbecue. Just don't forget to season it because the wing is also the most tasteless part.

items.name: Perfect Dragoturkey Wing
items.description: The domestic Dragoturkey tastes much better than its wild cousin. It has no sulphurous aftertaste, and the meat is delightfully moreish. That's why it's every child's favourite meal.

items.name: Irritating Koalak Forester Hair
items.description: This hair is covered in Kaliptus sap, giving it a shiny glint. Unfortunately, it cannot be used for haute couture as it smells like rotting Dragoturkey.

items.name: Magic Mama Koalak Bone
items.description: Mama Koalak has particularly solid bones that don't break under her weight. The same cannot be said for the famous minstrel Jon Lemon who lost the use of both his arms when he got squashed by Mama Koalak's humongous thighs.

items.name: Irritating Brown Warko Beard Hair
items.description: This hair is urticant enough to change simple Brown Warko kisses into weapons of mass destruction. Very urticant indeed.

items.name: Restraining Order
items.description: Your host has decided to block your access to his crypt for the next 24 hours because you were so rude to him.

items.name: Note on Krtek
items.description: You've noted down at what time Krtek took a beating. That way, you'll know when to return to give him another one.

items.name: Eggshell
items.description: What you're holding in your hands is all that remains of the enormous eggshells that appeared on the Dreggon Peninsula. It wouldn't even make a decent ashtray.

items.name: Enormous Fang
items.description: Grasmera and Grozilla clashed in an epic battle. All that remains is this enormous fang. Who will believe that you were there?

items.name: Manitou Zoth's Tight Leather Briefs
items.description: Now you can truthfully say that the Manitou Zoth is naked under his kilt.

items.name: Harry Kwismas's Orders
items.description: Harry Kwismas has revealed the identity of one of the monsters responsible for the break-in at Father Kwismas' workshop. If you aren't able to defeat the monster in two hours, you can head back to Harry and get a new order.

items.name: Harry Kwismas's Congratulations
items.description: Harry Kwismas greatly appreciated your victory. Come back in 24 hours, he'll need your help again if all the boxes of gifts still haven't been found.

items.name: Small Box of Gifts
items.description: This small box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

items.name: Box of Gifts
items.description: This box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

items.name: Large Box of Gifts
items.description: This large box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

items.name: Minotoball's Sealed Gift
items.description: No one knows what this gift contains. The Minotoball took the secret to his grave, as if you needing reminding that was your fault. You must be sick to death of hearing it, right?

items.name: Remains of Goultard's family
items.description: A few mouldering bones and some funereal jewellery is all that is left of Goultard's family.

items.name: Cabotine's Cursed Necklace
items.description: This cursed necklace's aura is so powerful you're having difficulty getting rid of the damned thing.

items.name: Hints for Dark Vlad
items.description: A simple map and a whereabouts elixir (which could very well just be an intelligence potion). With this, even Dark Vlad should be able to escape his labyrinth.

items.name: Extracts from "Goultard's Childhood"
items.description: Stained, spotted and wrinkled, these pages are almost illegible. However, through the thick layer of grime you can make out a few words. These pages are an extract from a forgotten book detailing Goultard's origins.

items.name: Wanted Notice
items.description: This is a wanted notice for Lethaline Sigibul.

items.name: Mastogob Wisdom Tooth
items.description: You pulled this tooth from the jaw of a still-living Mastogob. What's wrong with you? Are you crazy, or something?

items.name: Frozen Entrails
items.description: These entrails froze as soon the second you pulled them from the body cavity you found them in.

items.name: Pingwin Foot
items.description: As if it wasn't bad enough already that he has no arms, what's going to happen to the Pingwin whose foot you tore off?

items.name: Ethereal Skull
items.description: How can a skull be ethereal? Having thought about it a lot, you find yourself laughing at the answer to that question.

items.name: Volun Tear
items.description: This tear symbolises resilience in the face of oppression.

items.name: Magmatic Teardrop
items.description: Instead of wetting, this tear burns any combustible material it comes into contact with, so there's no risk of your makeup running when your boyfriend leaves you for his Dragoturkey.

items.name: Givranchy
items.description: Extract of Snowfoux musk is enormously popular with the female Snowfoux population, and it makes a great gift for your suitors or rivals.

items.name: Petrified Lichen
items.description: This lump of lichen was frozen solid by the cold. Once defrosted, you can use it in a Frigostian variant of Black Pudding Pizza.

items.name: Strange Object
items.description: You'd have to be a real dork not to understand how useful an object like this is.

items.name: Spoon
items.description: Because you stole his spoon, that poor bear has to use his fingers to eat. You're a monster.

items.name: A lump of Faded Stunted Rat
items.description: This is all that remains of the Stunted Rats from Grandfather's cellar. You certainly didn't pull any punches, did you?

items.name: Pea Seed
items.description: Nope, that's not a Mastogob Brain you're holding in your hand, it's a Pea Seed. The difference is obvious: the Pea Seed is cold to the touch.

items.name: Emmer Seed
items.description: Emmer is an ancient version of the wheat that is currently cultivated in Amakna. Anyone would think time stands still on Frigost.

items.name: Granola Seed
items.description: Once used as flour for biscuits, the cultivation of this seed was banned following a stupid bet. The former mayor of Frigost bet an Ecaflip that he would only eat one cookie made from Granola Flour. He lost the bet, and his fortune.

items.name: Pynekone Seed
items.description: This tiny seed comes from a mature Pynekone.

items.name: Lentil Seed
items.description: Placing a Lentil Seed on each of your eyelids won't make you see better, but you'll certainly look more stupid than usual if anyone sees you doing it.

items.name: Grain of Salt
items.description: Sparo wasn't worth his salt, and that's why he ended up in a barrel. Don't say you weren't warned.

items.name: Grenhayde Seed
items.description: Pull the stalk out, count to two and throw this seed as far as you can. If it lands next to an Atomystique he'll explode with rage. Young militiamen finish their Grenhayde Seed training pretty quickly.

items.name: Hay Seed
items.description: Slum-dwelling children attack civilised people with these seeds. You may be wondering how that works, but it's better not to know, really.

items.name: Basalt Seed
items.description: This seed has undergone a massive increase in temperature followed by extreme cooling, which has made it brittle and fragile.

items.name: Cole Seed
items.description: This seed has a high carbon content and when there's a full moon, it makes a strange noise. You'd have to be really stupid or a Iop to believe such nonsense.

items.name: Evil Seed
items.description: An old legend tells that the flour made from this seed was used for making the bread of Demon Steak sandwiches, favourite dish of the demon lord Rushu. Even today, Frigostians are wary of it.

items.name: Star Seed
items.description: If you like piling on the slap, and singing in the shower, this seed is for you. Eating it will have you wiggling your hips in front of a roaring crowd. Be careful, however, as its effect is very temporary.

items.name: Castor Bean
items.description: If you happen to swallow this bean, it will make that time you had the McSheth seem like a magical, unicorn blessed, rainbow filled, 8 week long summer holiday.

items.name: Vetch Seed
items.description: Vicia is a genus of about 140 species of flowering plants commonly known as vetches. It is in the legume family (Fabaceae). Among the closest living relatives of vetches are the lentils (Lens) and the true peas (Pisum). There. You'll go to sleep a little less stupid tonight.

items.name: Comic Seed
items.description: So you think you're funny, and blessed with a sense of humour that would make Oto Mustam laugh? You need to get yourself some new friends, the ones you have at the moment are totally insincere.

items.name: Fate Seed
items.description: It was written in the stars that you'd get your hands on this seed.

items.name: Pops Seed
items.description: This seed has the distinction of being made from honey. Mixed with Mimilk and served at breakfast time, it's a real treat.

items.name: Lupin Bean
items.description: Who knew you could make flour from lupin beans? I certainly didn't. You learn something new every day!

items.name: Lele Yucca
items.description: This flower was popularised by the town crier Jorg Farmboy, and all the other town criers hate him for it.

items.name: Osuction Tulip
items.description: Powdered and boiled, ingesting this tulip is recommended if you want to lose weight quickly. The disadvantage is that the weight of your wallet diminishes just as quickly.

items.name: Nelson Rose
items.description: Discovered by the famous botanist Yosef, this rose gives off the heady scent of sweaty Frighog dung, and reminds you of your most intimate moments.

items.name: Modas Mimosa
items.description: This flower casts a shadow in the shape of an Osamodas.

items.name: Ershop Rhubarb
items.description: The stems of this flavoursome rhubarb are hollow, and once appropriately arranged, produce a sound when blown into that's not unlike unaccompanied vocal music characterised by consonant four-part chords for every melody note in a predominantly homophonic texture. Or so the story goes, anyway.

items.name: Rosenberg Willow
items.description: The person who discovered this exquisite flower quickly went around proclaiming it to be the most beautiful ever discovered, and I, for one, wholeheartedly agree.

items.name: Tyler Rose
items.description: A Xelor Lord of Time discovered this beautiful flower, but was tearfully forced to part with it.

items.name: De Lima Rose
items.description: They say that this rose is blessed by the gods, something that they don't say about you.

items.name: Elboy Hellebore
items.description: The petals of this hellebore smell like dry-roasted peanuts.

items.name: Jenrel Woundwort
items.description: There was a time when chewing this flower was fashionable amongst Iop high society. They thought it made them look smart, which might have been true, if Iops were capable of thinking.

items.name: Sander Lily
items.description: The name of this flower is a tribute to Sander, the famous admiral of the Frigost fleet, who died hitting his head against the walls of the house of his rival, Al Hiartus.

items.name: Allen Lily
items.description: The pollen of this lily has the peculiar property of bringing some people out in a terrible rash, or invoking a euphoric sense of happiness in others.

items.name: Blinging Nettle
items.description: Don't be fooled by the smell or sparkling appearance of this plant, its flavour is even worse.

items.name: Mysterweed
items.description: The properties of this weed are still a mystery.

items.name: Lily of the Galley
items.description: This plant is used to decorate the kitchens of boats. It's a miracle she survived the ice age.

items.name: Ban Tamarind
items.description: This plant gives off a smell that attracts hens from miles around. Fortunately, it doesn't wake you up in the morning crowing.

items.name: Clark Petunia
items.description: When you're alone and life is making you lonely, you can always go to the pub.

items.name: Bittersweet Reseda
items.description: This plant smells wonderful and makes a delightful herbal tea, but you're not sure if it's supposed to taste sweet or sour. Curse your uncultured palate.

items.name: Royal Mastogob Wig
items.description: Well, one thing's for certain. Without his wig, the Royal Mastogob certainly loses some of his authority.

items.name: Royal Icefish
items.description: The Royal Pingwin himself used this Icefish against you. Regardless of where it came from, however, it will just end up on the barbecue like any other Icefish.

items.name: Buck Anear's Prosthesis
items.description: This may well look nothing more than a vulgar hook to you, my friend, but during the time of Buck Anear, it was considered the bleeding edge of prosthetic technology.

items.name: Staved-in Skull
items.description: As incredible as it may seem, this skull survived the ambient heat inside the Hypogeum. The same can't be said of its meeting with the Obsidemon.

items.name: Pharmaceutical Coupon
items.description: This coupon serves no purpose, pharmaceutical or not.

items.name: Ice Kama
items.description: Unable to strike new currency because of a lack of metal, Frigostians carve kamas from the ice and trade them for various local objects. This coin has no value outside of the island.

items.name: Lurgi Vaccine
items.description: This vaccine provides effective protection from the Lurgi, but its effects wear off quickly. It needs to be renewed every week.

items.name: Mastogob Blood Sample
items.description: You took this sample from a Mastogob suffering from the Lurgi.

items.name: Isotonic Seawater
items.description: Herr Peece needs this water for his research into a cure for the Lurgi.

items.name: Mugwort
items.description: This weed is well sought by alchemists, Eniripsas and Eniripsa alchemists. A plant similar to this one can be used to make a powerful liqueur popular with sailors, Enutrofs and Enutrof sailors.

items.name: The Beast Blood Sample
items.description: You went to great lengths to get this blood sample. Let's hope it was worth it.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 1am but before 4am.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 4am but before 7am.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 7am but before 10am.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 10am but before 1pm.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 1pm but before 4pm.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 4pm but before 7pm.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 7pm but before 10pm.

items.name: Meeting time
items.description: You have a meeting with Cap'n Tankerous at the inn, any time from 10pm but before 1am.

items.name: Mastogob Ticks
items.description: More resistant than a pair of Captain Chafer's Kriptonite Underpants, and more aggressive than a band of Astrubian Hunters, these ticks are a veritable nightmare for their host.

items.name: Contaminated Mastogob Blood
items.description: This blood sample was taken from a Mastogob infected with ticks.

items.name: Contaminated Mastogob Warrior Blood
items.description: This blood sample was taken from a Mastogob Warrior infected with ticks.

items.name: Contaminated Venerable Mastogob Blood
items.description: This blood sample was taken from a Venerable Mastogob infected with ticks.

items.name: Contaminated Mastogobbly Blood
items.description: This blood sample was taken from a Mastogobbly infected with ticks.

items.name: An Envelope for Otomai
items.description: Wogew the Hewmit has asked you to deliver this envelope to Otomai. It contains several useful documents on the ticks that live on Mastogobs, but also on Wabbits.

items.name: Gerard's Message
items.description:
I followed a hoary Mama Pingwin and she led me to her den, where hundreds of other Mama Pingwins were hiding. It's an opportunity not to be missed. I'm going to head inside and shoot anything that moves, there'll be enough meat for the next decade.
Gerard.

items.name: Gerard's Family Jewels
items.description: Unlike those of the Moowolf, these family jewels have neither value nor purpose.

items.name: Chief Anbifketf's Receipt
items.description: This receipt shows the date the pines were received. Show it to Gormor the Mangler to receive your pay.

items.name: Pine Trunks
items.description: Chief Anbifketf needs these trunks for the pipework heating system.

items.name: Pingwin Blubber
items.description: This thick and sticky blubber makes an excellent fuel that burns for a long, long time - which explains why Pingwins never feel the cold.

items.name: Damar's List of Supplies
items.description: This list shows the missing pieces the fishermen of the Frozen Lake need to repair their equipment.

items.name: Damar's Wedding Ring
items.description: Damar gave this ring to Valy Domidat thirty years ago.

items.name: Shredded Pingwin Skin
items.description: This Pingwin skin is in very poor condition. You won't be able to use it to make new underwear for Captain Chafer Day.

items.name: Domesticated Pingwobble Brain
items.description: While you were fighting, your Pingwobble was eaten. This is all that's left of him.

items.name: Discount Coupon
items.description: This discount will be applied when you rent a room in the upcoming ice hotel.

items.name: Old Stuffed Feca Dopple
items.description:
This old stuffed toy must belong to someone, but who?
Double-click to use.

items.name: Chewing Gum
items.description: The gum is of no use to you because your breath is too bad. On the other hand, Mac Gayver, the Xelor, will find a surprising use for it.

items.name: Family Chest
items.description:
This chest contains many heirlooms. In the absence of anyone else, you might be able to claim a reward from its owner.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Sealed Book
items.description:
This sealed book is in poor condition. Forcing it open to read its contents may make it unusable. You'd better hire a professional, but which one?
Double-click to use.

items.name: Petrified Vegetal Key
items.description:
This petrified vegetal key must be for opening a petrified vegetal door in Frigost's Petrified Forest, unless it's for something else entirely. You'll have to search the area carefully.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Resonance Crystal
items.description:
This stone, cold to the touch, vibrates constantly. What you're holding in your hands is the precious stone all Frigostian women dream about.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Mother of Pearl Brooch
items.description:
This magnificent brooch gives off the gentle fragrance of sea air. Who will you give it to?
Double-click to use.

items.name: Larva Egg
items.description:
This egg contains a larva from the Bearbarian Hive.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Ice Saw Recipe
items.description:
A swordsmith can create an ice saw using:
- Woolly Piggoth leather x 2.
- Mama Pingwin oil x 1.
- Gullipop feather x 2.
- Pingwinkle beak x 1.
- Kriptonite x 1.
- Aspen wood x 7.
- Mastogob wool x 5.
- Alabaster Dreggon claw x 1.

items.name: Steel Plate Recipe
items.description:
A miner can melt this plate with:
- 5 * Coal.
- 25 * Iron.
- 10 * Tin.
- 10 * Manganese.
- 5 * Cobalt.
- 1 * Aluminite.
- 1 * Sulphur Pouch.
- 1 * Mother of Pearl.

items.name: Protective Mask Recipe
items.description:
A tailor can make this hat with:
- 5 * Mama Pingwin Down.
- 5 * Venerable Mastogob Wool.
- 2 * Kanigloo Ears.
- 2 * Woolly Piggoth Leather.
- 2 * Pingwinkle Beaks.
- 5 * Coal.
- 5 * Iron.
- 5 * Tin.

items.name: Protective Gloves Recipe
items.description:
A Jeweller can make this ring from:
- 4 Pingwinkle Feathers.
- 2 Pingwobble Wings.
- 10 Shaman Pingwin Beard Hairs.
- 10 Sabredon Hairs.
- 2 Cromagmunk Tails.
- 4 Mastogobbly Leathers.
- 2 Crabeye Pincers.
- 10 Woolly Bow Meow Hairs.

items.name: Blueprint for a Frigostian Bamboo Drinking Trough
items.description:
This plan shows how to construct a prototype Drinking Trough from:
- 1 x Bamboo Drinking Trough
- 2 x Kung Fu Pingwin Ear
- 10 x Mama Pingwin Down
- 2 x Kanigloo Fabric
- 10 x Woolly Piggoth Leather
- 2 x Crabeye Eye
- 10 x Stunted Rat Fabric
- 2 x Frighog Baleful Eye

items.name: Blueprint for a Frigostian Bamboo Manger
items.description:
This blueprint shows how to build a prototype manger by assembling:
- 1 Bamboo Manger.
- 2 Mama Pingwin Oils.
- 10 Shaman Pingwin Beard Hairs.
- 2 Cromagmunk Acorns.
- 10 Frighog Pierced Ears.
- 2 Gullipop Beaks.
- 10 Crabeye Pincers.
- 10 Sabredon Hairs.

items.name: Blueprint for a Frigostian Bamboo Lightning Thrower
items.description:
This plan shows how to construct a prototype Lightning Thrower from:
- 1 x Bamboo Lightning Thrower
- 2 x Shaman Pingwin Giant Fishbone
- 10 x Pingwinkle Feather
- 2 x Woolly Piggoth Tusk
- 10 x Kanigloo Ear
- 2 x Woolly Bow Meow Sternum
- 10 x Gullipop Feather
- 2 x Pingwinkle Beak

items.name: Blueprint for a Frigostian Bamboo Slapper
items.description:
This plan shows how to construct a prototype Slapper from:
- 1 x Bamboo Slapper
- 2 x Pingwobble Wing
- 10 x Kung Fu Pingwin Tail
- 2 x Sabredon Tooth
- 10 x Cromagmunk Tail
- 2 x Stunted Rat Paw
- 10 x Woolly Bow Meow Hair
- 10 x Pingwobble Skin

items.name: Dose of Lurgi Vaccine
items.description: Here's a dose of vaccine against the Lurgi.

items.name: Kack Handed's Letter
items.description:
Fred, if you're reading this letter, it means I am dead. You're probably looking for my booty, so I want you to know that I will never tell you where it is hidden.
Cheers!

items.name: Syringe of Lurgi vaccine
items.description: This syringe contains a single dose of vaccine against the Lurgi, tested and certified by Kayte Mark.

items.name: Getafiks's Seed
items.description: This seed has been entrusted to you by Getafiks to repopulate the Lonesome Pine Trails.

items.name: Request for a Sleigh
items.description: This request was prepared by Djauns for a Sleigh for Snow Bow Wows. Before signing it, he reminded you to hurry because time is running out.

items.name: Intact Snowfoux Fur
items.description: Collecting this fur without damaging it was no mean feat when you take into account how badly you fought its former owner.

items.name: Crate of Equipment
items.description: This crate contains everything that Larry Tutthe needs.

items.name: Water Sample
items.description: You collected this water from the Tears of Ouronigride for Ogivol Victor.

items.name: Water Creature
items.description: You found this creature in a pool of mineral water in the Tears of Ouronigride. You'll pick anything up, won't you?

items.name: Modified Water Creature
items.description: This creature is developing right before your eyes! You'd better hurry up or it'll get so big you won't be able to carry it any more.

items.name: Snowfoux Remains
items.description: You valiantly fought the Snowfoux. These remains are proof of your victory.

items.name: Seasickness
items.description: Transforming into a ghost pirate didn't really suit you; you're definitely not a sailor. You'll feel better in 24 hours, I'm sure.

items.name: Pingwin Serum
items.description: Only educated people know the usefulness of this serum, which is why you haven't got a clue what it does.

items.name: Crystallised Gullipop Guano
items.description: If you serve your drinks "on the rocks" and use this special ice cube, they're sure to have an unrivalled flavour and freshness.

items.name: Truth Serum
items.description: Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth?

items.name: Fat Purse of Kamas
items.description: This purse contains enough kamas to help you buy a decent outfit. Given the difficulty of the job, it represents a fortune. You can't use it for anything else, sadly.

items.name: Adam costume
items.description: Worn to Captain Chafer's Panty Party, this outfit will cause envy amongst men, and especially amongst women eager to taste the forbidden fruit.

items.name: Eve costume
items.description: Worn to Captain Chafer's Panty Party, this dress will turn your suitors' heads and cause many a stiff neck. Your local physiotherapist will thank you.

items.name: Copy of the Santho family dossier
items.description:
This dossier contains a copy of the inheritance duty, property deeds and other paperwork belonging to the Santho family, which show, among other things, the purchase and the inheritance of hundreds of acres of farmland south of Bonta. The purchases are spread between the years 551 and 555. They were made possible by the immense wealth of Edmond Santho, who made his fortune by selling huge quantities of cereals of Frigostian origin.
Currently, only one field does not belong to Raymond Santho: that of Robin Marimoni.

items.name: Key to Heike Holo's Cell
items.description: The key to Heike Holo's cell.

items.name: Documents about the theft.
items.description: These documents concern the theft of cereals coming from Frigost. The Oatmenu family's boats are mentioned.

items.name: Obsidian Chisel
items.description: As sharp as Iop's sword, this chisel can be put to many uses. Do not trim your nails with it though, you could lose a finger.

items.name: Double-bladed Plane
items.description: Here's a little tip that very few people know: the chips of wood ejected by this plane make excellent Bow Meow litter.

items.name: Ski Waxing Brush
items.description: Made of Kanigloo Hair hardened in Mycos Sap, this brush is harder than Crocabulia's scales. It seems perfect for grooming the YeCh'Ti, but nobody will ever know for sure.

items.name: Aline Rose
items.description: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.

items.name: Maree Rose
items.description: This beautifully coloured, regal rose sinks when thrown into the sea. Once recovered from the sandy depths, it must be sprayed constantly with water to stop it drying out. Flowers, eh?

items.name: Long Kanigloo Hair
items.description: The hair is so long that Eniripsa children could use it as a skipping rope, although they don't really have any use for a skipping rope given that they have wings.

items.name: Mycos Sap
items.description: Gummy, sticky and stinky, this Mycos extract is completely repugnant, and yet you still can't help but dip your finger in it. Go figure.

items.name: Letter from Bea
items.description: Bea Fortax wrote this letter to her lost fiancé Al Ive, to whom she has remained faithful for more than a century.

items.name: Fight Ticket
items.description: This ticket shows when your last battle took place in the cellar of the Frigostian Paradise Tavern.

items.name: 1,000 Kama bet
items.description: This ticket shows that you'll walk off with 1,000 kamas if you win.

items.name: 2,000 Kama bet
items.description: This ticket shows that you'll walk off with 2,000 kamas if you win.

items.name: 3,000 Kama bet
items.description: This ticket shows that you'll walk off with 3,000 kamas if you win.

items.name: 4,000 Kama bet
items.description: This ticket shows that you'll walk off with 4,000 kamas if you win.

items.name: 5,000 Kama bet
items.description: This ticket shows that you'll walk off with 5,000 kamas if you win.

items.name: Frigostian Soap
items.description: This soap was once sold by Tyler Dendur, who perished in a dynamite explosion attempting to blow up Frigost Town Hall. Above all else, the Frigostians remember the magnificent fireworks that followed his death.

items.name: Letter from Tyler Dendur
items.description: This sealed letter is for one of Tyler's former disciples.

items.name: Clump of Hair
items.description: You tore this clump of hair from your enemy with your teeth.

items.name: Inventory Document
items.description: One of the inventory documents written by Nikos Mahdman, Count Harebourg's Superintendent.

items.name: Barnaby, the Dimensional Boar
items.description: This fluffy little creature is fragile but very cute. However, you saw his true nature in the other world. Never again will you laugh at young wild boar.

items.name: Frigostian Detention Papers
items.description: The crimes you committed and the date on which you were locked up are written on these papers.

items.name: A copy of the pipeline plans
items.description: This is a pretty accurate copy of the plan of the pipelines that run near Bambelle's sawmill.

items.name: Key to the Archives Room
items.description: Use this key to get into the Archives Room.

items.name: Valy Domidat's Key
items.description: This key will open Valy Domidat's wardrobe. It might also work on her chastity belt, but you don't have time to try.

items.name: Frigostine's Receipt
items.description: Frigostine gave you this receipt for the Frosteez.

items.name: Jon Burrowman's Receipt
items.description: Jon Burrowman gave you this receipt for the Snowdrops.

items.name: Clarisse Tocate's Receipt
items.description: Clarisse Tocate gave you this receipt for the Icefish.

items.name: Laurent Gebleuh's Receipt
items.description: Laurent Gebleuh gave you this receipt for the Obsidian.

items.name: Al Shab's Receipt
items.description: Al Shab gave you this receipt for the meats.

items.name: Chief Anbifketf's Receipt
items.description: Chief Anbifketf gave you this receipt for the Aspen Wood.

items.name: Aspen Crate
items.description: This crate could be used to store all kinds of things in, like medicine, tools, or your mother-in-law.

items.name: Clarisse Tocate's Basket
items.description: Clarisse Tocate prepared the contents of this basket with love for her cousins Albert Lioz and Moutou Louse.

items.name: Adult Toy
items.description: This toy has been designed to keep lonely adults busy for several hours.

items.name: Tsume-Bozu Testicles
items.description: When you fight bare legged and bare bottomed, you've got to expect to lose more than your pride if you're defeated.

items.name: Soft Oak Branch
items.description: Is this branch capable of healing or summoning? It doesn't matter, because ever since you chopped it off the Soft Oak, it's been perfect for cleaning out your neighbours' nostrils.

items.name: Trained Snow Bow Wow
items.description: This Snow Bow Wow has been trained. We don't know in what, but no one's going to ask you to worry about any of that kind of stuff anyway.

items.name: Full Aspen Crate
items.description: This crate contains all kinds of things, like medicine, tools, your mother-in-law, and even a useful book that says it's time to maybe think about giving the mother-in-law references a bit of a rest.

items.name: Royal Mastogob Blood Sample
items.description: Whether you deserve it or not, this sample belongs to you now. You should take it to Herr Peece.

items.name: Artisanal Friswein
items.description: Only connoisseurs know the difference between Artisanal Friswein and the Friswein you find in the pub. It's exactly the same with good and bad hunters.

items.name: Soviyeah Ticks
items.description: More resistant than a pair of Captain Chafer's Kriptonite Underpants and more aggressive than a band of Astrubian hunters, these ticks are a veritable nightmare for their host.

items.name: Research Funds Pledge
items.description: This pledge, signed by the mayor, certifies the amount of funds to be released for medical research. Too bad you're not a doctor.

items.name: Experimental Cereal
items.description: This cereal with unlikely effects is the result of many cross-breedings in the greenhouses of Frigost.

items.name: Experimental Plant
items.description: This plant with unlikely effects is the result of many cross-breedings in the greenhouses of Frigost.

items.name: Manuva Roots
items.description: Consuming these roots in a herbal tea allows the drinker to see the facts as they are, rather than as they should be. Some Frigostians get the same result by spending their evenings down the pub.

items.name: Mining Authorisation
items.description: This document confirms your entrance into Kit's mine.

items.name: Frozen Sample
items.description: This sample was taken from a body trapped in the ice. Herr Peece will know what to do with it.

items.name: Quadramental Breeze Potion
items.description: This potion contains a small amount of Quadramental Breeze that you cleverly captured yourself with your little handies.

items.name: Moutou Louse's Crate
items.description: Moutou Louse dropped this crate on the floor as he ran for his life.

items.name: Sulphurous Plant
items.description: This extremely rare plant is mostly made of vegetal sulphur. It is credited with such virtues to make an Osa green with envy.

items.name: Sulphurous Perfume
items.description: This perfume makes your eyes sting and even makes your hair hurt.

items.name: This Season's Frigostian Boxer Shorts
items.description: These boxer shorts are a credit to the reputation of Amaknian shoemakers. Soft, flexible and robust all at once, they are designed to stand up to any "challenge".

items.name: P.A.N.T.S. Potion
items.description:
This potion has been blessed by the P.A.N.T.S.
It leaves you strangely unaroused.

items.name: Buttercup
items.description: Wes Rob, the terrifying pirate, planted this flower in the southernmost tip of the Petrified Forest, before he died having drowned in a barrel of beer during a storm at sea.

items.name: Granny Capping's Crate
items.description: This crate belongs to one of Granny Capping's convoys. She'll be delighted to get it back.

items.name: Obsidemon's Hypogeum Secret Key
items.description:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Obsidemon's Hypogeum.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Asparah Gorge Secret Key
items.description:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Asparah Gorge.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Petrified Forest Secret Key
items.description:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Petrified Forest.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Fangs of Glass Secret Key
items.description:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Fangs of Glass.
Double-click to use.

items.name: Snowfoux Dentures
items.description: Snowfoux are much less impressive without their dentures. If you're not sure what to do with this pair, you could always give them to your Enutrof mistress as a present.

items.name: Letter of Baka Laive's Appreciation
items.description: Baka Laive gave you this letter in acknowledgement of your participation in the protection of the Snowbound Village.

items.name: Letter for Jon Burrowman
items.description: A letter written by Herr Peece, the doctor.

items.name: Letter for Asselo
items.description: A letter written by Herr Peece, the doctor.

items.name: Icy Brockhard Relic
items.description: You really don't want to know which part of the Icy Brockhard this relic comes from.

items.name: Venomous Brockhard Relic
items.description: You really don't want to know which part of the Venomous Brockhard this relic comes from.

items.name: Bestial Brockhard Relic
items.description: You really don't want to know which part of the Bestial Brockhard this relic comes from.

items.name: Pyrotechnic Brockhard Relic
items.description: You really don't want to know which part of the Pyrotechnic Brockhard this relic comes from.

items.name: Bestial Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Icy Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Venomous Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Nightcrawling Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Pyrotechnic Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Gluttonous Brockhard Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Kolosso Sample
items.description: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

items.name: Herr Peece's Cheque
items.description: This cheque should be enough for you to take a relaxing break in the Silver Tavern on Frigost.

items.name: Crate of Frozen Icefish
items.description: When you think how powerful cooked Frozen Icefish is, you'd be right in assuming that the contents of this crate cost a fortune.

items.name: Keg of Powder
items.description: Keep in a cool, dry place.

items.name: Unique Ring
items.description: This ring isn't perhaps as unique as it seems. It's your only clue for finding Herb Cut's attackers.

items.name: Pair of Rustic Skis
items.description: They might be a bit stiff, but these skis are still of the highest quality. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

items.name: Pair of Dark Skis
items.description: Dark, but gracious, these skis are almost bewitching. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

items.name: Pair of Slippery Skis
items.description: Cold to the touch, but smooth as a baby's bottom, these skis were made for speed. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit lucky.

items.name: Pair of Supple Skis
items.description: Supple like a Bwork ballerina, these skis are one of Juss's pieces, but not one of his masterpieces. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit skilful.

items.name: Gluttonous Brockhard Leather
items.description: Frigostian mothers love this leather because of its ability to repair itself, which means their children can throw themselves off a cliff or lie happily between the slavering jaws of a rabid Snowfoux without them having to worry about damaging their clothes.

items.name: Gluttonous Brockhard Blood
items.description: The Gluttonous Brockhard is capable of regenerating its flesh and its blood. What happens if you isolate its blood, though? Is a new Gluttonous Brockhard formed? If that's the case, what you have there in your grubby little paws is enough to make an entire army of clones.

items.name: Venomous Brockhard Hair
items.description: This hot hair didn't come from an otter, a botter, a knotter or a frotter. It came from a Venomous Brockhard, obviously.

items.name: Pyrotechnic Brockhard Brain
items.description: Just like the brain of a Iop, the Pyrotechnic Brockhard's brain is good for nothing. Well, it was until you picked it up.

items.name: Icy Brockhard Horn
items.description: Male Icy Brockhards only have horns to dissuade people like you from fraternising with the females.

items.name: Bestial Brockhard Muzzle
items.description: This muzzle is capable of distinguishing between a truffle and an acorn from 500m. You'd be happy if you could do the same from 3m.

items.name: Nightcrawling Brockhard Muzzle
items.description: A little-known technique for defeating a Nightcrawling Brockhard is to stick a Dofus up each of its nostrils and then walloping it on the head with a hammer.

items.name: Stretcher
items.description: This robust stretcher is waterproof and can withstand heavy loads, so you will easily be able to use it to carry, yes, you guessed it, your mother-in-law.

items.name: Asselo's Unguent
items.description: This unguent is cold and viscous, like the inside of your nostrils, only not quite as foul-smelling.

items.name: Asselo's Concoction
items.description: This surprising-looking concoction has an indescribable flavour and comes from an old recipe your senile grandmother wrote on the back of a pair of silk bloomers.

items.name: Royal Mastogob Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Royal Pingwin Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Buck Anear Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Obsidemon Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Tengu Snowfoux Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Korriander Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Kolosso Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Celestial Bearbarian Potted Meat
items.description: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

items.name: Maya's Headscarf
items.description: If the fight drags on, this will be all that remains of Maya.

items.name: Rogue Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Rogue Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Thwee Kings Coupon
items.description: Hand this coupon over to one of the Thwee Kings on Kwismas Island, and they'll give you a gift.

items.name: Kwismas Decoration
items.description: Placed on your head or draped across your shoulders, this delightful decoration will improve your appearance tenfold. Apparently Mel Chiow, one of the Thwee Kings, collects Kwismas Decorations.

items.name: Gold
items.description: This precious stone was given to you by Cas Paw, one of the Thwee Kings. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

items.name: Mywwh
items.description: This resinous gum was given to you by Balt Hasaw, one of the Thwee Kings. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

items.name: Fwankincense
items.description: This incense was given to you by one of the Thwee Kings, Mel Chiow. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

items.name: Kwismas Scroll
items.description: This scroll sticks to your skin like an Enutrof sticks to his kamas. Its magic prevents you from going back to the jails of reconciliation, but, fortunately, it disappears after 24 hours.

items.name: Tiny Heart Box
items.description: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies small children.

items.name: Little Heart Box
items.description: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies Astrubians.

items.name: Big Heart Box
items.description: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies those who regularly venture into the Blop Fields.

items.name: Enormous Heart Box
items.description: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies ordinary mortals.

items.name: Gigantic Heart Box
items.description: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies veterans of the World of Twelve.

items.name: Suspended Heart
items.description: This heart is a warning. It is what will happen to you if you don't do exactly as Cuspular from Astrub says. Luckily, he's decided to leave you alone for at least one day.

items.name: Masqueraider Doploon
items.description: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

items.name: Chrysanthemum
items.description: This flower is commonly used to brighten up gravestones and get rid of moskitos. Offered as a bouquet, the often have the same effect on mother-in-laws. Their popularity is better understood around St. Ballotwine's day.

items.name: Bleeding Rose
items.description: A distant cousin of the demonic Rose, this flower feeds off the blood of dead people and the bones of the living.

items.name: Kalamarose
items.description: The Ingalsse family used to import this flower to feed the Black Tofus until they discovered its side effects on the birds who, as well as becoming depressed, found themselves saddled with egg shells on their heads.

items.name: Rosette Flower
items.description: It was the botanist, Jeff Moshroom, who was the first to discover the secret of the Rosette Flower. He died shortly afterwards, a victim of the new song by Jon Lemon.

items.name: Gifdoploon
items.description: This coin, which you received for defeating all the temple Dopples, can be exchanged for something valuable.

items.name: Key to Isgrate Giftoyu's Chest
items.description: This key opens Isgrate Giftoyu's chest.

items.name: Alyssum
items.description: Cute and cuddly, Alyssum was the girlfriend of numerous sailors at Madrestam Harbour, which didn't particularly please Geordy, her husband. After a particularly violent dispute, he turned his wife into plant food and disappeared without leaving a trace. No one ever saw her again. Since then, though, a flower has been named after her.

items.name: Trool Stuffing
items.description: This venomous plant is used by Bworks as an accompaniment to meat served to tamed Trools. It stifles the meat's screams when the Trool eats one of its arms or legs.

items.name: Dragon's Blood
items.description: This plant owes its pale-red colour to the stagnant bodily fluids that it feeds off. It is an important part of the diet for vegetarian vampires.

items.name: Master hunter's trap
items.description: This crate contains a camouflage device made by Unterix Unter himself, as requested by Otomai's Apprentice.

items.name: Plasmogrine Bait
items.description: This bait was prepared by Otomai's Apprentice. It won't catch you any Snappers, but it should grab the attention of the Beast which is terrorising Astrub.

items.name: Box of Plasmogrine
items.description: A box of Plasmogrine. You need to give it to Otomai's Apprentice, who can be found in Astrub.

items.name: Smuggled Fairywork
items.description: Only to be used for dodgy, deeply blameworthy activities.

items.name: Juvenile Heart
items.description: The young Sauroshell who once held this organ dear was awestruck by your presence. She wanted to defend herself, but without warning she just lost heart.

items.name: Novice Heart
items.description: With this kind of trophy, everyone will see that you ride through the land stealing hearts.

items.name: Mature Heart
items.description: Malicious gossips might suggest that you have no heart, which is why you go around stealing them from others.

items.name: Venerable Heart
items.description: As venerable as your adversary might have been, he really ought to have thought twice before wearing his heart on his sleeve.

items.name: Juvenile Shplinter
items.description: Some old Enutrof women claim that if you grind this piece of Sauroshell to powder and mix it with rancid Lousy Pig grease, it'll create a rejuvenating face cream which will save them from shpinsterhood.

items.name: Novice Shplinter
items.description: As much as he tried to resist, this fragment's Sauroshell ended up shplattered everywhere.

items.name: Mature Shplinter
items.description: Sauroshells of all ages have a remarkable sense of humour. They're always ready to shplit their sides over a good joke.

items.name: Venerable Shplinter
items.description: This is proof that Sauroshell fragments only get more shplendid with time.

items.name: Used Sole
items.description: This sole's no substitute for a cheap pair of flip flops.

items.name: Charlisagen Shells
items.description: Thanks to the success of its daily shell hunt, and fearing a lack of Vulkanian shells, Charlie's Agents imported these shells, which, not unlike the summer tourists, reproduce like there's no tomorrow.

items.name: Sandka Shell
items.description: This shell was once home to one of the most regal Crabs in Vulkania.

items.name: Restla Shell
items.description: Since this crab doesn't like staying in one place for too long, a very common trick on Vulkania consists of slipping it into one of the surfer's swimming costumes.

items.name: Accio Shell
items.description: This bloodthirsty shell hates tourists and very rarely lets itself be caught. That's why it scores the highest number of points in the Shell Hunt.

items.name: Hunt Ticket
items.description: This ticket indicates the time at which you started the Shell Hunt. You have 15 minutes to collect as many shells as possible, and you'll have to wait 20 hours before you can take part in the next Hunt.

items.name: Entry ticket to Grozilla and Grasmera's Den
items.description: This ticket enables you to come back and face Grozilla and Grasmera again provided 20 hours have passed.

items.name: Hunting Ticket
items.description: This ticket tells you what time you finished the Sauroshell Search. You won't be able to take part in another Search until 20 hours have passed.

items.name: Happy Camper Medal
items.description: This medal has been awarded to you by Charlie's Agents, as recognition for the skills you have shown on Vulkania. Valid until next year, you'll need it to obtain a Madreggon. Otherwise, it'll do the trick if you want to hog the limelight at trendy parties.

items.name: Totem Erarious Head
items.description: Eh-Rehr would no doubt rather have his head on his shoulders.

items.name: Totem Erarious Body
items.description: You dug this body up in a cemetery. This kind of behaviour is usually inexcusable... but we'll let you off just this once.

items.name: Totem Erarious Left Arm
items.description: Everyone knows that Eh-Rehr only has one left arm, so it's a good thing you've found it.

items.name: Totem Erarious Right Arm
items.description: Legend has it that if you put Eh-Rehr's arms back on his body and then apply pressure in the right area, the totem will complete an extraordinarily powerful action strong enough to slice bricks in half.

items.name: Totem Erarious Left Leg
items.description: You've found a leg, which should bring you one hop closer to peace of mind.

items.name: Totem Erarious Right Leg
items.description: Don't forget this leg anywhere before finding the other pieces of the totem, or you'll be haunted forever by a limping ghost.

items.name: Totem Erarious
items.description: Eh-Rehr, whole, entire, magnificent. It's a shame he had to come apart in the first place, but at least reassembling him will earn you a ticket into the mysterious Pinki Crater.

items.name: Juvenile Tongue
items.description: This little tongue is just perfect for tickling the insides of people's ears.

items.name: Novice Tongue
items.description: This tongue is sturdy enough to poke into your nose, and scratchy enough to pull out anything undesirable from inside.

items.name: Mature Tongue
items.description: This tongue would make a charming replacement for your worn-out braces if only it didn't wriggle about when it was cut.

items.name: Venerable Tongue
items.description: This old tongue has already been in every hole you could possibly imagine, even those comdemned as immoral by Iop principles.

items.name: Caught Moumouse
items.description: This Moumouse is reasonably annoyed. It has to be said that it could end up between the claws of an evil Bow Meow.

items.name: Dekster the Bow Meow
items.description: Under his cutie kitty eyelash-batting exterior, Dekster is a total psycho who thinks nothing of slaughtering one thousand rodents a day. His favourite hobby is chasing Mimice to add them to his trophy collection.

items.name: Vulkania Pumice Stone
items.description: This porous volcanic rock has astonishing erosive properties. What's more, thanks to its low density, it also floats on water. The moral of the story is: you can occasionally use the pumice whilst washing your hands, but don't use it to go diving.

items.name: Wriggly Gumball
items.description: Often used to plug holes, Wriggly gum is also much loved by children, until they get a bit older and realise that blowing bubbles does not count as a life aim, unless you're a Snapper.

items.name: McGraff Sample
items.description: This sample was taken for the investigation. Don't spill it or urine trouble!

items.name: Hartvigg Sample
items.description: Please, please, please, please wash your hands with a pumice stone after handling this sample, especially if you're going to eat straight afterwards.

items.name: Stone Sample
items.description: How do Srams produce samples like this one? This has to be one of the universe's greatest mysteries.

items.name: Stak Sample
items.description: Do not drink under any circumstances! Drinking it would hinder you in your quest for touristic justice. And it would be gross.

items.name: Stok Sample
items.description: Stok made a weird V sign with his hand when he gave you this sample. Thinking about it makes you kind of nervous. What did it mean?

items.name: Bah Salt Crystals
items.description: In ancient times, Bah Salt Crystals were harvested by Enutrofs with sickles and white robes. They were then used to season slabs of roast Boar served during nighttime feasts.

items.name: Summer Salt Crystals
items.description: This salt bounces when it hits the ground, or the inside of your stomach. Can cause nausea.

items.name: Alyda Salt Crystals
items.description: This salt is so tasty it deserves a medal.

items.name: Ground Salt Crystals
items.description: This powder, made up of different types of salt, is what gives Plimok Soup its characteristic taste.

items.name: Broken Heart
items.description: This Sauroshell Heart was found on the beach at Tarada Bay. Its owner was probably far too sentimental.

items.name: Cryptic Message
items.description: The words scrawled on this piece of paper are completely illegible. Why did they ever abolish handwriting classes?

items.name: Vulkanian Passport
items.description: If you participate in the various activities on Vulkania, you can get your passport stamped, which would make you a Happy Camper.

items.name: Thomas Cork Card
items.description: Thomas Cork uses these cards to record the number of points you won during the Shell Hunt.

items.name: Box of Empty Phials
items.description: A box full of empty phials designed for collecting samples. This high-quality equipment is resistant to shocks, extreme temperatures and dodgy chemical experiments.

items.name: CID Conclusion - Suze McGraff
items.description: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Suze McGraff is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

items.name: CID Conclusion - Ivan Hartvigg
items.description: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Hartvigg is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

items.name: CID Conclusion - Stok
items.description: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Stok is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! That rapscallion!

items.name: CID Conclusion - Stak
items.description: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Stak is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! That rapscallion!

items.name: CID Conclusion - Tom Stone
items.description: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Tom Stone is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

items.name: Madreggon Token
items.description:
You can win these tokens by defeating Grozilla and Grasmera in their den on the island of Vulkania.
If you collect 20 of these tokens, you can take them to Dina Tapio and swap them for a Madreggon.

items.name: Tombstone
items.description: A tombstone from one of the graves in Billabone Cemetery.

items.name: Broken Tooth
items.description: This tooth once belonged in your mouth. That was until Goultard ran an evaluation of your strength.

items.name: Abrasive Corktail
items.description: It looks like a Sludgepuppy Corktail, it's the same shade of brown as a Sludgepuppy Corktail, but it isn't a Sludgepuppy Corktail. The addition of powdered pumice stone, diced Vulkanian pepper and Sauroshell Shplinter enhances this brew's taste but unfortunately makes it unsafe to drink. On the upside, it's perfect for polishing teeth and armour.

items.name: Blubasaur the Weepy Shplinter
items.description: A Shplinter to prove to Nevark the Hunter that you've defeated this island Sauroshell.

items.name: Ikthyosaur the Fishy Shplinter
items.description: A Shplinter to prove to Nevark the Hunter that you've defeated this island Sauroshell.

items.name: Prontosaur the Punctual Shplinter
