items.description: This sheet recaps all the skills developed by the recruit during the fight.

items.name: Wrapped Up Recruit's Sheet
items.description: This sheet recaps all the skills developed by the recruit during the fight.

items.name: Princely Recruit's Sheet
items.description: This sheet recaps all the skills developed by the recruit during the fight.

items.name: Chains of Life
items.description: Created by Ereziah in order to stop Shadow, these alchemic chains glint in particularly lively light. Nothing could ever break them, except for Xelor's hammer, or Jon Lemon's voice.

items.name: Rokokonut
items.description: This nut is about the same size as your head, but it seems to be full, so there's no way you'll confuse the two.

items.name: Rokokonut
items.description: This nut is about the same size as your head, but it seems to be full, so there's no way you'll confuse the two.

items.name: Rokokonut
items.description: This nut is about the same size as your head, but it seems to be full, so there's no way you'll confuse the two.

items.name: Engraved Tablet
items.description: There's a message engraved on this stone slab: "Once you've poisoned Jowkinson, go to the fountain Madrestam. You'll get rest of promised money." You're not sure the author is a native speaker of the Amaknian language. Close, but no cigar.

items.name: Strange Compass
items.description:
As you wandered back and forth across the Kanigs' territory, you stumbled upon this curious object on the ground. It looks like a compass, and it vibrates with an unknown energy when you hold it in your hand.
(Double-click to use the compass.)

items.name: Globule of Clingy Blop
items.description: This useless blob is even stickier than Captain Haddock'n'roll's legendary plaster.

items.name: IOU
items.description: The Bontarian in distress has promised you a reward if you help her get back to the White City safe and sound.

items.name: Plissken in a Can
items.description: You use an old Kaniger can to trap a freshly captured Plissken. You desperately want to take it home and give it to your mother-in-law, but this Plissken is destined for other, sadly less hilarious, things.

items.name: Tarmite Larva
items.description: The Tarmite is a real scourge. It digs tunnels through the soil, gnaws at wood and chews away at the fibres in clothes. It's famous among the Kanigs as a 'love-it-or-hate-it' foodstuff, and the thought of this one drowning in stomach acid doesn't bother you at all.

items.name: Kanig Rope
items.description: This rope is long and sturdy enough to tie up all the guests at your wedding like sausages and hang them up between two trees. Too bad nobody ever comes to your parties.

items.name: Empty Flask
items.description: This flask was given to you so you could collect Slave Juice with it. Oh, and just for info, that weird stuff you do at home with a hood over your head does not make you eligible to fill it.

items.name: Slave Juice
items.description: You're the only one who knows where the suspicious-looking liquid in this flask actually came from. Ask yourself this: would you drink some of it, if you were dying of thirst?

items.name: Concoction Sample
items.description:
In the end, you'd probably have been better off drinking the slave juice whilst it was still pure.
(DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE.)

items.name: Test Concoction Sample
items.description:
In the end, you'd probably have been better off drinking the slave juice whilst it was still pure.
(DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE.)

items.name: Kanig Alchemical Concoction
items.description: Your short-lived career as a guinea-pig was a great success, despite a few bothersome side effects.

items.name: Letter from Scam Jaxon
items.description: This letter is addressed to San Lavalss, steward at Amakna Castle. That means you can't open it, you nosy parker.

items.name: Stontusk Bone
items.description: You picked this bone up in Stontusk Desert, but judging by the shape and size of it, it didn't come from a Kanig.

items.name: Rigging
items.description: This worn rope appears to have done several years' hard service out at sea. Unless the bad condition and acrid smell are due to the Kanig urine it's been lying in, that is.

items.name: Log of Wood
items.description: Putting up a fence, lighting a bonfire, fixing that hole in the door your mate Johnny made by accident: with a log like this, you're one step closer to actually fulfilling your New Year's resolutions.

items.name: Rubble
items.description: Too soft to make resistant false teeth, bits of this rubble are crushed into powder and then mixed with water before being used to fill up baby Kanigs' bottles.

items.name: Deteriorated Utensils
items.description: This chest contains several utensils that have seen better days. The gentle hand of a compassionate sculptor will help them be useful again.

items.name: Worn Skin
items.description: As old and frail as your grandma, and as flaky and stinky as your grandpa, this skin is of no use to anyone.

items.name: Melted Candle
items.description: This candle has pretty much melted into nothingness, much like your New Year's resolutions.

items.name: Kanig Pubic Hairs
items.description: These foul-smelling hairs make pretty good bait for fishing. They're enough to make Trout pout and Grawns grin.

items.name: Kanig Hammer
items.description: Originally designed to break rock, this hammer also breaks bones and who knows what else.

items.name: Ripley Scott's Doll
items.description: This bewitched doll is worth its weight in peanuts. Go and see the Bworks and you'll be the most popular visitor in the village.

items.name: Kanig Axe
items.description: This axe was specially designed to send Morfoxen, a horrible Shushu with disgusting table manners, back to the Shustuft Crust where he belongs. Against other opponents, all it'll do is chop their legs and arms off.

items.name: Orichor
items.description: This divine resource is highly sought after by the Dimensional Voyagers. Exchange it with the collectors for rewards that'll make you jump for joy... Or jump clean into other dimensions!

items.name: Orichometre
items.description: This device is no good for predicting the weather, heating up leftovers or taking the temperature in your armpit, but it can measure the Orichor levels in a given area.

items.name: Beacon Detector
items.description:
This detector reacts to signals emitted by the technomagical beacon that Agent Agoo carries everywhere.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Experimental Holodater
items.description: You may as well know right away: this holodater is not capable of remembering your sweetheart's birthday for you. Avoid the yearly tantrum by getting the date tattooed on your hand or buying an agenda at the 99 kama shop.

items.name: Enutough Blood Sample
items.description: You know an Enutough's got high quality experimentation blood when you grab his kama pouch and he goes bright red with rage in under a second flat.

items.name: Blablage's Portable Calculator
items.description: A miniature version of the machine that made Ada Blablage's fortune, this calculator puts two and two together and gets four, which is more than you can do.

items.name: Gold Watch
items.description: Every time you hold this watch in your hand, old-fashioned music plays in your head... and you feel the desperate urge to take revenge on someone, anyone! Have you thought about seeing a specialist?

items.name: Kama Conformity Tester
items.description: This magical magnifying glass won't help you find your true purpose in life, but it will help you tell the difference between forgeries and the real deal.

items.name: Purse of Fake Kamas
items.description: To tell a fake kama from a real kama, all you need to do is give it to the head of your city's militia. If you're condemned to death by slow boiling in a cauldron on the main square, it was a fake kama.

items.name: Test Reports
items.description: You used this sheet to note down the results of a nugget chucker test performed on a Drheller.

items.name: King Nidas's Nose Hair
items.description: This nose hair would be worth its weight in gold if only it wasn't coated in all manner of malevolent airborne bacteria.

items.name: King Nidas's Seal
items.description: Show Leonard this seal for a one-way pass to see King Nidas. Did I say one-way? Forget that. You'll be fine.

items.name: Drheller Tusk
items.description: Now you've chased away those good-for-nothing Poachers, take the tusks you confiscated to Dhyan Fossi. She'll make sure the bitter trophies are reduced to dust.

items.name: Sweat Atomiser
items.description: This little flask is filled with concentrated Prespic sweat. In case you're tempted to spray it around your home, remember this: just because it's in a pretty bottle, doesn't mean it smells good. At all.

items.name: Piece of Scrap Metal
items.description: You picked up this piece after resisting a Strongboxer attack. Short of making yet another handicraft necklace, you don't really know what to do with it.

items.name: Bit of Strongboxer
items.description: All alone, this bit of Strongboxer is about as useful as a lone novice looking for a team with whom to eradicate the vermin of Frigost Village.

items.name: Recycled Bit of Strongboxer
items.description: Unlike lone novices looking for veterans to escort them through the Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse, this bit of Strongboxer will actually be good for something!

items.name: Hunk of Meat
items.description: You sliced off this hunk of meat in a bloodthirsty rage after resisting a Drheller attack, but now you've regained your composure. Short of making yet another handicraft necklace, you don't really know what to do with it.

items.name: Voyager Pack
items.description: This pack contains basic expedition material for a Dimension Voyager: first-aid kit, explosives, traps, survival rations, tent, spare undies, lipstick. Contents vary from pack to pack.

items.name: Voyager Pack
items.description: This pack contains basic expedition material for a Dimension Voyager: first-aid kit, explosives, traps, survival rations, tent, spare undies, lipstick. Contents vary from pack to pack.

items.name: Voyager Pack
items.description: This pack contains basic expedition material for a Dimension Voyager: first-aid kit, explosives, traps, survival rations, tent, spare undies, lipstick. Contents vary from pack to pack.

items.name: Voyager Pack
items.description: This pack contains basic expedition material for a Dimension Voyager: first-aid kit, explosives, traps, survival rations, tent, spare undies, lipstick. Contents vary from pack to pack.

items.name: Blinding Drheller Trap
items.description:
This trap is used to keep Drhellers away without injuring them. At least, that's what you think, you naive sucker.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Enutough Ring
items.description: You fished this ring out of an Enutough's crusty pants. Short of making yet another handicraft necklace, you have no idea what to do with it.

items.name: Enutough Toolbag
items.description: This toolbag contains all the tools an Enutough might need in an awkward situation.

items.name: Strongboxer Whistle
items.description: This whistle can be used to call a Strongboxer. At least, that's what Professor Maximilio is hoping. Why don't you try it out?

items.name: Kamanbair
items.description: Crafted using only the finest armpit gunk, then left to mature in a vat of molten toe jam, this cheese is used in the vast majority of Enutough cuisine.

items.name: Hot Meal
items.description: You don't know what's in this dish, but your stomach doesn't care: it's gurgling like a baby Trool at the very thought of taking a bite.

items.name: Aggressive Perfidhius Eye
items.description: Perfidhius are basically evolved Digshots: their love for fighting has left them somewhat tattered and torn, but their reflexes are sharpened to perfection. This eye has borne witness to many a bloody battle.

items.name: Golden Waffle
items.description: This type of waffle is a huge success in Astrub and can be bought plain, with cobalt sprinkles or drenched in melted copper. Yum!

items.name: Blue Pill Sample
items.description: This sample would be a godsend for you. Unfortunately, it's for someone else.

items.name: Fertilised Cross Strich Egg
items.description: Ever since you started lugging this egg around in your bag, you've had the surprisingly motherly feeling that you're about to hatch something. Let's hope it's a plot and not some mad half-human, half-Strich baby.

items.name: Scarlet Jewel
items.description: When you take this jewel in your hand, a feeling of warmth, peace and tolerance spreads through you. Quite the opposite of what happens when your grandparents come round.

items.name: Incendiary Drheller Trap
items.description:
This trap is used to keep Drhellers away without injuring them. At least, that's what you think, you naive sucker.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Poisonous Drheller Trap
items.description:
This trap is used to keep Drhellers away without injuring them. At least, that's what you think, you naive sucker.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Antenna from a Lone Strongboxer
items.description: This antenna is in too bad a state to be used for anything, except perhaps picking your nose.

items.name: Horn from a Strongboxer in a Small Group
items.description: This horn is in too bad a state to be used for anything, except perhaps picking your ears.

items.name: Tongue from a Strongboxer in a Line
items.description: This tongue is in too bad a state to be used for anything, except perhaps sticking stamps.

items.name: Short-Sighted Enutough Eyebrow
items.description: I'm going to say what everyone's thinking: this eyebrow is of no use to you whatsoever. You have enough as it is.

items.name: Training Sheet
items.description: Skale has given you this sheet to help you train the recruit, according to various parameters, in combat.

items.name: Training Sheet
items.description: Skale has given you this sheet to help you train the recruit, according to various parameters, in combat.

items.name: Training Sheet
items.description: Skale has given you this sheet to help you train the recruit, according to various parameters, in combat.

items.name: Auriferous Nugget
items.description: This nugget makes your eyes shine and your heart beat faster... But if you want more, you're going to have to slaughter even more Drhellers.

items.name: Scraped Kamasterisk Horn
items.description: Only an Enutrof would think up the idea of fighting with gold-plated horns. But you have to hand it to him: the result is almost terrifying as the Bearendizer during a honey shortage.

items.name: Skimflin Flammer's Pouch
items.description:
This pouch of kamas should cover Skimflin Flammer's debt. Though, come to think of it, it's really light...
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Recalcitrant Strongboxer Tongue
items.description: This tongue is as useless as you are.

items.name: Old Map of Enurado
items.description: You don't mean to boast, but you're kind of a map expert, and it doesn't take you long to realise that this is a map detailing the depths of Enurado. There are several secret passageways marked on it, as well as what you believe is either a prison or a zombie zoo, judging by the skull and bars symbol next to it. The Alloyance seal is still visible on the map, even though most of it has been scratched off.

items.name: Crate of Bits of Strongboxer
items.description: This crate is filled with bits of Strongboxers, improved, enchanted and ready to assemble.

items.name: Piece of Old Hurtful Locker
items.description: Even your great-grandparents look like spring chickens in comparison to this bit of Strongboxer. You reckon it'll do nicely for building the tracker.

items.name: Piece of Old Strongboxer
items.description: Even your great-grandparents look like spring chickens in comparison to this bit of Strongboxer. You reckon it'll do nicely for building the tracker.

items.name: Piece of Old Precious
items.description: Even your great-grandparents look like spring chickens in comparison to this bit of Strongboxer. You reckon it'll do nicely for building the tracker.

items.name: Piece of Old Antrezure
items.description: Even your great-grandparents look like spring chickens in comparison to this bit of Strongboxer. You reckon it'll do nicely for building the tracker.

items.name: Piece of Old Brutatax
items.description: Even your great-grandparents look like spring chickens in comparison to this bit of Strongboxer. You reckon it'll do nicely for building the tracker.

items.name: Enchanted Ruby
items.description: Selling this enchanted gemstone would rake in enough for you to buy the Lakeside Palace and still have kamas left over. You resolve to use it for building the tracker.

items.name: Enchanted Garnet
items.description: Selling this enchanted gemstone would rake in enough for you to buy the Lakeside Palace and still have kamas left over. You resolve to use it for building the tracker.

items.name: Enchanted Topaz
items.description: Selling this enchanted gemstone would rake in enough for you to buy the Lakeside Palace and still have kamas left over. You resolve to use it for building the tracker.

items.name: Enchanted Sapphire
items.description: Selling this enchanted gemstone would rake in enough for you to buy the Lakeside Palace and still have kamas left over. You resolve to use it for building the tracker.

items.name: Enchanted Emerald
items.description: Selling this enchanted gemstone would rake in enough for you to buy the Lakeside Palace and still have kamas left over. You resolve to use it for building the tracker.

items.name: Synthetic Staruman Hair
items.description: They're scratchy, they're ugly, they cause skin diseases and they're not biodegradable. What were the Starumen thinking?!

items.name: Wood Glue
items.description: Good old wood glue, just like you can find in any workshop in Amakna. What? You've never used wood glue? You've never lived, my friend!

items.name: Sulphur Powder
items.description: This powdery foodstuff is at the root of so many methane suffocation cases that it's a wonder it's considered a foodstuff at all! It's illegal now, thankfully.

items.name: Disgusting Bucket
items.description: This bucket is full of stinky metabolic waste collected in the Auriferous Quarry.

items.name: Disgusting Stain
items.description: With this disgusting stain on your clothes, you don't even need to try out for the Dung Beetles tribute band - you're in!

items.name: Disgusting Substance
items.description: Toilet humour is out, according to Scatman Kopperfaige, so you can't even use this pile of poop for a poorly written comedy sketch.

items.name: Tate Wadd's Inconsequential Purse
items.description: This pouch contains about enough kamas to buy a gigantic house in Bonta.

items.name: Tate Wadd's Titchy Purse
items.description: This pouch contains about enough kamas to buy a paddock in the Cania Plains.

items.name: Tate Wadd's Small Purse
items.description: This pouch contains about enough kamas to buy a manor on Frigost Island.

items.name: Tate Wadd's Lightweight Purse
items.description: This pouch contains about enough kamas to buy Amakna Castle.

items.name: Tate Wadd's Modest Purse
items.description: This pouch contains about enough kamas to buy the city of Sufokia.

items.name: Sparkling Ruby
items.description: This ruby is as big as your fist and shinier than a freshly polished Enutrof head.

items.name: Blue Crystal
items.description: A piece of blue crystal which is no good at all if you like neither blue nor crystals.

items.name: Golden Nugget
items.description: Here's a contaminated nugget that's likely to give anyone it touches the dreaded gold fever...

items.name: Bag
items.description: This bag is the most non-descript thing you own. For once, there's not even anything worth mentioning about the way it smells.

items.name: Toxic Necrotick Juice
items.description: This liquid is less sweet and quite a bit more corrosive than orange juice. Also, it bubbles. Srambad assassins love it.

items.name: Enutough Ingot
items.description: This ingot must be worth a small fortune, but it's not yours, so stop looking so greedy.

items.name: Vil Smisse's Glove
items.description: The chief of the Smisse clan gave you his glove so that his allies would welcome you with open arms, instead of sharp blades.

items.name: Inky Spot
items.description: Thankfully for your clothes, these spots can be washed out with Gobball Slobber.

items.name: Bag of kamas
items.description: This bag contains a lot of kamas.

items.name: Bag of kamas
items.description: This bag contains a lot of kamas.

items.name: Bag of kamas
items.description: This bag contains a lot of kamas.

items.name: Message from Frank Lee Smisse
items.description: This envelope contains a coded message not meant for you. Rein in your curiosity – it'd be a shame for your skull to be stacked up in the Catacumbras over a silly piece of paper.

items.name: Doctor Jako's Krosmoglob Signal
items.description: Use this item to summon Doctor Jako Djiyn's Krosmoglob.

items.name: Trechepeira Gwey Meat
items.description: This meat is pretty appetising as long as you don't think about what the Trechepeira Gwey eats.

items.name: Agent Cretsee's Documents
items.description: These confidential documents are extremely important to the Order Errant.

items.name: Mama Fia Signal
items.description: This ring is worn by those Mama Fia trusts.

items.name: Defective Krosmoglob Signal
items.description: Use this item to summon a defective Krosmoglob.

items.name: Fula Bulony's Doll
items.description: This doll is pretty unique. Since it was intended as a public warning, it shouldn't really be in the arms of a child.

items.name: Millimaster Disguise
items.description: This disguise will allow you to pass, unnoticed, through the ranks of the Malitiamen.

items.name: Healthy Scoliopode Sample
items.description: Drinking this Scoliopode sample guarantees excruciating suffering and slow death.

items.name: Healthy Trechepeira Sample
items.description: Drinking this sample will let you see the world through the eyes of a Sram. And if you're already a Sram, you'll grow extra eyes.

items.name: Healthy Sculucanus Sample
items.description: If you drink this sample, you'll never be pure of spirit again.

items.name: Healthy Amorphid Sample
items.description: A single drop of this sample in your stomach will turn your little paunch into a big balloon.

items.name: Scoliopode Egg Sample
items.description: Be careful not to sit on this syringe. Your behind would become parent to a whole brood of Scoliopode larva.

items.name: Trechepeira Egg Sample
items.description: Be careful not to sit on this syringe. Your behind would become parent to a whole brood of Trechepeira larva.

items.name: Sculucanus Egg Sample
items.description: Be careful not to sit on this syringe. Your behind would become parent to a whole brood of Sculucanus larva.

items.name: Amorphid Egg Sample
items.description: Be careful not to sit on this syringe. Your behind would become parent to a whole brood of Amorphid larva.

items.name: Sweet Potatoes
items.description: In Srambad, sweetness is punishable by imprisonment. That's why these potatoes are in the dungeon.

items.name: Gizmond Quelyn's Eidolonic Generator
items.description: This generator is a little miracle of dimensional technomagic. As for figuring out whether it's working correctly, well, you might have to take your best guess.

items.name: Aggressive Necrotick Sample
items.description: It'd be best if you didn't taste it – you're aggressive enough as it is.

items.name: Package for Kathy Brennan
items.description: Curiosity pushes you to open the box and find out what's inside, but good sense prevails, and you leave the package intact.

items.name: Toxoliath Gastric Juice
items.description: This fluid is capable of dissolving almost anything: your pet, your father-in-law, or even an anvil.

items.name: Skull Bracelet
items.description: These miniaturized skulls belonged to Astrubians executed by order of Sram's Herald for trying to ransack their chests of gold.

items.name: Marie Jeannette's Ticket
items.description: This ticket smells like pleasant perfume and the promise of a swinging good time.

items.name: Rotten Meat
items.description: You're asking yourself not only how this piece of rotten meat got into your pocket, but also why you didn't notice it sooner. The answer to one of those questions might have to do with your own strong odour.

items.name: Detention Slip
items.description: This ticket proves to the jailer that you are indeed one of his prisoners.

items.name: BoMeoMo Beer
items.description: This beer, specific to Srambad and impossible to find anywhere else, owes its flavour to the ingredients used to make it.

items.name: Doctor Deal Linger's Empty Flask
items.description:
Doctor Deal Linger has given you this flask to use when you take a sample of the murky water in the Catacumbras.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Flask Filled With Murky Water
items.description: This water doesn't seem potable.

items.name: Bag of Contraband
items.description: It may look like a bag of grains, but it actually contains contraband from other dimensions.

items.name: Jack the Whipper's Head
items.description: Out of habit, you put the head in a box in order to not draw attention. Except, in Srambad, you should proudly display the head if you want to avoid suspicious glances.

items.name: Woven Shadow
items.description: In putting on this shadow, you'll become one with the darkness. You're beginning to understand why this item is so prized by thieves and assassins.

items.name: Sauroshell Serum
items.description: According to Doctor B'boing, this serum will be very effective against depression. However, the Sauroshells are particularly depressed to see you. They must know this is going to be painful.

items.name: Dragon Blood
items.description: As everyone knows, most dragons are particularly stingy. They never agree to give their blood the first time 'round. How arrogant.

items.name: Orch Wax
items.description: This wax doubtlessly helped the Orch Assassin to carry out his attack near Pat Tzumeesee without falling into the void.

items.name: Maridoo's Ribs
items.description: Maridoo's Ribs taste like Lousy Pig Ribs, just milder.

items.name: Juan Toutou's Envelope
items.description: This envelope is for the Srambad militia.

items.name: Sack Improbability Powder
items.description: No one can predict what will happen when this powder is used.

items.name: Sack of Dirty Money
items.description: You've never seen such filth. By comparison, your bedroom is spotless.

items.name: Pit-Viper's Broken Mirror
items.description: Who cares about seven years of bad luck? The important thing here is that you won the fight and weren't kicked out of Srambad.

items.name: Nogud Tooth
items.description: This tooth is no good. It's not even worth a single kama.

items.name: Crate of Clothes
items.description: A bunch of striking garments which can only improve your appearance.

items.name: Bag of kamas for Collector Por
items.description: This bag is as heavy as your brother-in-law.

items.name: Cosmetics Sphere
items.description: A real pioneer in his field, Jobat Kosm has invented this sphere to make it easier to transport and mix cosmetics.

items.name: Burglar's Scrunchie
items.description: It seems that the Double's scrunchie is slightly different from her double's, but no one has ever really been able to tell the difference.

items.name: Nogud Tooth
items.description: This tooth is no good. It's not even worth a single kama.

items.name: Nogud Tooth
items.description: This tooth is no good. It's not even worth a single kama.

items.name: Stolen Explosives
items.description:
This crate should be handled with care.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Juan Toutou's Cargo
items.description: What is this mysterious cargo you're transporting?

items.name: Dominous Mask
items.description: The Dominous has no concept of subtlety and his mask fits him perfectly. His role: crush his enemies as quickly as possible. You might say Shadow was inspired by Iopswhen he created Dominous.

items.name: Nightfoul Mask
items.description: The Nightfoul is a very peculiar type of shadow: quick and agile, no sooner can you spot it than it's disappeared.

items.name: Mirefly Mask
items.description: Shadow has a fascination with the void and nonexistence. Whether you see the glass as half full or half empty, Shadow's not happy until it's completely empty. In the end, maybe you're more like him than you imagine.

items.name: Panterror Mask
items.description: Revenge is a dish best served cold, something that Shadow understands quite well: hidden in his underground lair, he's been preparing his plan to reduce the World of Twelve to nothingness. The Panterror is part of that plan. It's capable of finding the smallest corner of shadow where it can rest, forgotten, until it delivers the fatal blow.

items.name: Dark Stone
items.description:
Combined with the Obscurati masks, this stone has the power to temporarily clothe its bearer in shadows.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Lenny the Lenald Hairs
items.description: You won this trophy by fighting the terrible Lenny. Now, you just need to get rid of it. Let's face it, there's not really a spot for it on your mantel.

items.name: El Troolito Mane
items.description: The odour coming from this mane is strong enough that it might follow you for the rest of your life. You don't deserve that.

items.name: Arden the Giant's Briefs
items.description: Maybe you could have found a use for these briefs, but they take far too much room in your sack. Better part with them first chance you get.

items.name: El Rumo's Briefs
items.description: It wouldn't be too pleasant to have your face pressed into these pants – they could knock anyone out.

items.name: Agent Dirk T. Rick's Krosmoglob Signal
items.description: This object allows you to call Agent Snair from a distance.

items.name: Butcher's Shoulder Pad
items.description: This spike-encrusted shoulder pad is essential in the education of young Bworks, especially when they've trouble hearing – just because they're hard of hearing doesn't mean they're hardened by life.

items.name: Notes for Dor Lingster
items.description: This book is for recording the stories of Srambad's talking skulls. It can be placed in a Krosmoglob with no risk of explosion.

items.name: Moldy Funeral Ashes
items.description: These ashes reek of death.

items.name: Slimy Funeral Ashes
items.description: These ashes reek of death.

items.name: Stringy Funeral Ashes
items.description: These ashes reek of death.

items.name: Moist Funeral Ashes
items.description: These ashes reek of death.

items.name: Crumbly Bone
items.description: This bone is ideal for making flour which can then be used to feed herbivores in order to make them completely insane.

items.name: Rubbery Bone
items.description: This bone is usually used by rascals to play pranks on thieves.

items.name: Chewed Bone
items.description: The Necroticks use these bones as chewing gum.

items.name: Spectral Elixir
items.description: According to the rumours, this elixir brings a curse with it. You're not in a rush to find out.

items.name: Ephemeral Daggers
items.description: As their name might suggest, these daggers are bewitched to disappear after a short time.

items.name: Doctor Deal Linger's Empty Flask
items.description:
Doctor Deal Linger has given you this flask to use when you take a sample of the murky water in the Catacumbras.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Toxic Waste
items.description: No, these aren't the leftovers from the last time you tried to cook. They're pretty similar though.

items.name: Toxic Waste
items.description: Even if there are some strong similarities to your most recent conquest, there's no relation.

items.name: Toxic Waste
items.description: You've just found the missing ingredient for the cake you were making for in-laws' anniversary.

items.name: Sacred Icefish
items.description: You're already salivating at the idea of the great meal you could prepare with these Icefish.

items.name: Sacred Meat
items.description: What's so sacred about it?

items.name: Sacred Fertiliser
items.description: No use putting it on your head. It may be sacred, but it still only makes plants grow.

items.name: Sacred Honey
items.description: Less sugary than Bronzed Liquid Honey, it's no less sacred.

items.name: Protoz'orror Protuber
items.description: It looks like a local specialty that was served to you on the Sea Chafer.

items.name: Appy Plant
items.description: This deliciously formed plant was created by Nileza when he was bored during a long winter night.

items.name: Herbuss
items.description: Note: this herb will not make you fly. Whether it makes you feel like you're flying might be a different story.

items.name: Nina Scharp's Inoculator
items.description: If the contents of this syringe will work on a whale, just think what it would do for you! No more dorsal pain from taking too many hits in the tail!

items.name: Viring Kroboplasm
items.description: Nina Scharp asked you to bring her back some Viring Kroboplasm. Let's hope you don't throw up.

items.name: Bacterrible Kroboplasm
items.description: Nina Scharp has asked you to bring her back some Bacterrible Kroboplasm. Don't forget to wash your hands after getting the samples.

items.name: Verminoculate Kroboplasm
items.description: Nina Scharp has asked you to bring her back some Verminoculate Kroboplasm. Cross your fingers you don't get a cold while getting the sample.

items.name: Bashillus Kroboplasm
items.description: Nina Scharp has asked you to bring her back some Bashillus Kroboplasm. She must have heard about your famous bedside manner.

items.name: Kroboplasm Syringe
items.description: Seeing how much liquid this instrument can contain, it's unlikely a subject would survive the sample-taking process. But the advancement of science is worth a couple sacrifices, isn't it? Well, it probably depends which side of the needle you're on.

items.name: Experimental Solution
items.description:
A little notice is engraved on the side: "For each problem, a solution!". Well that's reassuring, isn't it?
Now you just need to find an isolated krobe to test it on.

items.name: Experimental Solution
items.description:
A little notice is engraved on the side: "For each problem, a solution!". Well that's reassuring, isn't it?
Now you just need to find an isolated krobe to test it on.

A little notice is engraved on the side: "For each problem, a solution!". Well that's reassuring, isn't it?

items.name: Piece of Time
items.description: It is said that this strange object allows us to fulfil all the tasks that we're always putting off until later. Some people badmouth it, pointing out that even with all the time in the world, we wouldn't do anything useful. Who knows?

items.name: Orange Krosmorb
items.description: The Altdemons aren't really known for their intelligence, which is probably why they steal Krosmorbs. Who wouldn't get a few bright ideas looking at this beaut?

items.name: Green Krosmorb
items.description: Colonel O'Whel has given you the green light to go and get the stolen Krosmorbs back. Watch your backs, Altdemons!

items.name: Crimson Krosmorb
items.description: Maybe the monster that stole this orb thought it was a Dofus. After all, who's stupider than a demon? Don't bother replying, it was a rhetorical question... The real answer might upset you.

items.name: Broken Miniature Sandglass
items.description: This sandglass is a symbol of passing time. You can't help but wonder if there isn't more than meets the eye with this thing...

items.name: Nick Utter's Bracelet
items.description: Placed around the limb of an anachronistic creature, this bracelet will send it back to its own time, quick as a flash.

items.name: Giant Soap Recipe
items.description: To create a Giant Soap Bar of your own, you're going to need a Demonic Rose Petal, some Wild Sunflower Oil and a Kokokonut.

items.name: Giant Soap Bar
items.description: You weren't feeling very inspired when you made this, so you decided to base the design on that of good old Frigostian Soap.

items.name: Tuft of Siks-T Hair
items.description: This tuft of hair is absolutely priceless. Maybe you'll find out how Siks-T manages to keep it in such good condition, no matter what hardships he may face.

items.name: Doc's Toolbox
items.description: This box contains a load of tools as varied and mismatched as your thoughts during your final exams.

items.name: Damaged Technomagical Part
items.description: This part has good reasons for not working properly... unlike you when you're in bed with your sweetheart.

items.name: Wakstrel Feather
items.description: Wakstrels sometimes use these surprisingly sharp feathers as projectiles, but their most common use is as torture instruments. Bare feet of the world, beware.

items.name: Piece of Coralator
items.description: After your triumph over those meddling Coralators, you ended up with this trinket in your hand. What are you going to do with it? Probably nothing.

items.name: Flask of Lubricant
items.description: According to Gizmond Quelyn, Doctor B'boing urgently needs this flask. Is it for work or for... you know, something else? You'd rather not know.

items.name: Unstable Orichor
items.description: You've heard that Osamodas sprinkles his cereal with a little Unstable Orichor every morning, to give him a sparkling kickstart to the day.

items.name: Selective Orichometre
items.description: According to Vertime the Collector, this device should help you track down some Unstable Orichor. Follow its directions and see if you don't find what you're looking for.

items.name: Dead Xelomorph Pixel
items.description: A Xelomorph chucked one of its useless pixels straight at your head just before it attacked you... and all because you opened one of Xelorium's chests. Where do these monsters get off, huh?

items.name: Dead Xelomorph Pixel
items.description: A Xelomorph chucked one of its useless pixels straight at your head just before it attacked you... and all because you opened one of Xelorium's chests. Where do these monsters get off, huh?

items.name: Minute from Xelorium
items.description: With this item in your bag, you have no excuse when someone asks you if you have a minute.

items.name: Chronanomaly Powder
items.description: Avoid using this powder for anything at all. You wouldn't want to get stuck in an endless time loop, would you? Would you? Would you?

items.name: Paxtim Eggs
items.description: Paxtim Eggs will only develop if they are kept somewhere warm and moist. Since their mother appears not to have known this, it's quite easy to find unhatched ones along the Gonebyways.

items.name: Sonic Screwdriver
items.description: Doctor Hoo has stored this Sonic Screwdriver in a well-padded case to make sure it's protected from bumpy temporal rides - and to prevent it from switching itself on by accident.

items.name: Bag of Spare Parts
items.description: If you imprisoned a Foggernaut in this bag, they'd probably be as happy as Larry tinkering away with its contents.

items.name: Legendary Blade
items.description: This blade possesses legendary powers and serves as the link between all the eras in which true heroes have lived.

items.name: Portable Detector
items.description: You don't really know how this device works, but at least you know how to switch it on, which is quite an achievement for someone like you.

items.name: Chronanomaly Powder
items.description: Avoid using this powder for anything at all. You wouldn't want to get stuck in an endless time loop, would you? Would you? Would you?

items.name: Fragment of a Xelomorph's Memory
items.description: You've already forgotten what this is for.

items.name: Master of Zaaps Powder
items.description: If the Master of Zaaps reports you for foul play, the traces of temporal powder kicking about in your bag will be all the evidence he needs. Get rid of them ASAP.

items.name: Eternal Battery
items.description: If this battery was slotted into a Wabbit drummer, that crazy fluffball would probably be tapping out his beat until the end of time.

items.name: Fragment of Fraktal's Memory
items.description: This time, you haven't forgotten what this is for.

items.name: Bag of Materials
items.description: The bits and bobs in this bag are all of the highest quality... which is more than can be said for your false teeth.

items.name: Cube Detector
items.description: This device can be used to detect anomalies generated by destructive cubes' camouflage fields.

items.name: Altdemon Tooth
items.description: Only one thing can be said for sure of this off-white gnasher: it is definitely not a wisdom tooth. So there's no point keeping it in your pocket.

items.name: Ephemulberry Leaves
items.description: These leaves wilt extremely quickly, so if you were planning to use them for a salad, you'd better get a move on.

items.name: Silk of Time Thread
items.description: This thread is surprisingly resistant given how fine it is. Next time your life is hanging by a thread, you'd better hope to your god that it's this kind.

items.name: Wood Crystal
items.description: This piece of wood, which is nothing like amber at all, has survived entire ages and is packed with temporal energy.

items.name: Temporal Flame
items.description: This flame releases no heat, and burns slowly, ever so slowly...

items.name: Tracker of Creatures from Other Times
items.description:
This tracker analyses disruptions caused by creatures from other times, allowing you to trace them.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Altdemon Loincloth
items.description: Search hard enough, and you might just find a use for this vile scrap of fabric. You can't bear to throw it away: it has come to represent your own final shred of decency.

items.name: Tracker of Creatures from Other Times
items.description: This tracker analyses disruptions caused by creatures from other times, allowing you to trace them.

items.name: Temporal Expeller
items.description: This device is able to send intruders back to their own time. With a bit of luck, it will work on your history teacher and your granny's annoying friends from bridge club.

items.name: Relic from Another Time
items.description: This relic is totally out of place in this time.

items.name: Traces of Explosives
items.description: This is the only trace suggesting that any criminal activity has gone on here.

items.name: Khronobourg
items.description: Fugitives and Dimensional Voyagers distil this beer using fermented Xelomorphs, and consume it without any sense of moderation.

items.name: Strange Figurine
items.description: This unrealistically proportioned figurine was probably mislaid by some pervert whose entire life is crushed by the most insurmountable loneliness.

items.name: Crushmore Guard Claw
items.description: Sometimes, you'd like to have nails this long so you could scratch your back more easily. But then, just think how lethal picking your nose would become... The price of glory, eh?

items.name: Tomorroot
items.description: Consume enough of these roots, and you'll soon be procrastinating like there's no tomorrow.

items.name: Empty Crystal Flask
items.description: You don't know what this globe-shaped flask used to contain, but given the effect it's had, it probably wasn't a sedative.

items.name: Full Crystal Flask
items.description: Refrain from watering your plants with the contents of this flask, or else you're in for quite a shock.

items.name: Everflax Flower
items.description:
This flower will disappear when you're least expecting it.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Avant-Garde Sethen Beard
items.description: Superstitious types swear by Sethen Beards. Apparently they're deeply magical, although the only unusual thing you've noticed about this one is that it smells like sardines and must.

items.name: Temporal Stabiliser Neutraliser
items.description: Now that you've seen what the neutraliser looks like, you're not really surprised that it didn't come with an instruction manual.

items.name: Dead Pixel
items.description: This pixel isn't black because it's dead; nor is it dead because it's black. It's black and dead because it got very hot.

items.name: Apathetic Fugitive Feather
items.description: This feather acts as proof of your brilliant victory over a creature that was threatening the safety of the Voyagers' Outpost.

items.name: Agent Da's Report
items.description: This thick notebook contains the results of Agent Da's research. Unfortunately for you, it's written in code and is covered in slobber.

items.name: Tomorroot
items.description: Consume enough of these roots, and you'll soon be procrastinating like there's no tomorrow.

items.name: Tomorroot
items.description: Consume enough of these roots, and you'll soon be procrastinating like there's no tomorrow.

items.name: Gonebyway Grass
items.description: These crisp stalks emit a pale glow of mystical blue when they're on the Gonebyways, but dull immediately as soon as they leave.

items.name: Broken Syringe
items.description: This syringe was being used to menace Doc Ettem Bworn's carotid artery before you stepped in.

items.name: Old Thirtree Loincloth
items.description: What do Thirtrees hide under their loincloths? Some questions ought never be answered.

items.name: Hunk of Choice Meat
items.description: This hunk of meat leaves much to be desired. You can't help but hanker after the delicious steaks served up in Amakna's inns.

items.name: Agent Pascal's Book
items.description: This book is a compilation of the prettiest illustrations found in the Bwork Magi's books.

items.name: Cleaning Crate
items.description: This crate contains all you need to clean all the latrines in Amakna Castle. It'd take even more than that to banish Thriten's filth for good.

items.name: Flower of the Past
items.description: Its comforting fragrance takes you back to autumn evenings spent under your cosy thatched roof.

items.name: Flower of the Future
items.description: Its undecipherable fragrance makes you think of adventures, adrenaline and uncertainty.

items.name: Enamoured Thriten Love Letter
items.description: Thriten's great, brutish hands could never have written so neatly.

items.name: Enamoured Thriten Bouquet
items.description: You're unlikely to find a lovelier bouquet in your lifetime.

items.name: Old Hystairkal Cloth
items.description: You don't mean to be rude, but this cloth is filthier than a Trool's gusset.

items.name: Magic Croquette
items.description: A powerful divine aura emanates from this item. But what sort of god would breathe magic into... a croquette?

items.name: Golden Dragoturkey Milk
items.description: Breeders find it pleasant to milk their Dragoturkeys. The only problem is that they can't sell the milk because it's revoltingly disgusting, so they use it to feed young Dragoturkeys... it's a kind of vicious circle.

items.name: Bag of Amaknian Spices
items.description: It's not entirely certain that these spices are still edible, but since they're not for you, what does it matter?

items.name: Ala Raine's Ham
items.description: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

items.name: Mary Reankle's Scroll
items.description: A series of numbers is scratched onto this scroll. Mary Reankle has hinted that they could be coordinates. All you have to do is find somebody who knows how to read them... in other words, somebody who isn't you.

items.name: Arthur's Letter
items.description: This letter is for Nova, Pinh's wife. It's no doubt nothing more than a testimony of their friendship. Nothing to go spreading rumours about.

items.name: Page from Arthur's Journal
items.description:
This page was written by Arthur Coward, an archaeologist.
(Double-click to read it.)

items.name: Bucket of Sea Water
items.description: Sea water from an old barrel abandoned on a Sufokian pontoon. Judging by the smell, it's not exactly fresh.

items.name: Bootlegger Scarf
items.description: Well done, you really taught those bootleggers a lesson! But was this ratty old trophy really worth all the effort?

items.name: Dimensional Diamond
items.description: A fine-cut stone with numerous facets and changing reflections... It's thought that gazing at it sharpens one's vision and mind.

items.name: Total Transparency Potion
items.description: Drink this potion to turn completely transparent. You've already achieved the same result in your social life without any wizardry, of course, but you're a sucker for new technology. (Double-click to use.)

items.name: Scribbled Notes
items.description: Someone has scribbled the numbers 3, 6, 1 and 5 on this piece of paper. There's also a note which says that only Enutoughs and their Strongboxer guards are allowed in the refinery, and that intruders will be kicked out of the dimension, at the very least.

items.name: Scribbled Notes
items.description: Someone has scribbled the numbers 6, 6 and 6 on this piece of paper. There's also a note which says that only Enutoughs and their Strongboxer guards are allowed in the refinery, and that intruders will be kicked out of the dimension, at the very least.

items.name: Scribbled Notes
items.description: Someone has scribbled the numbers 1, 0 and 8 on this piece of paper. There's also a note which says that only Enutoughs and their Strongboxer guards are allowed in the refinery, and that intruders will be kicked out of the dimension, at the very least.

items.name: Scribbled Notes
items.description: Someone has scribbled the numbers 0, 0 and 7 on this piece of paper. There's also a note which says that only Enutoughs and their Strongboxer guards are allowed in the refinery, and that intruders will be kicked out of the dimension, at the very least.

items.name: Scribbled Notes
items.description: Someone has scribbled the numbers 4 and 2 on this piece of paper. There's also a note which says that only Enutoughs and their Strongboxer guards are allowed in the refinery, and that intruders will be kicked out of the dimension, at the very least.

items.name: Refined Orichor Sample
items.description: This Orichor has been marked with a runic symbol. It's so eye-catching that even a Iop would spot its magical nature in a second.

items.name: Agent Bloude's Journal
items.description:
Agent Bloude made notes of her investigation in the Voyagers' Tower, just in case she forgot everything.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Dodecariam Symbols
items.description: The symbols of the Dodecariam - the set of magic runes with the power to store the memories of the gods - have been copied onto this page from the Historibus Compendium.

items.name: Espionage Report
items.description: This surveillance report regarding various high-ranking Dimensional Voyagers is addressed to the Explorancient. (Double-click to use.)

items.name: Mermaid Transformation Potion
items.description: Warning: contrary to what its name might suggest, this potion will not turn you into a magnificent, mythical sea creature, but rather into an ugly fish-thing, the likes of which you might find in the Shrouded Canal sewers.

items.name: Gein Disguise
items.description: You can pass yourself off as Gein using this disguise - if you can deal with the shoddy quality and the overpowering smell of mothballs.

items.name: Svivomito's Contract
items.description: This is a contract drawn up by Frank Lee Smisse, which promises a large reward to the person who brings him the stolen documents.

items.name: Silent Summoning Potion
items.description: Pouring the contents of this flask onto the ground will allow Gein the Silent to appear... which will most likely have some devastating effects.

items.name: Piece of Time
items.description: It is said that this strange object allows us to fulfil all the tasks that we're always putting off until later. Some people badmouth it, pointing out that even with all the time in the world, we wouldn't do anything useful. Who knows?

items.name: Piece of Time
items.description: It is said that this strange object allows us to fulfil all the tasks that we're always putting off until later. Some people badmouth it, pointing out that even with all the time in the world, we wouldn't do anything useful. Who knows?

items.name: Piece of Time
items.description: It is said that this strange object allows us to fulfil all the tasks that we're always putting off until later. Some people badmouth it, pointing out that even with all the time in the world, we wouldn't do anything useful. Who knows?

items.name: Tuft of Black Hair
items.description: The battle against Echo was so intense that you were left with this tuft of hair in your clenched fist. As you don't want people to think you fight like a little girl, you're probably not going to keep this trophy.

items.name: Bird of Time Feather
items.description: It's not just anyone that manages to ruffle the Bird of Time's feathers... so you'd think this trophy would be of great value. Unfortunately, it isn't. Might as well go back and fight Piwis in Astrub.

items.name: Magic Cage
items.description: According to Hel Munster, this cage reduces the size of any creature trapped inside. Sadly, it doesn't work on mother-in-laws, so don't expect it to help with those little reminders about 'doing something with your life'.

items.name: Caged Gargantula
items.description: When Hel Munster uncovers the secrets of this perpetually hungry creature, he may release it... or use it as a handy receptacle for table scraps.

items.name: Arak-hai Egg
items.description: As soon as you see this smooth and slimy object, an idea hits you: why not give out these Arak-hai eggs for next Fleaster? Of course, it may lead to some regrettable incidents involving the hatched offspring of the Rac Queen, but what a story to tell the grandchildren!

items.name: Enchanted Stone
items.description: According to the Protector of Flovor, this stone will attract interest from any creature who tries to expand its control over the trees of the Dark Forest.

items.name: Spynner Gland
items.description: This black and slimy object can be nicely summed up as 'yuk'.

items.name: Magic Potion
items.description: This potion is magic. No one is asking you to drink it so you don't need to know any more about it, unless you just want to satisfy your morbid curiosity. There's no point in reading any further to see if we reveal its secrets, our lips are sealed.

items.name: Competition Cannonball
items.description: Worse than the Big Cannonball, the Competition Cannonball has no equal when it comes to making your life hell.

items.name: Bworkette Beer
items.description: This beer is in every way the same as Bwork Beer, except for a slightly pinker colour and fruitier taste.

items.name: Bakelelite Scrap
items.description: This scrap metal is as good as gold in the hands of the Scrapmetal innkeeper.

items.name: Forge Liquid
items.description: Only dark smiths know the secret to creating this liquid.

items.name: Geegee Potion
items.description: Somewhat more effective than the Effeff potion, but not quite as good as the Aychaych potion.

items.name: Kwakwa Egg
items.description: This egg is much lighter than its size lets on.

items.name: Ghost Hunter Daggers
items.description: Oto Mustam ordered these daggers to be able to fight the spirits that haunt his nights. Or maybe he was looking for a weapon that could harm Domen.

items.name: Royal Blop Oil
items.description: At first sight, nothing makes this oil different than a good frying oil. You'd have to be a Tabi to notice all the subtle differences.

items.name: Amino Sweet Gum
items.description: You have no idea what this Amino Sweet Gum can be used for, but since you're not paid to think, that's not a problem.

items.name: Coticule
items.description: The rarity of this plant is matched only by its rarity.

items.name: Fragment of Tyreal's Blade
items.description: You don't know if Rish Claymore put the fragment in a box because he was afraid you'd cut yourself or if it was to keep you from losing it on the way.

items.name: Keymaster Article
items.description: The latest gossip in King Allister's court is much more interesting than ceremonial discourses.

items.name: Sickworm Cocoon
items.description: Artok has asked you for three of these cocoons to create a new pair of shoes.

items.name: Polished Pump
items.description: The best shoes for busting a move when the music's got you pumped up.

items.name: Bribe for Oto Mustam
items.description: This nice gift ought to assure your advancement within the Brakmar militia, or he might send you straight to the stocks.

items.name: Legendary Crackler's Gold Tooth
items.description: You just carelessly extracted one of the Legendary Crackler's teeth. Too bad it only had one – with a whole set you could have paid off your tab down at the tavern.

items.name: Immature Koalak Ears
items.description: Thrown loose into your bag, these ears took on the colour of Kaniger Hairs, which gives them an even more sordid appearance.

items.name: Dopple Testicles
items.description: Up until today, you didn't know Dopples had reproductive organs. Of course, this could just be another one of their tricks.

items.name: Dragoturkey Dung
items.description: This resource doesn't smell like demonic roses - rather it gives off a stench rather like the throne room.

items.name: Refurbished Champo
items.description: Paro Cabanne has once again accomplished miracles with his talented hands.

items.name: Crushed Blop Flowers
items.description: You've got a pretty puny pudding!

items.name: Ancestral Treechorn
items.description: It's... well, it's shiny.

items.name: Toadung Drool
items.description: From now on, your pockets will be sticky and give off the odour of an Enutrof.

items.name: Glukoko Balls
items.description: The last time you saw so many balls in the same place was in the third quarter of a Gobbowl match.

items.name: Jar of Homemade Jam
items.description: The taste of this jam is strongly reminiscent of rancid Trool toes. Of course, once you try it, you'll always want more. But why would you try it in the first place.

items.name: Snoowolf Tuft
items.description: You ripped this trophy from the horrible Snoowolf. You thought about using it as a duster, but the rough hairs are of poor quality. Might as well get rid of it.

items.name: Incarnam Pancake's Recipe
items.description:
Frey Shlibaykt explains the secrets of a successful pancake.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Incarnam Pancake
items.description: Despite the light burnt odour it gives off, this pancake is delicious. To be expected, of course, since you made it.

items.name: Sack of Jewels
items.description: This sack contains the fruits of Carla Faberjegg's labours. Your job is to give it to the Kerub Captain, who will take care of getting it back to its rightful owner.

items.name: Rysck's Dice
items.description: Throw the dice and ask Rysck what destiny has in store for you.

items.name: Rysck's Dice
items.description: Throw the dice and ask Rysck what destiny has in store for you.

items.name: Rysck's Dice
items.description: Throw the dice and ask Rysck what destiny has in store for you.

items.name: Rysck's Dice
items.description: Throw the dice and ask Rysck what destiny has in store for you.

items.name: Flask of Rac Queen Poison
items.description: This poison contains a sugary nectar that reminds you of your favourite treats. And just like these sweets, it might taste delicious at first but it's not very good for your health.

items.name: Enchanted Plants
items.description: Sotsiah Peh jealously guards the secret of the role of these plants in the manufacturing of magic weapons.

items.name: Ambusher Crown
items.description: This crown is used to prepare traditional Kanniball side dishes.

items.name: Boris Helmet
items.description: This is all that could be recovered from your fight against those opposed to Oto Mustam's military policy.

items.name: Fresh Sample of Moowolf Mojo
items.description: This small flask contains the virile power of the Moowolf Mojo in liquid form. Be careful though, it's not edible.

items.name: Cawwot Alcohol
items.description: When a Brakmarian takes something that doesn't belong to him, we call that stealing. When it's a Bontarian, we call it a loan of undetermined duration.

items.name: Aminita Powder
items.description: This lively green powder is used as a pigment by many amateur painters.

items.name: Aliton
items.description: This coin is used as currency for the militiamen fighting in the war of the cities.

items.name: Partypoopa Stone
items.description: This stone, pulled fresh from the entrails of the Partypoopa, is still hot.

items.name: Explosive Powder
items.description: Store in a cool, dry area and keep away from flames.

items.name: Royal Certificate
items.description: This document, signed by King Beldarion, is proof of your membership to one of the Orders of Bonta.

items.name: Lache Welesa Heart
items.description: This heart is just as bloody as the Order you want to join.

items.name: Golden Plissken
items.description: The smuggler guaranteed you that under all these fake scales you will find a real golden plissken.

items.name: Paul Hitik's Documents
items.description: The contents of these documents are encrypted so that they can't be read by the first Iop to come along.

items.name: Cavern Mushrooms
items.description: The mushrooms only grow in dark and damp places. However, they're too big for you to be able to grow any in your shoe.

items.name: Merlinmagus Ambrosius's Mixture
items.description: We strongly recommend you don't bring any mixtures prepared by Merlinmagus Ambrosius within proximity of your lips, unless you want to give your friends a laugh.

items.name: Burned Mixture
items.description: Merlinmagus Ambrosius should be happy with this.

items.name: Capri Zoner's Loot
items.description: There are enough precious stones in this chest to pay for a trip around the dimensions in eighty days.

items.name: Farle Sausage
items.description: It took the idiots two attempts to cut a slice of this sausage without cutting their fingers.

items.name: Hersa's Bell
items.description: Luckily Hersa's name has been engraved on this bell, because there's not a blind bit of difference between it and any other bell.

items.name: Collywobbles
items.description: What you have is contagious and may get worse at any moment.

items.name: Black Rat Antidote
items.description: This is one of the antidotes the Black Rat or one of his henchmen pinched. You had better use it on yourself before it's too late. Stop shaking like a spineless loser, it's just a teeny little razor-sharp pinprick.

items.name: Half-price Pandaburg Flask
items.description: Pandaburg is a tasty drink which could very slowly make you blind, mute and deaf. How convenient! Pandawas aren't the speedy kind.

items.name: Morsel of Strich
items.description: There are many ways to cook Strich meat, but there's still some who prefer to eat it raw.

items.name: Box of Old Tools
items.description: This box is full of old tools, most of which ought to be chucked away.

items.name: Depth Ore
items.description: This extremely rare mineral is only found at the bottom of the ocean. Markets are out of their depth with this kind of ore, so you won't find them selling it.

items.name: Sylvan Needle
items.description: This needle was crafted specially by Sadidas in order to craft and patch up their dolls.

items.name: Kindling
items.description: This wood is great for lighting fires with; it's surprisingly flammable.

items.name: Mashed Kokonut Pulp
items.description: To get the best part of a rotten Kokonut, you've got to shake it hard, or else the pulp stays on the bottom.

items.name: Tortoise Liver Oil
items.description: The statistics are definitive: the greatest criminal geniuses drank litres and litres of Tortoise Liver Oil when they were children. It should be said that this miraculous substance promotes growth, intellectual development and hatred of whoever encourages its use.

items.name: Sea Babbage Leaf
items.description: Sea Babbage is much tastier than regular Babbage. It is not recommended to wash it first. That way, you can descale your teeth while you eat.

items.name: Old Rokoko Leaf
items.description: The Kanniballs use this leaf for many activities of both a culinary and recreational nature. It is also quite helpful in certain sensitive situations, like when you're at the end of the roll.

items.name: Sea Babbage Leaf
items.description: Sea Babbage is much tastier than regular Babbage. It is not recommended to wash it first. That way, you can descale your teeth while you eat.

items.name: Sea Babbage Leaf
items.description: Sea Babbage is much tastier than regular Babbage. It is not recommended to wash it first. That way, you can descale your teeth while you eat.

items.name: Sea Babbage Leaf
items.description: Sea Babbage is much tastier than regular Babbage. It is not recommended to wash it first. That way, you can descale your teeth while you eat.

items.name: Bwork Headband
items.description: The owner of this headband isn't going to come back and claim it any time soon.

items.name: Magic Spoon
items.description: When it comes into contact with a poisoned foodstuff, this spoon emits a flashing red light. This is accompanied by an earsplittingly strident klaxon. If you're deaf and blind, you can claim nobody told you.

items.name: Kingobur Gundyan's Key
items.description: This key opens Kingobur Gundyan's chest, although an armed Iop could have cracked it open too.

items.name: Lunch Basket
items.description: You can no longer say that takeaway dishes are lower quality than home-made meals.

items.name: High Quality Scythe
items.description: This scythe has a micro-porous layer on a molecular level that enables it to be imbued with all sorts of enchantments. Unless you've got bionic eyes, you won't see any of that, though.

items.name: Old Enchanted Bone
items.description: This Old Dreggon Bone was enchanted by Rigal Hookhand himself, which has increased its black market value tenfold.

items.name: Accessory Bag
items.description: This sack contains everything you need for any ritual, and has handy side pockets to carry your lunch in. You realise too late that you haven't got any idea of the consequences of the ritual if no vengeful spirit comes to interrupt it.

items.name: Enchanted Scythe
items.description: This doesn't look any different from the non-enchanted, vanilla version. The only way to tell some blaggard hasn't scammed you is to use it on a soul who refuses to depart this world.

items.name: Lucius Drago's Skull
items.description: This will prove to Shush Tercesasti that you have completed your mission with gusto.

items.name: Ginsengoku Seed
items.description: All this little seed wants is to become a beautiful Ginsengoku plant... but it needs time to grow up. Well, that's ol' Mother Nature for you, taking her sweet time as usual.

items.name: Mechanical Parts
items.description: The letter N is engraved inside each of these parts.

items.name: Mechanical Parts
items.description: The letter A is engraved inside each of these parts.

items.name: Mechanical Parts
items.description: The letter R is engraved inside each of these parts.

items.name: Mama Vaudou's Amulet
items.description: What mysterious powers does this crescent moon-shaped amulet hold? Can it make fur grow out of your ears? Increase the size of certain attributes? Make an unfaithful husband come running back to his wife like a little Bow Wow to its master? Only Mama Vaudou knows.

items.name: Young Ginsengoku Shoot
items.description: Thanks to Mama Vaudou, your little seed sprouted into this adorable young shoot just full of promise. You should think twice about lighting that cigar to celebrate the happy day, though, unless you want to set the forest on fire.

items.name: Ginsengoku Moon Root
items.description: After all that work, you've finally harvested the fruit of your labours, a magnificent... root. That's it? And what exactly are you going to do with that? Cook it? Are you an old swamp gnome on a diet or something?

items.name: Moon Fertiliser
items.description: This compost is rich in minerals and various other elements, plus it's entirely free of chemicals. Let that be an example for Raymond Santho!

items.name: Skull and Crossbones Flag
items.description: A pirate ship without a skull and crossbones flag is like a cheese without a rind: just plain weird.

items.name: First Moonies Scroll
items.description:
This scroll was written by the famous Moonies, and it is genuinely genuine. Yes, of course, since we say so!
(Double-click to read the document.)

items.name: Second Moonies Scroll
items.description:
This scroll was written by the famous Moonies, and it is genuinely genuine. We already told you that, n'est-ce pas?
(Double-click to read the document.)

items.name: Third Moonies Scroll
items.description:
We can't say it enough: this scroll was written by the famous Moonies, and it is genuinely genuine.
(Double-click to read the document.)

items.name: Bworn's Key
items.description: If you believe the last Moonies Scroll, this key will make you rich! All that's left to do is open your eye – the good one – to find the entrance to Bworn's Cavern.

items.name: Pirate Hat
items.description: There's some writing embroidered on the lining of this hat: ‘Truth lies at the bottom of a well...' This sentiment is a bit shocking to hear from a pirate, as the majority of filibusters are convinced that the truth lies at the bottom of a bottle of rum.

items.name: Urgent Parcel
items.description: There's a strong smell of lemon coming from this parcel.

items.name: Dough-Dough Egg
items.description: Dough-Doughs are sacred birds for the locals, so avoid showing this egg to any villagers if you want to avoid trouble. If you run into a Kanniball patrol, you can always hide it somewhere... Where is up to you.

items.name: Dough-Dough Egg
items.description: Dough-Doughs are sacred birds for the locals, so avoid showing this egg to any villagers if you want to avoid trouble. If you run into a Kanniball patrol, you can always hide it somewhere... Where is up to you.

items.name: Dough-Dough Egg
items.description: Dough-Doughs are sacred birds for the locals, so avoid showing this egg to any villagers if you want to avoid trouble. If you run into a Kanniball patrol, you can always hide it somewhere... Where is up to you.

items.name: Dough-Dough Egg
items.description: Dough-Doughs are sacred birds for the locals, so avoid showing this egg to any villagers if you want to avoid trouble. If you run into a Kanniball patrol, you can always hide it somewhere... Where is up to you.

items.name: Pirate Jaw
items.description: Some pirates get so bored they dislocate their jaw by yawning too much... But that wasn't the case for the pirates you ran into, so you had to fight hard for this trophy.

items.name: LeChouque's Hook
items.description: An essential accessory for unlucky pirates, this hook can be used as a hand. Its colour gives it a classy style...

items.name: Dragandrop Scale
items.description: Although its appearance suggests the opposite, this scale is as flexible as fabric.

items.name: Sniké
items.description: This pair of shoes won't help Dike Tarak break any records, but the studded sole will prevent him from slipping on Dragoturkey excrement.

items.name: Tailor's Manual for Ninnies
items.description: This Tailor Manual will teach you the tricks of the trade. For those who lack imagination, the first pages have a few simple cut-out patterns.

items.name: Viscous Fluid
items.description: After having received a beating, this liquid is much smoother.

items.name: Danathor's Requests
items.description: This document, penned by Danathor, contains the Steward's requests and instructions to make a weapon.

items.name: Distillery Crate
items.description: This crate contains documents and items recovered from the rubble of the old Bonta Distillery.

items.name: Unlocked Coffer
items.description: The deal made with Tuck Rosenton forbids you from stealing the contents of this coffer.

items.name: Poison Sachet
items.description: Slipped into a common Bag of Spices, this poison is extremely powerful.

items.name: Flask of Poison
items.description: This flask doesn't contain aspirin, but all the same, once you mix it with beer, your headache will go away.

items.name: Improved Spamouflage Potion
items.description: This potion, created by a master of the Order, lets you reveal any invisible thing in the area.

items.name: Rotaflor Belladonna
items.description: This Belladonna only grows on a Rotaflor. This peculiarity is still being studied by Otomai's Disciples.

items.name: Isle O'Antitch Flask
items.description: This flask contains a strange little creature who looks in bad shape. If you shake the flask near your ear, you can hear sharp little cries.

items.name: Piece of Sacred Cake
items.description: When he's feeling chagrined, the god Ecaflip consoles himself by chowing down on some pastries. Oh yes, it's not always paradise in Ingloriom: there are days where the life of a god really isn't a piece of cake.

items.name: Four-Leaf Clover
items.description: Widely regarded as a good luck charm, this clover is supposed to bring fortune, love, glory and beauty - but seeing you, it doesn't seem like it's very effective.

items.name: Weremoggy Paw
items.description: Wabbits say that a Weremoggy Paw is a more powerful talisman than a Wabbit Paw. However, the Weremoggies say the opposite. It just goes to prove that no one like to lose a piece of their anatomy for stupid superstitions.

items.name: Circuit Map
items.description: This map shows the circuit that Agent Evenli will have to follow.

items.name: Pair of Old Sandals
items.description: These sandals look like they've been worn by several generations of Pandawas.

items.name: Ecaflee Boil
items.description: Stuck on the end of your nose, this boil is a perfect complement to you witch outfit when visiting Al Howin's garden.

items.name: Kittenip Trophy
items.description: This trophy is awarded when the winner of a game of Kittenip gains victory by gaymebraker.

items.name: First Part of Agent Tai's Report
items.description: With illustrations added, this report would be a serious competitor with the Bwork Magus' Spellbooks.

items.name: Second Part of Agent Tai's Report
items.description: Among other things, this report contains the rules of the game for Kittenip and its many variants.

items.name: Inn Map
items.description: For puritans, this map represents the way in to the Shustuft Crust. For others, it promises a good time.

items.name: Trud Blend Shield
items.description: This shield remained intact after a violent run-in with the Colousses. Sadly, the same cannot be said of its user.

items.name: Ecaflee Eggs
items.description: These viscous little balls will soon give birth to larger balls hungry for fresh blood. How cute.

items.name: Technomagical Thingamajig
items.description: In theory, this device is supposed to pass you off as the god Sadida, in person. In reality, you'll soon see if it works.

items.name: Common Clover
items.description: Today's not your lucky day.

items.name: Temporal Incapacitator
items.description: This item is set to temporarily block Agent Pizzareta's temporal abilities.

items.name: Measuring Tool
items.description: This device notes and saves geographic coordinates. It's useless to try and use it to measure other things... Anyway, you'd surely be disappointed.

items.name: Ush Galesh's Flame
items.description: You don't understand why this flame has changed colour, but is it really that important?

items.name: Weremoggy Guinea Pig
items.description: It doesn't know what's in store for it, and nor do you.

items.name: Lilsmelliting
items.description: This creature is aptly named.

items.name: Smelliting Biscuit
items.description:
A powerful magical aura emanates from this item, given to you by Lilsmelliting.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Sram Ring
items.description: Instead of the Golden Pussmina, you found this ring. There must be an explanation.

items.name: Appearance Powder
items.description:
This powder won't make your wildest dreams appear. It will, however, force an invisible Sram to show itself.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Golden Pussmina
items.description: This shawl, sewn from silky hairs of a Golden Bow Meow, was ordered by Enutrof to hide the face of his most beautiful daughter. The god hoped that she could hereby walk around without attracting attention. Unfortunately, wearing it only stirred up desire.

items.name: Pouncer's Eye
items.description:
This is an eye.
No, really?

items.name: Catichan's Eye
items.description:
This is an eye.
No, really?

items.name: Calleyat's Eye
items.description:
This is an eye.
No, really?

items.name: Catsquatch's Eye
items.description:
This is an eye.
No, really?

items.name: Damaged Whistle
items.description: You got this whistle during your fight against Shinobite and his ninjas. However you blow into it, nothing happens.

items.name: Bow Meow Grass Resin
items.description: There are several ways to prepare and consume this bit of resin. The stupidest of Weremoggies are mad about it.

items.name: Unblocked Whistle
items.description:
Catvanna has unblocked this whistle. You no longer need to blow into it like a piglet, nor turn as red as a peony to try and make a sound.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Ecaflee Eggs
items.description: These viscous little balls will soon give birth to larger balls hungry for fresh blood. How cute.

items.name: Ecaflee Eggs
items.description: These viscous little balls will soon give birth to larger balls hungry for fresh blood. How cute.
