items.description: Many potions, their content as bizarre as it is strange.

items.name: Sroness's Instructions

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This document contains instructions for Gaymoff.

items.name: Necronyx Shard

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Nyx was a necromancer who had nothing to do with this rock.

items.name: Necronyx Powder

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Rest assured: this powder was obtained from the rock of the same name, and not from the necromancer of the same name.

items.name: Pearl of Eternity

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: You have the impression that this pearl is whispering horrible things to you.

items.name: B'ones Iris

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This plant only grows on the corpses of the sea creatures on which it feeds.

items.name: Sroness's List of Equipment

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Sroness has made a list of equipment she needs to kit out the future recruits.

items.name: Demon Horn

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: If you were a barbarian, you'd hollow out this horn to make a very charming stein. But you are a civilised being, are you not?

items.name: Charred Ones' Heart

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This heart has become as cold and still as your old Auntie Danielle.

items.name: Waste Item

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This item is going to be recycled for a good cause.

items.name: Charred Ones' Burning Ember

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: No one has ever thought of sticking this ember to the end of a stick to make a non-polluting torch.

items.name: Fidji Merline's Crate

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This chest contains numerous materials that will be useful for Howard Nidian.

items.name: Scott Pennar's Chest

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This chest contains numerous materials that will be useful for Howard Nidian.

items.name: Howard Nidian's Transmitter

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This transmitter will direct magical emanations from the livid heart to the main sensor.

items.name: Nelaba O'Brian's Sensor

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Theoretically, this magical emanation sensor should facilitate plant growing in the Magmatic Steps.

items.name: Ethereal Item

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This item is similar to your words: inconsistent.

items.name: Howard Nidian's Talisman

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: These skulls are too large to have belonged to the Littls.

items.name: Soul-Blaze Ashes

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: These are as cold as an Enutrof who's made a bad bargain.

items.name: Black Fire Pearl

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: A spark of Black Fire has been concentrated into this pearl.

items.name: Howard Nidian's Charm

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: You can't resist shaking it to make the skulls rattle, annoying your neighbours.

items.name: White Fire Pearl

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: A spark of White Fire has been concentrated into this pearl.

items.name: Franiel's Whistle

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: You would be ill-advised to blow this whistle in the Magmatic Steps, unless you want to attract an army of the dead.

items.name: Hallooraider's Talisman

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Disturbing heat emanates from this talisman. The sensation is similar to wetting your pants on the ghost train.

items.name: Binoraider's Talisman

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Disturbing heat emanates from this talisman. The sensation is similar to wetting your pants on the ghost train.

items.name: Lysraider's Talisman

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Disturbing heat emanates from this talisman. The sensation is similar to wetting your pants on the ghost train.

items.name: Hammered Necronyx

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This block of Necronyx had divine energy beaten into it with a hammer.

items.name: Armarine Sacrifice

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description:
Destroying this item will satisfy the hunger of the Necronyx doll.
(Double-click to feed the doll)

items.name: Ghoul Sacrifice

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description:
Destroying this item will satisfy the hunger of the Necronyx doll.
(Double-click to feed the doll)

items.name: Soul-Blaze Sacrifice

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description:
Destroying this item will satisfy the hunger of the Necronyx doll.
(Double-click to feed the doll)

items.name: Cursed Sacrifice

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description:
Destroying this item will satisfy the hunger of the Necronyx doll.
(Double-click to feed the doll)

items.name: Ancestral Crackler Heart

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This heart has stopped beating, which is hardly surprising, given that you beat its owner to death. Yes, yes, he started it... but still...

items.name: Glazed Eye

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description:
This glazed Shushu eye seems imbued with an evil presence... It might give you the gift of second sight, but it might not show you anything you want to see twice (or even once, for that matter).
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: The War of the Steps

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: An old book evoking the war that raged between the Brakmarians and demons in the Magmatic Steps.

items.name: Residual Ore

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Despite its appearance and impurities, this ore can be used in Smithmagic.

items.name: Tree Blood

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Pour this blood into the Infernal Well to awaken the demonic being lurking in its depths.

items.name: Wooden Bowl

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This empty bowl sculpted out of the bark of the sacrificial tree is perfect for soup, if of course you're hungry for blood.

items.name: Wreck Barrel

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This barrel should make Seewulf happy.

items.name: Wreck Chest

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This chest should make Seewulf happy.

items.name: Wreck Stone

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This stone should make Seewulf happy.

items.name: Wreck Crate

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This crate should make Seewulf happy.

items.name: Ocean Shard

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: For some people, the sea is a source of life and a generous benefactor of constantly renewed beauty. For others, it is a wild mistress, remorselessly killing those who would try to tame it... When you gaze deeply into the depths of this shard, you feel the weight of the waters on your shoulders. Be careful not to gaze upon it for too long, or you may never be able to come back up to the surface.

items.name: Tamed Anger of the Ocean

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This pearl of solid water is boiling with contained anger.

items.name: Benzo Cake

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This cake is available on prescription only. Follow the dosage carefully. In the event of undesirable effects, consult a doctor immediately, and call the morgue while you're at it.

items.name: Beating Heart of an Ancestral Crackler

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: There's nothing like a divine spark to get this heart beating again.

items.name: Crumpled Plan

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This plan provides indications about the seabed. However, it is of no use if you get lost in your own bed. No rest for the wicked!

items.name: Kay Thanxbai's Crate

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This crate looks inconsequential, but is a feat of technology.

items.name: Astrubian Frothy Beer
items.description: It's more foam than liquid, not that you pay any less for it.

items.name: Dandelion Pear
items.description: This meat needs to be properly cooked to remove the taste of corpses.

items.name: Rose Pear
items.description: This meat needs to be properly cooked to remove the taste of congealed blood.

items.name: Sunflower Pear
items.description: This meat needs to be properly cooked to remove the oily taste.

items.name: Scarecro Pear
items.description: This meat needs to be properly cooked to remove the taste of manure.

items.name: Box of Knick-Knacks
items.description: These knick-knacks don't belong to you, so there's no point figuring out what they're used for.

items.name: Gobball War Chief Sample
items.description: There might be millions of competitors fighting it out in this sample, but only the best will result in the birth of a Gobball.

items.name: Julie Thecon's Crate
items.description: You could put together several Dragoturkeys just by assembling the parts in this crate.

items.name: Target Dummy
items.description: This structure is an improvement on a complete massacre. If you fail in your career as an adventurer, you can always fall back on dummy making.

items.name: Animated Target Dummy
items.description: Just like a trade unionist, this training dummy comes to life when the magic words are spoken.

items.name: Contaminated Grain Sample
items.description: This sample will be useful for Dragonsly.

items.name: Contaminated Plant Sample
items.description: This sample will be useful for Dragonsly.

items.name: Contaminated Wood Sample
items.description: This sample will be useful for Dragonsly.

items.name: Contaminated Meat Sample
items.description: This sample will be useful for Dragonsly.

items.name: Contaminated Fish Sample
items.description: This sample will be useful for Dragonsly.

items.name: Dragonsly's Vermifuge
items.description: This vermifuge was created to fight against parasites that have become incredibly resistant to traditional extermination methods, unless you happen to count the attic fires caused by those methods.

items.name: Artempth Rose Flower
items.description: The flower of this rose is so dark that its shadow seems to twinkle in comparison.

items.name: Astrubian Association Card
items.description: This card states that you are a member of the male... benefactors who wish to preserve the old chapel of Astrub, the Rogue culture hotspot. The document grants you access to the building without fear of persecution or public quartering.

items.name: Torn Fabric
items.description: This piece of fabric, found on a pillaged grave, was left behind by the crook you're currently looking for.

items.name: Becky's Lock-Picking Kit
items.description: You've managed to find this lock-picking kit in Becky's workshed.

items.name: Charred Book
items.description: By some inexplicable miracle, this book wasn't reduced to ashes after being thrown into the flames. Nevertheless, it's as black as a Shushu's soul, which might make it difficult to read.

items.name: Gobbette Mimilk
items.description: If you hadn't already finished growing, you might have drunk a few drops of Mimilk... but that might risk bringing back memories of your childhood and nobody wants to see a big, strong hustler like you reduced to tears.

items.name: Centenary Bark
items.description: This old piece of bark has seen more winters than you... That should give you a better idea of your importance in the order of things.

items.name: Enchanted Bark
items.description: Magus Ax's ritual has completely retranscribed the text from the blackened book onto this Centenary Bark. Goblin Prent should know how to use it wisely.

items.name: Crafted Leather Case
items.description: This old case contains an ancient scroll that could tell you more about a certain dragon.

items.name: Scroll Translated by Aisling
items.description:
If you read this scroll, you'll be able to add to your pitiful knowledge of Ratathrosk, the dragon of Astrub.
(Double-click to read the message.)

items.name: Crate of Wood
items.description: It cannot be ruled out that there'll be scraps of flesh and pieces of bone amongst this wood taken from a cemetery.

items.name: Brutas's Crypt Key
items.description: A handful of earth collected in front of the crypt of Astrub's founder.

items.name: Vengeful Spectre Relic
items.description: This necklace used to belong to a Brakmarian ghost who has been haunting the cemetery for centuries. It's probably cursed. Not that it matters, since you weren't planning to keep it as a souvenir.

items.name: Gargoyl Belt
items.description: You took this belt from one of the creatures guarding Astrub Cemetery. There's no point trying to wear it; it doesn't fit.

items.name: Sacred Urn
items.description:
Priest Nistracolamus has given you this funeral vase so you can bury it near the Autumn Knight's grave. You'll need to fill it first if you want the magic to work.
(Double-click to fill the urn.)

items.name: Unidentified Claw
items.description: If he examines this claw, the master hunter Unterix might be able to tell you more about the type of animal who's terrorising the lumberjacks in Astrub Forest.

items.name: Bonta Honey
items.description: This honey isn't for you. Would you really want to compromise your mission because of your sweet tooth?

items.name: Osamodas Spellbook
items.description: An old book containing magic formulae used to summon spirits. It's better if you don't open it. Just give it to Artand.

items.name: Kerub's Purse
items.description: This purse contains the bonus for Prent. Don't think for one minute there's a Goblin inside it. That would definitely be impossible... unless it had been sadly reduced to ash.

items.name: Iron Scissors
items.description:
This pair of scissors is not much to look at. Its former owner glued it to his wrists and went around giving ridiculous haircuts to Gobballs. It was totally unprofitable; nobody paid the slightest bit of attention.
(Double-click to use the scissors.)

items.name: Pandawa Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Pandawa.

items.name: Rogue Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Rogue.

items.name: Masqueraider Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Masqueraider.

items.name: Foggernaut Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to a Foggernaut.

items.name: Eliotrope Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Eliotrope.

items.name: Huppermage Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Huppermage.

items.name: Ouginak Tuft
items.description: This tuft of hair belonged to an Ouginak.

items.name: Nistracolamus's Holy Water
items.description:
This water was blessed by Nistracolamus before your very own eyes. Even if you doubt his skills, you can't deny this water has magical properties.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Nistracolamus's Thurible
items.description: This thurible was given to you by Nistracolamus to send the spirits back to the world of the dead.

items.name: Piece of Larva
items.description: Now here's a trophy you probably shouldn't hang on your wall... When the thrill of victory wears off, you can get rid of it.

items.name: Well-Filled Purse.
items.description: Upon opening this promising purse, you discover it's full of Little Pebbles. It looks like you've been taken for a ride by Goblins... That's not really something to boast about, is it?

items.name: Gobball Snot Stew
items.description: Don't spend too much time stewing over the taste. That would be stew-pid.

items.name: Nistracolamus's Holy Water
items.description:
This water was blessed by Nistracolamus before your very own eyes. Even if you doubt his skills, you can't deny this water has magical properties.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Nistracolamus's Holy Water
items.description:
This water was blessed by Nistracolamus before your very own eyes. Even if you doubt his skills, you can't deny this water has magical properties.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Moumouse
items.description: You captured this hysterical Moumouse in Grandmother's house.

items.name: Destination: Maelstrom
items.description: Consulting this work is like opening the door to the unknown with your eyes closed. Soon, you'll dive into the crazy spiral of life of the inhabitants of the Maelstrom. Dare to do so and there's no knowing how evil the meanders of your dreams will be. Learn from the Great Upheaval, the result of which is the Turmoil.

items.name: Brokkr's Broken Hammer
items.description: This crate contains a legendary hammer. Alas! It is broken in two. It will take more than a pot of glu to fix it.

items.name: Tankard of Friendship
items.description: This empty Tankard was given to you by a Stubbyob as a sign of friendship. Thanks to it, you might just earn the right to open the doors to the Kingdom of Freezammer... Best not smash it over the head of one of the regulars when you next visit the tavern.

items.name: Cursed Metal
items.description: When you touch this piece of metal, a supernatural cold overtakes you. It feels a bit like being in your mother-in-law's presence.

items.name: Brokkr's Hammer
items.description: Forged by Brokkr with the help of her sister, this hammer is a masterpiece of Stubbyob craftsmanship. Using it to crush the heads of people you don't like would be unfortunate, and using it for your weekend DYI projects would be unforgivable. Show a little respect!

items.name: Woven Blankets
items.description: Even though the fabric is as light as silk, these blankets protect against the cold better than the thickest furs. If one's going to hog the blankets, Klime figures one might as well have the best quality blankets to hog.

items.name: Very Hot Meat Pasties
items.description: These pasties stuffed with ground meat are best eaten hot. You've only got a few minutes to bring them to the Alteryobs so don't dawdle along the way!

items.name: Mechaniac Piece
items.description: This is proof that you're a brute who breaks everything you touch... The Mechaniacs are still trembling.

items.name: Chest of Kamas
items.description: The contents of this chest are intended to compensate the Stubbyobs for the problems caused by Count Harebourg's project, not pad you savings... So, hand's off!

items.name: Ystrion's Beard Hair
items.description: Isn't a lock of beard hair the most beautiful token of affection one could dream of? So much more personal than a heart-shaped diamond or box of chocolates.

items.name: Stubbyob Tools
items.description: Drilling tools that will let you make holes in the crate that will hold Ystrion.

items.name: Empty Crate with Holes
items.description: Ystrion's second home is ready; all that's left is to give him the grand tour so he can see what's around the next bend.

items.name: Ystrion's Crate
items.description: You dared put Ystrion in a wooden crate. Is there no limit to your evil?

items.name: Torpid Bearbarian Honey
items.description: This wild-tasting honey is one of the ingredients that gives Barbeerd its distinctive taste.

items.name: Korriander Powder
items.description: A pinch of Korriander powder could spice up your life as an adventurer, but be careful not to overindulge in it... An enduring legend says that certain plants in the Petrified Forest were once Twelvians who became accustomed to consuming it regularly.

items.name: Bitter Orange Liqueur
items.description: A simple glass of fruit juice and hey presto! You'll be rolling around under the table.

items.name: Crate of Supple Skis
items.description: Take this crate back to Ski White and you'll get a kiss, just like in Fairywork tales.

items.name: Crate of Dark Skis
items.description: Take this crate back to Ski White and you'll get a kiss, just like in Fairywork tales.

items.name: Crate of Rustic Skis
items.description: Take this crate back to Ski White and you'll get a kiss, just like in Fairywork tales.

items.name: Crate of Slippery Skis
items.description: Take this crate back to Ski White and you'll get a kiss, just like in Fairywork tales.

items.name: Quench Water
items.description: This freezing cold water is used by Stubbyob smiths to quench the metal, that is to say cool it down after heating it up to make it stronger. You learn something new every day, don't you?

items.name: Confidential Note
items.description:
You found this scroll on the body of a relic hunter. Yes, indeed: you are the sort to riffle through the pockets of your defeated enemies... How sweet.
(Double-click to read the document.)

items.name: Message for Cantile
items.description: Give this message to the mayor of Frigost Village and watch her reaction carefully when she reads that King Dazahk is demanding ten million kamas... You might be disappointed: not everyone is a much of a skinflint as you.

items.name: Tumult Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Herald of Tumult".

items.name: Al Howin Cursed Pumpkwin Seeds
items.description:
These seeds will sprout pumpkwins worthy enough to enter in the "Who's Got the Biggest Pumpkwin" contest. 
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Contaminated Creature Sample
items.description: This sample was taken from a creature suffering from the Al Howin curse.

items.name: Nightmarish Sweet
items.description: This sweet is Meridia of Fear Asid's favourite. Only a very rare few know the recipe.

items.name: Rac Queen Leg
items.description: This leg was savagely ripped from its rightful owner during a fearsome fight.

items.name: Viscous Vampire Blood
items.description: This blood was stolen from a Vampire who had been expecting anything but that!

items.name: Stolen Bone
items.description: This bone came from an illustrious unknown stranger.

items.name: Soiled Undies
items.description: The owner of these undies soiled them in a moment of extreme terror. Deeply ashamed, he got rid of them by giving them to the first person he met.

items.name: Cursed Pumpkwin
items.description: This Pumpkwin is one of the ingredients needed to create Devhorrors.

items.name: Scooger's House Key
items.description: Using this key, you can sneak into Scooger's house.

items.name: Fleece-Up Lotion
items.description: There's nothing better for growing a few hairs on a hairless head.

items.name: Crate of Decorations
items.description: This crate contains Kwismas decorations hand-crafted by Mary Kwismas.

items.name: Tree Trunk
items.description: Mary Kwismas needs this tree trunk to craft all kinds of Kwismas decorations.

items.name: Aromatic Leaf
items.description: This leaf will give all of your dishes a slightly smoky taste.

items.name: Externam Amulet
items.description: This amulet makes it possible to see all of the spirits wandering around you until it has been entirely consumed. Give it to Scooger so he can see Larmey.

items.name: Extinguished Eternal Candle
items.description: Once lit, this candle lets the inhabitants of Externam craft a magical amulet.

items.name: Lit Eternal Candle
items.description: Take this candle to Larmey so he can have an Externam Amulet crafted.

items.name: Letter from Mary Kwismas
items.description: This letter was written years ago. It's addressed to Scooger.

items.name: Tiny Dream Coin
items.description: This coin can only be seen in dreams. Perhaps it can be used as currency with an imaginary being?

items.name: Small Dream Coin
items.description: This coin can only be seen in dreams. Perhaps it can be used as currency with an imaginary being?

items.name: Large Dream Coin
items.description: This coin can only be seen in dreams. Perhaps it can be used as currency with an imaginary being?

items.name: Huge Dream Coin
items.description: This coin can only be seen in dreams. Perhaps it can be used as currency with an imaginary being?

items.name: Aubergines
items.description: Scooger is going to use these aubergines to prepare a Kwismas feast.

items.name: Cawwots
items.description: Scooger is going to use these Cawwots to prepare a Kwismas feast.

items.name: Onions
items.description: Scooger is going to use these onions to prepare a Kwismas feast.

items.name: Fresh Meat
items.description: Scooger is going to use this meat to prepare a Kwismas feast.

items.name: Peeled Potatoes
items.description: Scooger is going to use these potatoes to prepare a Kwismas feast.

items.name: Certificate from Harry Kwismas
items.description: This certificate attests to your barter with Harry Kwismas. Come back and see him in 24 hours to get a new emote scroll.

items.name: Kwismas Gift from Scooger
items.description: Scooger is generous this year! This gift is for someone on Kwismas Island.

items.name: Surprise Kwismas Gift
items.description: The inhabitants of Kwismas Island have decided to give Scooger this Kwismas Gift.

items.name: Tempoken
items.description: Time passes so quickly that one achievement soon gives way to another. Under such conditions, it's difficult to count them, which is why the god Xelor has made these Tempokens that he offers each time an adventurer completes an achievement.

items.name: Fleaster Custodian's List
items.description: The Fleaster custodian needs the things on this list. In exchange for them, she'll lend you her temaphromosis ring.

items.name: Temaphromosis Ring
items.description:
This ring is the perfect item for any adventurer who wants to pass themself off as a Chocomancer. 
(Double-click to turn yourself into a practitioner of chocomancy.)

items.name: Chocomancer Hairs
items.description: These hairs were discreetly stolen from the head of a Chocomancer and give off 99% pure dark magic.

items.name: Paper Wrapper
items.description: This little piece of coloured paper usually contains a delicious chocolate treat.

items.name: Mysterious Hair
items.description: The colour of this hair is reminiscent of burning flame or copper. It must have belonged to a ginger animal.

items.name: Ear of Rare Wheat
items.description:
This wheat only grows for a short period of time during the Fleaster season. When mixed with cocoa, it produces an unexpected and extremely chocolatey reaction.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Surprise Gift for Dadi
items.description: Emil Kah knows how to make his favourite squirrel curious. This gift contains a cosy bed that will delight the little critter. Dadi will most likely agree to trade one of his hidden treasures for it.

items.name: Doctor Theo Broma's Notes
items.description: Before disappearing, Doctor Theo Broma left records of his experiments.

items.name: Key to Doctor Theo Broma's Workshop
items.description: Doctor Broma's workshop has been closed since he disappeared; only this key can let you in.

items.name: Suwpwise Egg
items.description: This little egg is a beloved treat. Some love the surprise inside, others love the smooth sweet taste, and others love the colourful wrapper.

items.name: Waldy's Mockery
items.description: You didn't find the right Waldy! You must wait 10 minutes before trying again.

items.name: Collectible Picture
items.description: This picture is part of Fleaster museum curator Cadi Bury's vast collection.

items.name: Chocolate Coupon
items.description: Nacho Colate at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop will give you something in exchange for this coupon.

items.name: Hazelnut Coupon
items.description: Hazz Elnutt at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop will give you something in exchange for this coupon.

items.name: Praline Coupon
items.description: Oprah Lynn at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop will give you something in exchange for this coupon.

items.name: Big Chocolate Coupon Booklet
items.description:
This booklet contains 40 chocolate coupons that can be redeemed at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop. See Nacho Colate.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Hazelnut Coupon Booklet
items.description:
This booklet contains 20 hazelnut coupons that can be redeemed at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop. See Hazz Elnutt.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Empty Miniature Flying Bell Cage
items.description: Use this imp-made cage to capture the Fleaster Island miniature flying bells.

items.name: Caged Northern Miniature Flying Bell
items.description:
This cage contains a Fleaster Island miniature flying bell.
(Double-click to free the miniature flying bell.)

items.name: Caged Southern Miniature Flying Bell
items.description:
This cage contains a Fleaster Island miniature flying bell.
(Double-click to free the miniature flying bell.)

items.name: Caged Eastern Miniature Flying Bell
items.description:
This cage contains a Fleaster Island miniature flying bell.
(Double-click to free the miniature flying bell.)

items.name: Caged Western Miniature Flying Bell
items.description:
This cage contains a Fleaster Island miniature flying bell.
(Double-click to free the miniature flying bell.)

items.name: Fine Vintage Chocolate
items.description: This chocolate is infused with the magic of Fleaster Island, which gives it an unmistakable flavour.

items.name: All-Purpose Glu
items.description: This all-purpose glu glues everything to everything! Make sure you don't get any on your fingers.

items.name: Temaphromosis Ring
items.description:
This ring is the perfect item for any adventurer who wants to pass themself off as a Chocomancer. 
(Double-click to look like yourself again.)

items.name: Common Fleaster Egg
items.description: The Fleaster egg hunt is in full swing! This egg is proof that you're an egg hunter extraordinaire. Bring it to Lilivonne Kah on Fleaster Island.

items.name: Rare Fleaster Egg
items.description: The Fleaster egg hunt is in full swing! This one is especially rare and difficult to find. Was it luck or talent that put it in your hands? Only you can answer that question. Bring it to Lilivonne Kah on Fleaster Island.

items.name: Small Chocolate Coupon Booklet
items.description:
This booklet contains 20 chocolate coupons that can be redeemed at the Fleaster Island Chocoshop. See Nacho Colate.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Proof of Reliability
items.description: Obtained during a bloody fight, this sample shows your valour and courage.

items.name: Dose of Docility
items.description: The Fleaster Island chocolate makers use this dose to keep the guards docile. Don't bother giving it to your Bow Meow so it doesn't sharpen its claws on your settee as this dose only works on Marshmallow Bearbarians.

items.name: Festoken
items.description: Feeling a wee bit thirsty? Wanting a souvenir from the Amakna music festival? Go and see Merchall. That travelling salesman will most likely have just what you're looking for. Well... as long as a band's on stage!

items.name: Pollenectar
items.description: Do you start sneezing with the first days of Junssidor? Are your eyes red and is your nose itching? Don't be concerned! This pollenectar is probably responsible. Wait a few weeks. It'll lose all its virtues and these little annoyances will be nothing more than distant memories...

items.name: Pollenectar Net
items.description: This net is used to collect pollenectar when it comes off its host. The pollenectar gets caught on the webbing. It's perfect for carrying it over long distances.

items.name: Dirt from the Former Crocodyl Camp
items.description: You got this dirt from the site of the camp set up by the first Crocodyls who dared attack Astrub, the City of Mercenaries, during the Jade Twilight.

items.name: Unaltered Moonstone
items.description: This moonstone glows with divine light; it belongs to Crokalcrolak the albino Crocodyl.

items.name: Nibbled Scroll
items.description: This scroll was ripped violently out of a Crocodyl's mouth and is still covered in slobber.

items.name: Detention Ticket
items.description: This ticket will get you into prison for a free visit.

items.name: Blood Stinger's Sword
items.description: Behold the legendary sword of Blood Stinger.

items.name: Lakeweed
items.description: This ultra-resistant plant is perfect for tying up those who have been volunteered for sacrifice against their will.

items.name: Alassslash Meat
items.description: This tasty meat is one of the main ingredients in a Crocuzkoian delicacy.

items.name: Cannicodyl Meat
items.description: This tasty meat is one of the main ingredients in a Crocuzkoian delicacy.

items.name: Nosee Meat
items.description: This tasty meat is one of the main ingredients in a Crocuzkoian delicacy.

items.name: Caimaneedyl Meat
items.description: This tasty meat is one of the main ingredients in a Crocuzkoian delicacy.

items.name: Crocuzkoian Delicacy
items.description: One day, a butcher decided to mix together all the scraps of meat he had left over. The resulting dish was so popular it quickly became the favourite on the island.

items.name: Empty Test Tube
items.description: This test tube is perfect for collecting bubbles that keep Crocodyls away.

items.name: Test Tube Full of Repellent
items.description: A few drops of the product in this test tube can keep Prancing Chimera eggs safe from Crocodyl attacks for six to eight weeks.

items.name: Instructions from the Crocuzkoian Activist
items.description: Follow the instructions on this scroll to make effective Crocodyl repellent.

items.name: Used Lockpick
items.description: Although it's in a bad state, this lockpick should be able to help you escape from prison one last time.

items.name: [!] Kama
items.description: [!] Meow-naie

items.name: Bot Account ID
items.description: If you're uncomfortable with this mission, be sure to sign this document.

items.name: Paper Cup
items.description: Give this cup a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Plastic Cup
items.description: Give this cup a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Plastic Stirrer
items.description: It's insane how useful something this small can be – if you're incapable of skipping the sugar in your favourite hot drink, that is.

items.name: Plastic Bottle Cap
items.description: Give this bottle cap a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Open Plastic Bottle
items.description: Give this bottle a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Closed Plastic Bottle
items.description:
Give this bottle a new life by recycling it, and don't forget to take the cap off before you do!

(Double-click to separate the bottle and cap.)

items.name: Metal Bottle Cap
items.description: Be careful not to throw this piece of metal just anywhere!

items.name: Open Glass Bottle
items.description: Give this bottle a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Closed Glass Bottle
items.description:
Give this bottle a new life by recycling it, and don't forget to take the cap off before you do!

(Double-click to separate the bottle and cap.)

items.name: Soda Can
items.description: Give this soda can a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Clean Paper Bag
items.description: Give this paper bag a new life by recycling it!

items.name: Dirty Paper Bag
items.description: It's a shame this paper bag is wet or dirty, as it cannot be recycled now!

items.name: Plastic Cutlery
items.description: Pay no attention to what this cutlery is made of: it won't be recycled.

items.name: Pizza Crust
items.description: Everybody knows: pizza crust is what gets left on the plate when you're having trouble finishing your meal!

items.name: Apple Core
items.description: Careful not to upset the apple-cart.

items.name: Ball of Aluminium Foil
items.description: We don't quite know what was in this ball, but one thing's for sure: it won't be recycled.

items.name: Tissue
items.description: Don't leave your tissues lying around the office, toss them!

items.name: Ankama Kama
items.description:
Ankama kama, kama, kama, kama chameleon... You come and go, you come and go...

Context (FR) for Localisation: funny money, but it's impossible to get any serious work done today. Halden's on another '80s song kick. Note: Starbender and Nealin hate it when Halden starts singing '80s hits in the office.

items.name: Balanced Recipe
items.description: Neither bad faith nor a bad liver will help you with this recipe.

items.name: Idea Jotted Down on a Slip of Paper
items.description: There are no bad ideas, at least in theory. This one, for example, is absolutely perfect for filling the bin.

items.name: Dream Candle
items.description: This magic candle is supposed to stay lit all throughout Blanquette's birthday, but the dream magic still needs to able to flow... Thankfully, you're here to make sure it does.

items.name: Teletransmitter for Smart Stuffed Toy
items.description: As internal prototypes are exempt from the General Digital Plushy Regulation, this item collects an astronomical amount of data on the use of smart stuffed toys.

items.name: Stuffed Toy Remote Signal Transmission
items.description: A detailed transcription of the latest information recorded by smart stuffed toys.

items.name: Waey
items.description: This substance provides a lot of energy and increases muscle mass. It's found in the organisms of most living creatures in the World of Twelve that are exposed to the sun, partly explaining the strength of many predators.

items.name: Waey Extractor
items.description: This tool can be used to extract waey after a creature has breathed its last. However, be careful not to use it on a creature that is too weak, as stress makes the waey completely unusable.

items.name: Dream Merchant's Contract
items.description: This contract is probably incomprehensible, but you don't really care because you won't read it. You'll just click through to the end, like usual.

items.name: Mental Maths
items.description: Got an ouchie in the brain? Count on fingers... it get better.

items.name: Crushing Guilt
items.description: You'll have to ask a Goblin for forgiveness to get rid of this guilt weighing on your conscience. How absurd is that.

items.name: Ankabar Pass
items.description: To get this pass, you must have made someone very happy!

items.name: Freshly Painted Turquoise Dofus
items.description:
Be careful not to get it everywhere.
(Use the item to place it.)

items.name: Freshly Painted Ebony Dofus
items.description:
Be careful not to get it everywhere.
(Use the item to place it.)

items.name: Freshly Painted Crimson Dofus
items.description:
Be careful not to get it everywhere.
(Use the item to place it.)

items.name: Freshly Painted Ochre Dofus
items.description:
Be careful not to get it everywhere.
(Use the item to place it.)

items.name: Freshly Painted Emerald Dofus
items.description:
Be careful not to get it everywhere.
(Use the item to place it.)

items.name: Decorative Well
items.description:
If your wish is to make those around you happy, instead of tossing a coin into this well and hoping it will come true, take a bath in the well. When you come out, your wish will have been granted.

(Double-click the item to use it.)

items.name: Santho's Growth Vial
items.description: Raymond Santho admits that this product has not officially been tested on Twelvians. Unofficially, however...

items.name: Growth Vial Instructions
items.description:
These instructions explain how to use the growth vial. For best results, you should probably seek assistance from an expert like Erty Trapchet.

(DOUBLE-CLICK THE ITEM TO USE IT.)

items.name: Decorative Cawwot
items.description:
This huge cawwot would make a herd of wabbits drool. Too bad it has no smell and even less flavour and is as hard as a brick.

(Double-click the item to use it.)

items.name: Chest Blueprint
items.description: With this blueprint and a handyman's workshop, you'll be able to craft a chest.

items.name: Decorative Chest
items.description:
This chest is big enough for a contortionist to effortlessly slip into, or for someone else to forcefully squeeze into. In the second case, we encourage you to use the so-called hacksaw method.

(Double-click the item to use it.)

items.name: Crystal Alchemical Vial
items.description: Why is this item so expensive? Because alchemists don't like it when someone gives them flask.

items.name: Gobbette Feed
items.description: Made from a recipe devised by King Allister's chefs, the Amakna Castle Gobbette feed is unmatched. That's not to say it's good, just that it's the only Gobbette feed anyone makes.

items.name: Bouquet of Pippin Blop Flowers
items.description: This bouquet of flowers smells of damp soil and grass.

items.name: Bouquet of Morello Cherry Blop Flowers
items.description: This bouquet of flowers smells of damp soil and grass.

items.name: Bouquet of Coco Blop Flowers
items.description: This bouquet of flowers smells of damp soil and grass.

items.name: Bouquet of Indigo Blop Flowers
items.description: This bouquet of flowers smells of damp soil and grass.

items.name: Decorative Orbalantyr
items.description:
If you stare at the orbs on this Orbalantyr for days, you won't come into contact with the dark lord or anyone else.

(Double-click the item to use it.)

items.name: Lired's Notes
items.description:
Among these notes, one text seems to have been written by someone other than Lired:
"The eastern carver has settled in a lawless place. Hidden by a ruined ship, his feet burned by the sun, he watches the scenery as it ripples lazily."
"Amakna beer" is scribbled at the bottom of this document.

items.name: Lired's Notes
items.description:
Among these notes, one text seems to have been written by someone other than Lired:
"The southern carver has settled where the ground is always breaking open. He isn't afraid of the smouldering maw of the monster watching him at the edge of his territory."
"Burnt Cat beer" is scribbled at the bottom of this document.

items.name: Lired's Notes
items.description:
Among these notes, one text seems to have been written by someone other than Lired:
"The western carver has settled where the natural order is insulted at every turn. Perched on the edge of this land, alongside a deathly mound, she examines the contrasting elements through a dark curtain."
"Scrapmetal beer" is scribbled at the bottom of this document.

items.name: Lired's Notes
items.description:
Among these notes, one text seems to have been written by someone other than Lired:
"The northern carver has settled in a place where strength trumps reason. Overlooking the continent, completely exposed to the wind, she gazes at the fangs rising up to the sky."
"Astrub beer" is scribbled at the bottom of this document.

items.name: Decorative Poutch
items.description:
It's not as fun as taking your anger out on underlings, but it still helps when trying to destress.

(Double-click the item to use it.)

items.name: Tiwaapi Simulation Notification
items.description: Unfortunately, Tiwaapi doesn't have any new simulations to offer. Come back later.

items.name: Tiwotokar Simulation Notification
items.description: Unfortunately, Tiwotokar doesn't have any new simulations to offer. Come back later.

items.name: Tiwagrum Simulation Notification
items.description: Unfortunately, Tiwagrum doesn't have any new simulations to offer. Come back later.

items.name: Restored Book
items.description: A brand new leather cover that smells like frosteez oil, pages like new, an spiffing clasp, it's as if this book is fresh off the printing press! You should be proud of yourself!

items.name: Heroic Soul Stone
items.description: This stone has a discreet power and might be confused with an ordinary soul stone, but it's not the case.

items.name: Suspicious Message
items.description: Sensitive information about the structure of War's army has been hurriedly scribbled on this little piece of paper and it's enough to put a spanner in the works in the chain of command!

items.name: Mayce Innarmz's Report
items.description: Mayce Innarmz writes like a Lousy Pig, but you manage to decipher the message: The machines at the headquarters all have a design defect that can be capitalised on. They have not been monitored since the attack on the village.

items.name: Plegg Innarmz's Report
items.description: Here's a message written in rather sophisticated handwriting: The officers always take their blood baths at the end of the day, so this might be the best time to strike if we want to disrupt the troops. I will notify you if anything changes.

items.name: Hemmar Innarmz's Report
items.description: The message from Hemmar Innarmz is clear and concise. Nothing to report from the Bloodforge area.

items.name: Temporal Prism
items.description: This prism breaks down the time spectrum, allowing you to detect nearby time fluctuations. Invisible anomalies will soon reveal their secrets to you.

items.name: Tarnished Engagement Ring
items.description: This engagement ring, a symbol of genuine love, has suffered the ravages of time, which is not in line with what Filco Norse told you.

items.name: Piece of Thrall Chain
items.description: These links come from the chains of slaves under Servitude's influence.

items.name: Clock Hand Tip
items.description: This clock hand tip is reminiscent of those carried by the Watchers. Maybe it belonged to Pandora?

items.name: Martalo's Watch
items.description: This watch is specially designed to travel through time and space. Imbued with the power of a Watcher, it will protect you against dimensional illnesses and time differences.

items.name: Shackles Key
items.description: Servitude's slave drivers use this key to lock the goblins' shackles. This ensures that the little creatures will stay focused on their task: rowing.

items.name: Goblin's Open Shackles
items.description: It's best not to let a slaver see these shackles. They can't stand it when goblins do runners.

items.name: Blunt Object
items.description: Servitude's Galley is full of blunt objects. They're usually used to bring the slaves into line, but will work well for hitting the ship's huge chains.

items.name: War's Drum
items.description: Is it a war drum or War's drum or War's war drum? In any case, the leather is top quality! Let's hope they used genuine monster hide.

items.name: Exceptional Consultation Request
items.description: Rare is so much flattery to be read in so few handwritten lines. If Georges Segrob doesn't let you consult the royal library documents with that, then nothing will work!

items.name: Ettem Bworn's Notes
items.description: This little piece of paper for Gizmond Quelyn is full of schematics and other eccentric annotations, so let's hope he can use it to make something that doesn't blow up in your face.

items.name: Temporal Prism
items.description: This prism breaks down the time spectrum, allowing you to detect nearby time fluctuations. Invisible anomalies will soon reveal their secrets to you.

items.name: Full Heroic Soul Stone
items.description: The soul of the Autumn Knight is contained in this stone, so hurry up and bring it to Ralag Valiantsilver!

items.name: Forgotten Ore
items.description: Resources are scarce in Misery's Desert. So rare that their very existence is often forgotten.

items.name: Wick
items.description: This wick will allow Reg Chanamo to make an handcrafted bomb.

items.name: Siv Striknos's Diary
items.description: Does this dusty old book contain the most intimate secrets of some loner living in his cave or does it hold reflections in the deeper sense of the word? There's only one way to find out: open it and read it.

items.name: Inventory
items.description: A list of items has been scribbled down on this piece of paper.

items.name: Little Poem
items.description: This document was found in the abandoned cave in Misery's Desert.

items.name: Letter of Summons
items.description: This letter is embossed with Misery's seal.

items.name: Bone Powder
items.description: That which is dust returns to dust. This is why this powder is used to make fertiliser.

items.name: Desert Fertiliser
items.description: This fertiliser is made from bone powder. No plant would grow in this desert environment without it.

items.name: Patched Fabric
items.description: If you don't like second-hand clothes, avoid buying them in Misery's Desert.

items.name: Food Bag
items.description: Miserites store their food in bags like this.

items.name: Water Ration
items.description: Water is a scarce resource, especially when you live in Misery's Desert.

items.name: Strong Rope
items.description: In Misery's Desert, a strong rope is a basic necessity.

items.name: Elimination Round Certificate
items.description: This certificate is awarded to anyone able to spend 30 days and 30 nights alone in the desert braving the Felling Wind.

items.name: List of Taxes to Be Collected
items.description: This list indicates several names alongside a number of resources to be collected on Misery's behalf.

items.name: Bag of Precious Stones
items.description: You will find this kind of thing more easily in Misery's warehouses than in Miserites' homes.

items.name: New Scroll
items.description: This scroll's resistance guarantees smooth writing. You can also use it in emergencies such as a pressing urge if lost in the middle of the desert.

items.name: Tax Collector Insignia
items.description: This insignia is proof that you have passed the tests required to become a tax collector.

items.name: Soulbreaker Potion
items.description: If the black texture of the mixture and the skull and crossbones on the bottle haven't already deterred you from putting the bottle back where you found it, why not take a sip? It's your life after all.

items.name: Volkaragnar Tonic
items.description: This vial contains blacksmith dragon's breath which is perfect for strengthening any weapon.

items.name: Martalo's Watch
items.description: This watch is specially designed to travel through time and space. Imbued with the power of a Watcher, it will protect you against dimensional illnesses and time differences.

items.name: Handcrafted Explosive
items.description: With this explosive box, Reg Chanamo has really proved his talent for making something out of nothing.

items.name: Flower for Grandmother
items.description: This flower is a gift from Sirea for Grandmother, the matriarch of Astrub.

items.name: War's Influence
items.description:
You have a furious desire to fight everyone... It's probably due to the bad influence of War, because in the end, everyone knows that you're all about the peace and love, right?
(This item is necessary to display the Mark of War ornament.)

items.name: Corruption's Influence
items.description:
Your new goal in life is to poison the lives of everyone you meet. Such an attitude is probably caused by Corruption's influence... total insanity is only a small step away, you know.
(This item is necessary to display the Mark of Corruption ornament.)

items.name: Misery's Influence
items.description:
Since you have been under Misery's influence, you've started to keep an eye on your expenses. Sharing the loot is getting more and more difficult. You quibble and bargain all day long. In short, you're becoming a real Enutrof, if you weren't one already.
(This item is necessary to display the Mark of Misery ornament.)

items.name: Servitude's Influence
items.description:
The sound of the whip, the ringing of the chains, the rales of the slaves, the sound of the drum that rhythms the rhythm... All these sounds form a sweet symphony to your ears. Are you under Servitude's influence? Or is it just your sadistic side coming out?...
(This item is necessary to display the Mark of Servitude ornament.)

items.name: Allisterine's Bag
items.description: This small empty bag is the only thing that remained after the old lady disappeared.

items.name: Demongrel Seed
items.description: This seed contains a tainted power that can corrupt the soil where it is planted.

items.name: Corrupted Water
items.description: It's best not to try drinking such water – unless having a third arm or pustules instead of eyes is your thing, of course. We won't judge you.

items.name: Luminescent Mushroom
items.description: As soon as you picked this mushroom, it stopped emitting light. That means you'll need something else to turn your stomach into a torch.

items.name: Putrid Sap
items.description: This unbearable scent of this mixture flows through the plant veins of the monsters in Corruption's dimension. Corrupted Sadidas seem to have many uses for it.

items.name: Parasitic Bud Sample
items.description: This sample of what seems to be a parasitic plant came from the Tree of Death.

items.name: Woyal Lucky Charm
items.description: Rather than relying on luck to get the piece of cake with the lucky charm in it, you've opted for an original, less dangerous method. You waited to find out who got it, then stole it from them. It's immoral – true enough – but effective.

items.name: Dek's Blessing
items.description: A fragment of the power of the Meridia of Poison.

items.name: Jebedai's Blessing
items.description: A fragment of the power of the Meridia of Conjuration.

items.name: Grug's Blessing
items.description: A fragment of the power of the Meridia of Putrefaction.

items.name: Inkola's Blessing
items.description: A fragment of the power of the Meridia of Contagion.

items.name: Eidnas's Blessing
items.description: A fragment of the power of the Meridia of Fungi.

items.name: Kernuros's Power
items.description: This crackling ball of energy is all that remains of the little god of renewal.

items.name: War's Drum
items.description: Is it a war drum or War's drum or War's war drum? In any case, the leather is top quality! Let's hope they used genuine monster hide.

items.name: Sharivaken
items.description: There was a time when the Marquis of Lhambadda entertained himself by sailing the waters of the Kawaii River, on a gutted slot machine just stolen from the Ecaflip Temple. He found out that just one small token stuck in one of the slots was enough to stop the makeshift boat from taking on water. Obviously, those pursuing him were in a bad mood, and they didn't leave him time to cash it in. But these events gave him the idea of producing sharivakens as symbols celebrating the creativity of Shariva's Tumult.

items.name: Great Upender Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Great Upender".

items.name: Poacher Slobber
items.description: Some claim that you can fill dozens of barrels by distilling this slobber. Unfortunately, the poor quality of the resulting hooch can result in overcrowded cemeteries.

items.name: Toaquad Slobber
items.description: This gloopy ingredient is highly prized by witches and scandalmongers. For scandalmongering witches, it's the spice of life.

items.name: Tanuki Two-Lip Pot
items.description: A magical pot engraved with invisible glyphs, a masterpiece of Tanuki craftsmanship. But mostly a masterpiece of simplicity.

items.name: Spiritual Water of Plantala
items.description: This water can quench the thirst of spirits as long as they don't drink fermented beverages. And yes, akwaholism is a terrible affliction that can hurt everyone, including spiritual beings.

items.name: Anti-McSheth Serum
items.description: It took a lot of time and double the toil and trouble to perfect an effective serum to stave off the McSheth. This discovery brings new hope to the intestines of thousands of Twelvians.

items.name: Pint of Fermented Bamboo Milk
items.description: The intoxicating scent of this drink has a heady effect on you before you've even taken the first sip.

items.name: Clear Water
items.description: This spring water from Akwadala is extremely pure. Quality shaké depends on that purity.

items.name: Special Shaké
items.description: Arumichi seems particularly proud of your creation. This shaké will no doubt delight Daimya Hikomi's taste buds.

items.name: Polished Rice
items.description: This rice was polished with love. Apparently, that's a vital step in ensuring good shaké tastes the way it should.

items.name: Daimya's Decree
items.description: Letter written by the Daimya authorising Arumichi to supply the Bamboo Palace with shaké. It also promises that a guard will be posted at the brewery to prevent further incidents.

items.name: Hobnobourglass Magnet
items.description:
This temporistic item allows its bearers to find little hobnobourglasses in their victims' entrails. How appetising!

(Important: each character may only have one hobnobourglass at a time.)

items.name: Mark of the Heretic
items.description: You'd like to believe that the tingling in the back of your neck is just a passing sensation, but it could also be the symbolic weight of your arrogance combined with an irreverent attitude towards the Twelve according to some of their mortal agents. Just saying...

items.name: Magic Seal
items.description: Great acts of magic often begin with small ingredients. Never before has the initiative to curse your noisy neighbours began in a format so respectful of your drawers. Also available in twelve other distinct formats.

items.name: Contemplative Scroll
items.description: This is the start of wonderful opportunities, limited only by your intuition, your motivation, your creativity, the amount of grey matter resting in your cranium, your magical heritage, and a hint of inspiration.

items.name: LOLRPG Seal
items.description: You've received this distinctive mark because your actions were appreciated by the marvellous authorities of the "LOLRPG" collective, a group of discreet adventurers who collect magical trinkets so they can brag about it among friends when they're deep inside dungeons.

items.name: Sacred Bamboo Shoot
items.description: This little shoot could grow into something big. So take care of it like it's your best bud.

items.name: Wild Cucumber
items.description: For once you didn't have to fight to get this cucumber. It turns out wasn't very wild after all.

items.name: Balloch Balm
items.description: Calming balm specially formulated for the sensitive bits of male anatomy.

items.name: Wood Wushu Essence
items.description: This fragment of energy pulsates with the energy of the woods of Plantala.

items.name: Water Wushu Essence
items.description: This fragment of energy pulsates with the energy of the waters of Akwadala.

items.name: Rock Wushu Essence
items.description: This fragment of energy pulsates with the energy of the rocks of Terrdala.

items.name: Fire Wushu Essence
items.description: This fragment of energy pulsates with the energy of the fires of Feudala.

items.name: Wind Wushu Essence
items.description: This fragment of energy pulsates with the energy of the winds of Aerdala.

items.name: Offering to the Wind Spirit
items.description: Who would ever have thought that a spirit could love the taste of fruit this much?

items.name: Travel Permit
items.description: This pass was signed by Masters Wukin and Wukang. It authorises its holder to travel freely outside the fortifications built by the Kozaru.

items.name: Rock Claw
items.description: This claw was given to you by the Rock Spirit.

items.name: Wind Claw
items.description: This claw was given to you by the Wind Spirit.

items.name: Easy Balloch Balm Recipe
items.description: Even a beginner alchemist could make this recipe successfully.

items.name: Recommendation from Dick Kerboo Brandtawa
items.description: You've helped the librarian of Pandala Village, so he has given you this letter of recommendation addressed to the Pandarin Sudopong.

items.name: Recommendation from Ghao Zuo
items.description: The cellarer Ghao Zuo gushes about you in this letter. Let's hope the Pandarin Sudopong will look upon you favourably after reading it.

items.name: Black Ink
items.description: This ink may be used to create beautiful patterns on the paper of your lantern. If you don't know how to use a paintbrush, you'll have to dip your fingers in the ink and hope for the best.

items.name: Supple Bamboo Wood
items.description: This bamboo wood is still green and very flexible, making it perfect to cut into thin straps... or whip the stubborn local fauna.

items.name: Rice Paper
items.description: This red paper is mainly used to make unique lanterns.

items.name: Ceremonial Lantern
items.description: This lantern isn't perfect but you've poured all your love into making it; maybe the Fire Spirit will be moved by what could be called your "artistic process".

items.name: Gordo McRamsay's Filtounga
items.description: Filtounga was a unique dish. It should probably stay that way for the sake of the intestinal flora of all Twelvians.

items.name: Fouxwork Powder
items.description: This powder should be handled with care.

items.name: Unlit Incense Stick
items.description: Feudalans light these types of sticks to purify the region.

items.name: Lit Incense Stick
items.description: The smoke coming off this stick purifies the air and keeps parasites away from the lantern-trees.

items.name: Miraculous Water
items.description: This water comes from a magical spring in the Akwadala region.

items.name: Spark of the Fire Spirit
items.description: This spark comes from the Primordial Lantern.

items.name: Ritual Candle
items.description: This candle can burn for months on end without burning down as long as it is not used to cast out an evil spirit that has possessed a living being.

items.name: Recommendation from Yendong
items.description: You foiled a bank robbery, which has earned you a letter of recommendation from Yendong, the guardian of all Pandalans' savings.

items.name: Lantern Festival Riddle
items.description: A few words have been painted in black ink on this talisman in magnificent handwriting, which must have required immense patience.

items.name: Sesame Wanchiao
items.description: This traditional Pandawa pastry is a ball of sticky rice stuffed with sesame seeds. Why not have a contest to see who can put the most in their mouth at once? Just don't forget to breathe.

items.name: Bean Wanchiao
items.description: This traditional Pandawa pastry is a ball of sticky rice stuffed with sweet beans. Why not have a contest to see who can put the most in their mouth at once? Just don't forget to breathe.

items.name: Enchanted Mortar
items.description: This enchanted mortar was once in the Fouxwork Factory. It seems terribly old and somehow tied to the Fire Spirit.

items.name: Fire Claw
items.description: This claw was given to you by the Fire Spirit.

items.name: Pandweian Rokwa
items.description: This scroll explaining the Rokwa kwata is hard to read. The good news is that it contains pictures to help you understand the words.

items.name: Meditate on One's Mistakes
items.description: It's frustrating but sometimes you need to let some time go by in order to understand your mistakes. Take an hour or so to meditate on what those words mean.

items.name: Lit Ritual Candle
items.description: There is something hypnotising about the dancing flame on the tip of this candle. Don't stare into it too long or you might forget to take care of yourself.

items.name: Spark Jar
items.description: This jar lets you keep sparks. When full, never play with it near fouxworks or... sparks will be sure to fly.

items.name: Fertile Water
items.description: If you make an offering of this water to the forest spirits, you can temporarily placate the angry Plantalas.

items.name: Patience
items.description: It seems the Wood Spirit is much more patient than you. This flower (which is also sometimes called impatience) is there to remind you of that, but you'll have forgotten everything in a few minutes anyway.

items.name: Wood Claw
items.description: This claw was given to you by the Wood Spirit.

items.name: Empty Syringe
items.description: Use this syringe to take a blood sample from a Pandawa who's downed a full bottle. Something tells me you won't have much trouble finding one.

items.name: Anti-McSheth Serum Recipe
items.description: The disclaimers saying that this remedy is experimental are hardly reassuring...

items.name: Page from the Bamboo Grove Harvesting Register
items.description:
No, the thick red liquid that has dried on this torn page is not tomato juice. Could it be raspberry juice?
(Double-click to read the document.)

items.name: Naughty Adventurer
items.description: It will take a few minutes to make Kwatalo forget that you're not a brutish adventurer lacking in common decency.

items.name: Enchanted Kwapa Water
items.description: This attractive sparkling water with an otherworldly appearance looks luscious. But at the end of the day, it's still just skull juice.

items.name: Shamanic Certificate
items.description: Certificate required to practise Pandawushu.

items.name: Pandawushu Practitioner's Certificate
items.description: This administrative document issued by the Daimya herself allows foreigners to practise Pandawushu. Requires a prior shamanic certificate to be valid.

items.name: Grand Puddah Offering
items.description:
This little sachet is supposed to contain a prayer to the Grand Puddah, but the message it contains seems to be for someone else...
(Double-click to find out more.)

items.name: Diaphanous Ink Dofus
items.description: This inky egg seems colourless and translucent. Has it lost some of its magic? The dragon Orukam should be able to answer that question.

items.name: Concealment Flask
items.description:
The gas in this flask will make you look like someone else. Hopefully, that someone is a nothing.
(Double-click to use the flask.)

items.name: Female Tanuki Defeat
items.description: As your bruises show, this clump of hair was ripped violently from a female Tanuki. Now you know that Tanukis – both male and female – are not docile creatures.

items.name: Male Tanuki Defeat
items.description: As your bruises show, this clump of hair was ripped violently from a male Tanuki. Now you know that Tanukis – both male and female – are not docile creatures.

items.name: Flat Stone
items.description: Tanukis use these stones to make convoluted structures. You need to be an expert to get them to stay in place, particularly given how much they weigh.

items.name: Water Claw
items.description: This claw was given to you by the Water Spirit.

items.name: Note
items.description: This note was written by the shaman's assistant, but not signed by his parents. It is addressed to the innkeeper in Osakwa.

items.name: Pandawushuka Outfit
items.description: This traditional outfit was worn by generations of Pandawushuka before you. Well, not this particular one because you've just made it, but you get the idea.

items.name: The Price of Your Mistakes
items.description: It's frustrating but sometimes you need to let some time go by in order to understand your mistakes. The master might be willing to talk to you again in a day or so.

items.name: Lingering Odour
items.description: The odour should dissipate in a few minutes and you'll be able to resume your conversation with the flower. Don't make any mistakes next time or you might feel as bad as you smell afterwards.

items.name: Libation
items.description: This bottle was a gift from Hairod'og, along with two drinking cups. Fill both equally and drink to the health of the departed. Now that is how you honour the memory of drunken warrior masters.

items.name: Ghumsor Liqueur
items.description: You've squeezed this liqueur from a plant known as Ghumsor. Apparently, it produces this liqueur naturally to attract nearby insects and small animals. Unfortunately for it, you're neither small nor an insect.

items.name: Pearl of Wisdom
items.description: Now this is an authentic pearl of wisdom handed out by an authentic Lenald master. A lovely gift... even though you still have no idea how to use it. If all else fails, you can always use it to play taws.

items.name: Rank Attainment
items.description: This piece of paper is stamped with the date you last earned a new Pandawushuka rank.

items.name: Rested Dictionayokai
items.description:
Feel free to consult the Tsukumogami's pages for hints as to which spirits need to be recorded. Don't forget that after three writing sessions per day, the Tsukumogami might not be able to find the right words.
(Double-click to read Dictionayokai's notes.)

items.name: Tired Dictionayokai
items.description:
You'll have to wait a little before continuing your quest for spirits... just until your scribe dries the ink on his pages.
(Double-click to wake Dictionayokai up after a day's rest.)

items.name: Full Glass
items.description: This glass is full. But probably not for long.

items.name: Aunty Winette's Amulet
items.description: This amulet was made from part of its previous owner's dentures.

items.name: Week of Seven Saturdays
items.description: After the week of four Thursdays, here's the week of seven Saturdays. This fake calendar isn't very convincing, but with a bit of luck, it could trick a spirit into showing itself.

items.name: Cold Water
items.description: This cool water comes from a well in Pandala Village.

items.name: Chtiger Eye
items.description: This stone is used by the Tanukis to set the eyes in earthenware figurines.

items.name: Prayer Paper
items.description: If you want the Fire Spirit to grant your wishes, it's said you must write them down on prayer paper then burn your wishes in a brazier on top of Mount Foux-Chi. Legend or reality? The important thing is believing.

items.name: Virtue of Fertility
items.description: This "work of art" that you polished yourself represents one of the Tanuki virtues that lead to artistic perfection. It would make a magnificent paperweight.

items.name: Virtue of Rectitude
items.description: This "work of art" that you polished yourself represents one of the Tanuki virtues that lead to artistic perfection. It would make a magnificent paperweight.

items.name: Virtue of Harmony
items.description: This "work of art" that you polished yourself represents one of the Tanuki virtues that lead to artistic perfection. It would make a magnificent paperweight.

items.name: Virtue of Greatness
items.description: This "work of art" that you polished yourself represents one of the Tanuki virtues that lead to artistic perfection. It would make a magnificent paperweight.

items.name: Virtue of Sincerity
items.description: This "work of art" that you polished yourself represents one of the Tanuki virtues that lead to artistic perfection. It would make a magnificent paperweight.

items.name: Remedy for Yinagi
items.description: This fujibakama-based remedy is supposed to cure all afflictions of the body and mind. Inataba's wife, Yinagi, seems to really need it.

items.name: Soporific Spores
items.description: Just a tiny pinch of this power is enough to put the most enraged Bworks into a state akin to a deep coma.

items.name: Nenufrog Bulb
items.description: It would seem that this kind of bulb that grows on Nenufrogs serves a reproductive purpose. Next time you see Nenufrogs rubbing against each other, you'll know what they're up to.

items.name: Ribbon-Wrapped Branch
items.description: A broken branch from the Plantala silvery weeping willow. There's a ribbon attached to it. Maybe Inataba knows who it belonged to.

items.name: Damadrya Leaf
items.description: A simple leaf torn from the guardian of Plantala. It seems to still have traces of residual magic that could be used to do evil.

items.name: Veggifying Potion
items.description: You shouldn't drink this potion unless you want to be eating daisies roots first, literally.

items.name: Charred Bark
items.description: This bit of bark is perfect for any type of grilling.

items.name: Mountain Flower Petal
items.description: This petal comes from a flower in full bloom at dizzying altitudes. So there's nothing surprising about finding one in the Aerdala region.

items.name: Wild Root
items.description: These roots are not easy to get... Your bruises are ample proof of that.

items.name: Keg O'Beer's Souvenir Chest
items.description: This chest belonged to a Stubbyob who left to open an inn on Pandala Island.

items.name: Keg O'Beer's Old Soft Toy
items.description: Keg O'Beer was only able to fall asleep without his soft toy at the age of 177 – and even then, he wasn't willing to part with it.

items.name: Bottle of Pandabsinthe
items.description: Pandabsinthe is a rare, mysterious, and extremely powerful alcohol reputed to drive mortals mad. Consider yourself warned.

items.name: Fermented Mixture
items.description: This mixture is the main ingredient in a very rare alcohol – Pandabsinthe.

items.name: Grass Snake Venom
items.description: This venom can kill a Trool in less than an hour.

items.name: Mark of the Flame
items.description: You have chosen a thoughtful and analytical fighting style. Just thinking about it sets your mind ablaze with the zeal of a fighter.

items.name: Mark of the Storm
items.description: You have chosen a quick and nimble fighting style, like the piercing wind of a storm.

items.name: Mark of the Tide
items.description: You have chosen an unpredictable and dangerous fighting style, like the sea can sometimes be.

items.name: Mark of the Rock
items.description: You have chosen a fighting style based on brute strength. Every hit makes the ground tremble beneath your enemies' feet.

items.name: Mark of the Leaf
items.description: You have chosen a balanced and neutral fighting style, like a tree leaf being carried along by the breeze of destiny.

items.name: Kameoza
items.description: This Yokai is quite heavy. Carry it to the Stubbyob inn in Pandala Village... but be careful not to strain your back!

items.name: Bamboo Grove Harvesting Register
items.description: The information in this register, which was taken from Kykori, confirms what you already know: excessive bamboo harvesting for sordid reasons has had serious consequences.

items.name: Tanuki Thief's Soul
items.description: The thief won't get away from you this time!

items.name: Immaculate Kwapa Carapace
items.description: Removing the carapace from a Kwapa is one thing. Removing it without it damaging it in combat is quite another. You should be very proud of yourself.

items.name: Colossal Rocky Fist
items.description: This rocky fist has many uses. It's so large that the Tanukis use it as a cradle for their offspring, while others use it as a dumbbell for bodybuilding, and... well, it's just really useful.

items.name: Spirit Seeds
items.description: Plant these seeds at the base of the Goroku Tree so the fruit can be reborn.

items.name: Goroku Fruit Quarter
items.description: Eating this fruit once will then let you enter a different world.

items.name: Bonoboru Tuft
items.description: This hair will disappear to join its owner as soon as the owner shows up again, which will be in a few minutes.

items.name: Large Fan
items.description:
Take care not to start a hurricane when fanning yourself.

(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Pandala Lotus
items.description: In the language of flowers, the lotus is a symbol of purity.

items.name: Large Fan
items.description:
Take care not to start a hurricane when fanning yourself.

(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Large Fan
items.description:
Take care not to start a hurricane when fanning yourself.

(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Fertile Thoughts
items.description: A spirit accompanied by young bamboo plants gave you some food for thought. But don't worry, it won't take you more than 10 minutes.

items.name: Pandala Mildew
items.description: This white, cottony powder could make the situation in Plantala Forest much worse.

items.name: Flask of Shaké
items.description: This sample of a new Pandawa beverage probably can't do you any harm...

items.name: Empty Bottle of Shaké
items.description: This bottle of shaké is currently empty but won't be for long.

items.name: Fermentation Time
items.description: Annoyingly, good shaké needs time to ferment properly. You surely have many other things you could be doing in the meantime.

items.name: Scrap of Uniform
items.description: Arumichi may be able to tell you where this ripped-off scrap of a uniform comes from.

items.name: Pandalan Fishing Rod
items.description: A half-broken fishing rod that was used to knock out Arumichi.

items.name: Tsukinochi Ectoplasm
items.description: To get this ectoplasm, you must have scared the living daylights out of a Tsukinochi!

items.name: Drumurai Ectoplasm
items.description: To get this ectoplasm, you must have scared the living daylights out of a Drumurai!

items.name: Onabu-Geisha Ectoplasm
items.description: To get this ectoplasm, you must have scared the living daylights out of an Onabu-Geisha!

items.name: Jiangshi-Nobi Ectoplasm
items.description: To get this ectoplasm, you must have scared the living daylights out of a Jiangshi-Nobi!

items.name: Mysterious Substance
items.description: This soft, greyish substance gives off a powerful smell.

items.name: Suspicious Substance
items.description: If you look very closely at this green heap, you'll notice some reddish hues.

items.name: Unusual Substance
items.description: Only an expert could determine the origin of this substance.

items.name: Inali's Brooch
items.description: This piece of jewellery is proof that Inali, the goddess of rice, supports the adventurer wearing it.

items.name: Koumiho's Kitsounebi Flame
items.description: This burning flame from a Kitsoune will undoubtedly be an effective weapon against the Yokai eating the dead.

items.name: Yor Solismynao's Spellbook
items.description: Only trained eyes can read the contents of this book.

items.name: Dorigami
items.description: It's time to return the Dofus to its legitimate guardian: Ronald the Wise Lenald.

items.name: Araknawa Lily Bloom
items.description: Also called the "equinox flower" and the "ghosts' flower", the araknawa lily is a symbol of farewells. The errant guide has made it his crest.

items.name: Nasumara's List of Components
items.description:
List of components needed to forge an exceptional katana.
(Double-click to check the list.)

items.name: Kamanekoban
items.description: With a theoretical value of ten million kamas, this lucky coin is actually worth all the gold in the world.

items.name: Blessed Kamanekoban
items.description: This kamanekoban has been blessed with the god Nekineko's magic. Its power will allow Mona to stay an adorable Ginger Bow Meowette and not turn into a Bakeneko. At least that's what Sobomori hopes...

items.name: Kitetsu
items.description: Nasumara imbued his katana with all his resentment and hatred of the World of Twelve that never recognised his talent. The blade shines with evil energy and merely placing your hand on its sheath is enough to make you profoundly uneasy.

items.name: Externam Lantern
items.description: The light of Externam will guide you along the Route of the Dead and keep away spectres that wish you harm... up to a point. You'd better be ready for the worst just in case.
